title: (Trump) Gamer System
description_html:
Your Shard grants you access to a game-like system to manage your power(s). By default, you have access to a basic system which includes attributes and the ability to grow by gaining experience. You gain experience by completing quests or defeating enemies (does not need to involve killing them) and can increase your attributes by training. How the system works in details depends on the Shard, two people with this power can have systems that work differently.

All other powers you select interface through this one and unlock their ability to grow. As you use them, your powers will grow in strength and will unlock new aspects.

Your growth potential is not unlimited, however. Your Shard can only support a certain amount of total progression. This limit will be communicated to you.

addons.title: Over Leveling
addons.description_html:
Thanks to being able to absorb zero-point energy into its own reserves, it is possible to level up your abilities beyond what you were previously capable of.

It is also possible through [Calculation] to turn zero-point energy directly into experience points. Experience points gained this way will require a decent amount of zero-point energy. Your shard may also begin experiencing diminishing returns on the amount of experience points gained if you use this method too much in a given time frame. Negentropy removes this restriction.

addons.title: [Insert Place] Development System Aid!
addons.description_html:
You now gain a secondary system all based on the employees you have under you. This system will take track of everything that makes them suited to work under you and will provide the best tool's for you to make them better, whether it’s auto-generated video lessons to help a struggling employee overcome a weakness, food and drinks that boost physical or mental performance, or subtle behind-the-scenes adjustments that make operations run more smoothly—this system ensures your workforce thrives.

The benefits don’t stop at productivity. You gain access to the full potential of your employees' abilities. In need of a skill like [Coding] or [Law], you can temporarily borrow their proficiency. You can also passively absorb a portion of their [EXP], whether it's from skill progression or level-ups—if your system includes such mechanics.

If an employee is loyal enough to offer their life for you—whether due to genuine devotion, manipulation, or other reasons—they become something lesser: a unit that will carry out any command without hesitation, questioning only for the betterment about completing the objective.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Magnets, Son! How do they work?
description_html: You can create and shape magnetic fields within a 100-meter range, field formation is instantaneous, powerful, and extremely precise. You are limited only by your concentration, focus, ingenuity, materials at hand, and the space available within your range. This can be used for applications such as manipulating, compressing, and launching metal, or anything else you can get to work through magnetic field interactions. This comes with a passive defensive shield that will protect you fully from shockwaves, and deflect magnetic attacks such as metals, electricity, or plasma.

title: (Master/Stranger) If Anything Were To Happen…
description_html: You can not be harmed, arrested, detained, captured, imprisoned, or otherwise obstructed by any non-powered persons or non-sapient beings. Immediately before making such an attempt, they will decide to spend the next hour zealously trying to kill their compatriots and then themselves.

title: (Brute) Unlimited Potential
description_html: As you train, your body adapts. While you will always look human, you no longer have a glass ceiling stopping you from becoming stronger. As long as your training is strenuous, you will always get stronger. The training has to be enough to make you sweat, and your muscles need to hurt at least a little from lactic acid build-up. Fighting will get you significantly more gains than just training.

addons.title: Muscle Baby
addons.description_html:
Your body constantly refines itself for maximum efficiency, strength, and resilience. Every action—whether sprinting, lifting, or fighting—triggers precise adaptations. Sprinting increases speed, weightlifting enhances endurance, and combat sharpens movement and reaction time. Your body eliminates inefficiencies, ensuring that every gain improves overall performance.

You also adapt to external threats. If something nearly kills you, your body ensures it won’t happen again by reinforcing itself against similar dangers. Heat, force, and trauma trigger permanent resistance. Your muscles continuously harden and densify, making you stronger and more durable over time. With enough training and survival experience, your body becomes nearly indestructible.

title: (Trump/Breaker) Emulation of an Alien Caveman
description_html:
Your power grants you all the abilities and attributes of an ancient Shard, the ancestors of modern Entities, from before they merged into the first Entities and left their homeworld. You are not actually an ancient Shard; you continue to be whatever species you are naturally, with these abilities and attributes merely being an emulation created by your power.

The abilities this emulation grants you include innate mid-tier brute strength, regen, and durability, the ability to travel to nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to safely absorb large quantities of “basic” energies like heat, radiation, and electricity that you can store and release at a later time at a nearly 1 to 1 ratio with only minor energy loss, the ability to see various basic wavelengths for miles in all directions including into nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to quickly mentally process and store large quantities of information, the ability to sense and manipulate space-time by a limited degree in a small area around you, and the ability consume and breakdown nearly any type of basic matter for fuel.

You may also study the abilities and attributes of other creatures, including parahumans, and, through these studies, replicate those abilities and attributes with your own power for personal use. Though, because of the complexity of modern shards and the protections their abilities have against being understood by the unauthorized, you’ll struggle to produce abilities this way that are more complex or powerful than those that “The Fragile One” possesses, except for basic abilities like heat manipulation that can be considered extensions or evolutions of capabilities you started with.

This replication and copying ability is accomplished by mentally manipulating the false biology of a simulation your power provides of the ancient Shard your power is emulating to accurately represent an ancient Shard with those abilities.

All the abilities and attributes this power grants are accurately represented in the simulation of the ancient shard this power is emulating. You can manipulate the simulation to a large and precise degree, which accurately affects all the abilities your power grants based on the simulation. All alterations to the simulation must be biologically possible for a Shard, with your power providing a pseudo-thinker power to understand ancient Shard biology.

The simulation also has a total size limit equal to only that of an average modern shard, so you can’t just keep growing and adding to your simulated shard to have all your abilities derived from the simulation at full power and maximum capabilities. At the same time, you will eventually have to make sacrifices and compromises in your various “builds” of the simulation.

Your true body acts as the equivalent of an Entity avatar in the simulation your shard is emulating. If you develop the right capabilities in the simulation, you'll be able to do anything to your body that an Entity can do to their avatars.

You must fuel all of these abilities yourself, with running out of energy being fatal for you. You start full of energy and can store as much energy as your actual Shard has the storage capacity for.

With just this power, you do not start with FTL or space travel capabilities, the ability to communicate with modern Shards, or the ability to have hosts of your own, though you may eventually develop such abilities with the right alterations to the simulation.

If you have taken the negentropy perk, the way it manifests for this power is a bit unique. Instead of just eliminating your need to worry about your energy reserves, it provides you with a modest passive energy generation rate for your fuel reserves, rapid enough to bring you from an empty tank to full in thirty minutes. Running out of energy will also no longer be fatal; it will merely knock you unconscious for a few minutes.

addons.title: Shard Bud
addons.description_html: Your virtual Ancient Shard and your current Shard-like physiology have now merged into a single, cohesive entity. You are now more akin to a bud, although purposely limited. While you now have no actual size limit, two soft limitations exist. First, the bigger you are, the more energy is required to sustain you and perform any meaningful action, with the amount needed increasing exponentially. Second, expanding your size can complicate daily interactions and tasks, making normal life cumbersome. This however is not all drawbacks, as you now have a better time replicating powers, with those on the level of “The Fragile One” being entirely within your capability. You also now come inbuilt with the ability to project an Avatar if you ever feel the need to do so.

addons.title: [Comprehension]
addons.description_html: Your ability to replicate natural phenomena through understanding meshes well with your abilities as a Shard. Your ability to sense the various wavelengths at work allows you to better comprehend any physical phenomena you observe, while your ability to influence the physical world through understanding makes the creation of powers based on your knowledge and understanding incredibly intuitive. All of these benefits are exponentially greater in strength should you possess Natural Way, such that you can understand all but the most complex of powers with but a single glance and replicate them with little effort.

addons.title: [Budding]
addons.description_html: Your mastery over bio-crystalline flesh and the creation of living beings from it allows you to circumvent your size limitations to a certain extent in a very unique way by unlocking the secret to [Budding], the creation of new Shards from the [DATA] and flesh of existing ones. At will, you can create a virtual Bud of your Shard self, creating another virtual Shard based on the configuration your Shard self was in when it Budded. This virtual Shard can then be assigned to someone, whether that be yourself or someone else, allowing them to use whatever powers it is configured for. Be wary, however, as the act of Budding is very energy-consuming. These virtual Shards have their own separate energy reserves to fuel the abilities they supply, which must be managed; otherwise, they die, although you can supply energy from your reserves to them and vice versa. Be wary that you can easily drain your Shard’s reserves by creating too many Buds quickly without proper energy generation, although Negentropy negates this risk. If you possess Shard Bud, then you can take this one step further and use Maker of the End to create actual Shard flesh from your body, rendering your virtual Buds true primitive Shards in full. This also circumvents your need to worry about creating too many Buds, as your Shard isn’t simulating virtual Shards but actually creating new ones. Create enough Shards, and you might as well be a primitive Entity, with a network of Shards and powers at your disposal.

addons.title: The Primordial Titan
addons.description_html:
Powers you create are no longer limited in strength or scope, allowing the results of your simulations to rival The Triumvirate; with enough time and creativity, you might even be able to take down an Endbringer on your own. What's more, any powers you create also benefit from the jail-breaking properties of Cronus.

Your Brute enhancements are likewise magnified, making you stronger and tougher than most other Titans.

addons.text: Your ability to replicate natural phenomena through understanding meshes well with your abilities as a Shard. Your ability to sense the various wavelengths at work allows you to better comprehend any physical phenomena you observe, while your ability to influence the physical world through understanding makes the creation of powers based on your knowledge and understanding incredibly intuitive. All of these benefits are exponentially greater in strength should you possess Natural Way, such that you can understand all but the most complex of powers with but a single glance and replicate them with little effort.
addons.title: [Comprehension]

addons.text: Your mastery over bio-crystalline flesh and the creation of living beings from it allows you to circumvent your size limitations to a certain extent in a very unique way by unlocking the secret to [Budding], the creation of new Shards from the [DATA] and flesh of existing ones. At will, you can create a virtual Bud of your Shard self, creating another virtual Shard based on the configuration your Shard self was in when it Budded. This virtual Shard can then be assigned to someone, whether that be yourself or someone else, allowing them to use whatever powers it is configured for. Be wary, however, as the act of Budding is very energy-consuming. These virtual Shards have their own separate energy reserves to fuel the abilities they supply, which must be managed; otherwise, they die, although you can supply energy from your reserves to them and vice versa. Be wary that you can easily drain your Shard’s reserves by creating too many Buds quickly without proper energy generation, although Negentropy negates this risk. If you possess Shard Bud, then you can take this one step further and use Maker of the End to create actual Shard flesh from your body, rendering your virtual Buds true primitive Shards in full. This also circumvents your need to worry about creating too many Buds, as your Shard isn’t simulating virtual Shards but actually creating new ones. Create enough Shards, and you might as well be a primitive Entity, with a network of Shards and powers at your disposal.
addons.title: [Budding]

addons.text:
Powers you create are no longer limited in strength or scope, allowing the results of your simulations to rival The Triumvirate; with enough time and creativity, you might even be able to take down an Endbringer on your own. What's more, any powers you create also benefit from the jail-breaking properties of Cronus.

Your Brute enhancements are likewise magnified, making you stronger and tougher than most other Titans.
addons.title: The Primordial Titan

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Your power grants you all the abilities and attributes of an ancient Shard, the ancestors of modern Entities, from before they merged into the first Entities and left their homeworld. You are not actually an ancient Shard; you continue to be whatever species you are naturally, with these abilities and attributes merely being an emulation created by your power.

The abilities this emulation grants you include innate mid-tier brute strength, regen, and durability, the ability to travel to nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to safely absorb large quantities of “basic” energies like heat, radiation, and electricity that you can store and release at a later time at a nearly 1 to 1 ratio with only minor energy loss, the ability to see various basic wavelengths for miles in all directions including into nearby dimensions that aren’t blocked, the ability to quickly mentally process and store large quantities of information, the ability to sense and manipulate space-time by a limited degree in a small area around you, and the ability consume and breakdown nearly any type of basic matter for fuel.

You may also study the abilities and attributes of other creatures, including parahumans, and, through these studies, replicate those abilities and attributes with your own power for personal use. Though, because of the complexity of modern shards and the protections their abilities have against being understood by the unauthorized, you’ll struggle to produce abilities this way that are more complex or powerful than those that “The Fragile One” possesses, except for basic abilities like heat manipulation that can be considered extensions or evolutions of capabilities you started with.

This replication and copying ability is accomplished by mentally manipulating the false biology of a simulation your power provides of the ancient Shard your power is emulating to accurately represent an ancient Shard with those abilities.

All the abilities and attributes this power grants are accurately represented in the simulation of the ancient shard this power is emulating. You can manipulate the simulation to a large and precise degree, which accurately affects all the abilities your power grants based on the simulation. All alterations to the simulation must be biologically possible for a Shard, with your power providing a pseudo-thinker power to understand ancient Shard biology.

The simulation also has a total size limit equal to only that of an average modern shard, so you can’t just keep growing and adding to your simulated shard to have all your abilities derived from the simulation at full power and maximum capabilities. At the same time, you will eventually have to make sacrifices and compromises in your various “builds” of the simulation.

Your true body acts as the equivalent of an Entity avatar in the simulation your shard is emulating. If you develop the right capabilities in the simulation, you'll be able to do anything to your body that an Entity can do to their avatars.

You must fuel all of these abilities yourself, with running out of energy being fatal for you. You start full of energy and can store as much energy as your actual Shard has the storage capacity for.

With just this power, you do not start with FTL or space travel capabilities, the ability to communicate with modern Shards, or the ability to have hosts of your own, though you may eventually develop such abilities with the right alterations to the simulation.

If you have taken the negentropy perk, the way it manifests for this power is a bit unique. Instead of just eliminating your need to worry about your energy reserves, it provides you with a modest passive energy generation rate for your fuel reserves, rapid enough to bring you from an empty tank to full in thirty minutes. Running out of energy will also no longer be fatal; it will merely knock you unconscious for a few minutes.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Trump/Breaker) Emulation of an Alien Caveman

title: (Breaker/Trump) Cronus
description_html: Titans are Parahumans who have undergone a 'broken' Second Trigger, which results in their shard taking full agency over their body. You have dodged losing control of your body, but have still gained the ability to transform into a state where your Shard is dominant and all of your powers lose their limits. Any powers you take are buffed to be at around the level an Endbringer might be, and you have access to the full breadth of your shard. All Titans also have massively increased durability.

title: (Brute) Typhon
description_html:
While your appearance is still human, your body is that of an Endbringer—something that was never human, lacking all conventional organs. While it can flawlessly imitate any function of the human body—being considered “alive” for the purposes of the Manton Effect—its ultimately inhuman nature renders you immune to powers that target humans, such as those belonging to Regent or Imp.

Your body is extremely dense and composed of layers of increasingly durable flesh wrapped around a central core. This gives you incredible strength, durability, and speed. Any injuries dealt to you will leak a black ichor but will eventually regenerate flawlessly—so long as your core remains intact. If your core is destroyed, you will die.

Like an Endbringer, you cannot be easily predicted by most Thinker powers, with you being a total blind spot to precognitive abilities like those possessed by Contessa. You lack a power on the same scale as that of the Endbringers, instead any other powers you might possess are 25% stronger.

addons.title: Tártaros
addons.description_html: Your insides’ dimensional layering melds with your Endbringer body, causing reinforcing layers to appear the closer an attack gets to your core. It works by compressing and compacting multiple layers, more durable and dense than the previous one, in proportion to your core’s proximity, to such an extent that any attack that isn’t All-or-Nothing will find it nigh-impossible even to reach your core.

addons.title: Autochthon
addons.description_html:
In an attempt to fix the connection between you and it, your shard has, predictably, made things worse. Your body and core are no longer composed of Endbringer flesh, but rather the same bio-crystalline material that serves as the source of parahuman power: Shard-matter. This further boosts all of your powers by 25% and reduces all damage you take from non-esoteric sources. 

Finally, due to being made of shard-flesh, you are highly resistant to the unwanted Master, Stranger, Thinker, and Trump parahuman powers. If your powers are Shardless or you possess the Esoteric Knowledge perk, this resistance also applies to non-shard powers that would fall under the same classifications.

title: (Changer) The End-Becomer
description_html:
With each purchase here, you gain your own personal Endbringer changer form. Your form’s appearances and abilities can be left to chance or alternatively you can use the available customization section to decide your forms powers and overall appearance. You can intuitively control your Endbringer forms with as much natural ease you do your own body.

All forms you gain via this power will be of at least comparable strength and capabilities of the canon Endbringers. While you can use your non-Endbringer powers in this form, your Endbringer powers can only be used while in the associated Endbringer form. When your Shard runs out of power, you’ll find yourself stuck in whichever form you were in at the time.

description_html:

You can choose the intelligence level of your Endbringers, whether that is something alien, computer-like, human-level, animal-level, simply a puppet you have to direct, or something else entirely.

Your Endbringer’s appearance and/or abilities can be left to chance, or alternatively, you can use the available customization section to decide their powers and overall appearance.

All Endbringers you gain via this power will be of at least comparable strength to the canon Endbringers.

title: (Shaker) Inviolable
description_html:
You can create a large number of inviolable forcefields, your only limit is visualization and concentration. You must be able to keep track of all the forcefields you create, a multitasking power greatly increases the number you can manage at once. 

Each individual forcefield can be at most 400 square meters in surface and 10 centimeters thick, multiple fields can interlock to form a larger one. You can control the permeability at will. Nothing short of Sting can penetrate these. The edges of these forcefields are sharper than anything any Tinker has ever made, unless you intentionally smooth them out.

title: (Trump) Aliena
description_html:
This power is the conceptual mirror to Eidolon, while he can have three strong powers, you can have 20-30 weak powers.

You have a total of 75 points to allocate to your powers. A single power cannot exceed 5 points. A power's point worth is roughly proportional to its potency which is roughly equal to it's rating plus one ('Thinker 0' costs 1 point, 'Blaster 4' costs 5 points, etc.). Powers with hybrid rating ('Mover/Stranger 3' or 'Mover 3, Stranger 1') tend to be rated higher than simple abilities but less than the sum of their parts. You cannot summon duplicate powers or powers too close to an existing power. Tinker and Trump powers have their own, stricter, summoning rules (left to the author).

It takes up to 90 seconds to summon a power and decreases exponentially for weaker powers. If a power is invalid (too powerful) the summon will fail once it reaches the maximum time. You can recall previously summoned powers for a fraction of the initial time and a multitasking power allows you to recall multiple at once. You can dismiss any power instantly. All effects dependent on those powers will stop when the ability is dismissed but lingering or permanent effects remain (like Tinkertech or body-alterations).

You're a precognitive blindspot to everyone but the entity. Negentropy increases your point capacity to 125 and maximum points per power to 7.

title: (Trump) Eidolon
description_html:
You have Eidolon's powerset. This lets you have 3 strong powers at a time, though you can instead exchange strong powers for 2-3 weaker ones each. You need to either be actively using the powers, or trying to keep hold of them, otherwise they will fade shortly after reaching full power.

This power will take into account your desires but it ultimately decides what powers you get based on what it thinks you need. You can place basic requirements such as 'it must be a laser power', or 'it must grant me a form of flight', or 'it must be a tinker power'.
 
The strong powers this power can grant will be heads and shoulders over the powers of most parahumans. All powers will take a couple of minutes to build up strength, though they're still usable before reaching full strength. You will not be able to create or control Endbringers, and are a precognitive blindspot to everyone but the Entity. 

Negentropy lets you hold five strong powers at a time.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Ignis Fatuus
description_html: You can “flicker”, allowing you to page through realities and possible states of yourself and those you touch and swap them in either piece by piece or as a whole. By using another state that is not injured, you can swap their states and heal them. By finding and swapping the states of a nude person with another that is clothed, you can clothe them. You can even swap positions with another possible state, allowing teleportation. You cannot use this to grant others powers. Your power doesn’t have to actually swap with an existent version, although you can. Rather, the power focuses on possible states, states such as location, health, etc that your power overlaps and swaps with your current state. Finally, you gain one power slot that you can individually swap out at will, such as a powerful aerokinetic power capable of offense or defense. The power can only be as powerful as a single power that a full-powered Eidolon could summon. You're also a precognitive blind spot to everyone but the Entity. If you pick Negentropy, you gain two additional power slots and can choose to have a power be held in more than one slot, each additional slot dramatically increasing its power.

addons.title: Ideal State
addons.description_html:
Your Ideal Transit power now works through your flickering. As a result, your flickering is far more efficient, able to pick states effectively instantly and instinctively without needing to specifically pick varying states.

This can allow you to immediately flicker the best ideal state of anything you affect, such as being able to heal, swap locations, alter the air around you to poison your enemy, swap equipment, all at the same time, without having to put any thought into it, your power picking the ideal state needed.

This also allows you to let your power choose the perfect power to slot, as well as multiple powers, or whether a power occupies multiple slots if applicable. This doesn’t mean you give up control to your power; you can still freely decide all this as normal, this just ensures you won’t ever actually need to.

The distinctions between Ignis Fatuus and Eidolon disappear, mutating the power further.

You now possess 7 slots for powers. You can also break down a normal slot for 4 weaker powers, and back, and can still choose to hold a power in more than one slot to exponentially increase its potency.

While you’ll be able to immediately call up a power at full strength, and hold it as long as you’d like without effort as before, your power will get continuously more and more powerful the longer it’s held. 

The number of slots you have is increased to 12 if Negentropic/Shardless, and a normal slot can be exchanged for 6 weaker powers.

addons.title: Pyrphoros
addons.description_html:
Your powers are far more potent now, able to summon powers three times as powerful as before with the same slots. 

Your powers also evolve far faster than before, and when you call upon an ability, it’ll allow you to immediately call anywhere from normal strength to the greatest heights you’ve reached with it, meaning you won’t have to wait for it to reach prior heights. 

You can also allow it to summon abilities of its own choosing now as well, its selection far more fluid and powerful, and often ready to meet any need before the need even arises. You can choose your own abilities still, but often won’t need to.

addons.text:
Your Ideal Transit power now works through your flickering. As a result, your flickering is far more efficient, able to pick states effectively instantly and instinctively without needing to specifically pick varying states.

This can allow you to immediately flicker the best ideal state of anything you affect, such as being able to heal, swap locations, alter the air around you to poison your enemy, swap equipment, all at the same time, without having to put any thought into it, your power picking the ideal state needed.

This also allows you to let your power choose the perfect power to slot, as well as multiple powers, or whether a power occupies multiple slots if applicable. This doesn’t mean you give up control to your power; you can still freely decide all this as normal, this just ensures you won’t ever actually need to.

raw_object_text_safe.text: You can “flicker”, allowing you to page through realities and possible states of yourself and those you touch and swap them in either piece by piece or as a whole. By using another state that is not injured, you can swap their states and heal them. By finding and swapping the states of a nude person with another that is clothed, you can clothe them. You can even swap positions with another possible state, allowing teleportation. You cannot use this to grant others powers. Your power doesn’t have to actually swap with an existent version, although you can. Rather, the power focuses on possible states, states such as location, health, etc that your power overlaps and swaps with your current state. Finally, you gain one power slot that you can individually swap out at will, such as a powerful aerokinetic power capable of offense or defense. The power can only be as powerful as a single power that a full-powered Eidolon could summon. You're also a precognitive blind spot to everyone but the Entity. If you pick Negentropy, you gain two additional power slots and can choose to have a power be held in more than one slot, each additional slot dramatically increasing its power.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Breaker/Trump) Ignis Fatuus

title: (Thinker/Breaker) For The Want Of A Nail
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to view alternate realities by posing “What If?” questions, allowing you to view a vast range of possibilities. From something as simple as you have made a different choice to something entirely unrelated to yourself. This can range from questions such as “What if I hadn’t gone out yesterday?”, “What if I had Triggered with Alexandria’s powers?”, “What if science had a massive breakthrough that skyrocketed technological advancements 1000 years prior?”, and much more, those questions can include multiple deviations. You can view up to 10 separate realities at the same time.

Regardless of what differences there are, you’ll always view it through the senses of an alternate version of You, as well as possessing a fundamental understanding of how it came to be. You’ll be able to experience each reality with no more difficulty than you would just own.

Each reality and the beings within them have an identifier, a name that describes the deviation. By using that identifier you can ask a ‘What If’ question using Alternate Realities/Selves as a base.

The access to those realities is kept in a mental archive within your mind, allowing you to access them yet again if you switch from one reality to another and wish to go back. Asking the question that made that reality will make another variation for possibilities are endless.

You can pick one alternate version of yourself that you are viewing and can overlay that version of You onto yourself, gaining access to any deviations they have. This will allow you to utilize any abilities those alternates of you possess, as well as any equipment they have. When transformed your true body will slowly shift to match that of your alternate you, this can be both detrimental as well as beneficial. This shift is incredibly gradual and will entirely reverse if the change is held for less than a day.

addons.title: The Dagda
addons.description_html:
When you turn into an Alternate Self you automatically copy their powers and can choose to steal them. You can also do the reverse, give them a power you have taken/copied.

Oberon and Manager fuse into one inheriting each other strengths and covering their weakness. You can store an infinite amount of powers and use 10 (14 with Negentropy) of them simultaneously, compatible powers synergize and amplify each other and can occupy the same slot.

A power will temporarily become stronger the more versions of it you can use. As an example, the same power through Overlay, Copy, and Taken triples all of its aspects.

addons.title: Skill Up
addons.description_html:
Any skills you have through an Alternate Self is elevated to the highest possible level. Using a Skill from an Alternate Self together with the same Skill from Polymath elevates it beyond the limit, becoming a power, the elevation of a high enough skill from an Alternate Self will not need a duplicate skill for it to become a power. You could cut titanium with a stick through Swordsmanship, shoot bullets that never miss with Marksmanship, or create superpowered medicine through Apothecary. The strength of those powers scales with any power boosters you have without you even needing to use the power booster. Those powers are affected by Oberon/Manager the same way any other power is, you can't steal them with Manager but you can still copy them.

You can slot Thinker and Tinker powers from your Alternate Selves into a Polymath slot.

Any Thinker and Tinker powers you have that didn't come from Skill Up will have all their aspects doubled.

addons.title: Unusual Dimensional Hopping
addons.description_html:
You can use Amalgam to fuse with up to 10 Alternate Selves. This fusion works the exact same as Amalgam with the exception that your mind is the only dominant one, you can anytime choose for it to go back to an equal combination of minds.

You can control how many traits the fusion displays. You could have the appearance of one, the clothes of another, and weapons of yet another one.

When fusing you can choose whether it's your body combining with an Alternate Self or the body of an Alternate Self combining with yours. When you unfuse you can choose the destination of each member of the fusion, you can go to an Alternate Reality of one of the selves you were combined with or go to a reality you have been in the past.

The limit to how many Selves you can fuse with slowly increases.

addons.title: Conclusion One
addons.description_html: You experience all possibilities, what was/is/will/could be, the possible and impossible. You see everything simultaneously in milliseconds, every second of the past/present/future, every second of what will and never will be. This will have no negative effects on your Self. You know how likely and unlikely each possibility is to occur and why, giving you the capacity to know the most likely future. Omniscient and Vision fuse into one, you no longer have any blindspots and no knowledge can harm you. Your Selves from visions are valid targets for your Overlay (or Flickering if you have Endless Reflections) If you have Endless Reflections, your flickering will act before something happens; someone shot you? Nothing happened, because you already were out of the way before they pressed the trigger.

addons.title: Paint the World
addons.description_html:
You can completely change your reality using the realities from your Alternate Selves as a base, you can completely change everything to make a total copy of their reality or change only parts.

You do not have to be watching an Alternate Self for the changes you made in your reality to persist, the changes are permanent but you can anytime revert them.

When you make changes that you are in the middle of, like when you completely copy an Alternate Reality, you can opt to change your body to be a copy of the Alternate Self that resides in that Alternate Reality making your original form and your Alternate one and the same. This can be undone anytime.

You still have total control over Reality within 250 meters. The less you move the greater this range becomes, shrinking every time you move, the less lucid you are the faster it grows. Moving will not decrease your base 250-meter range, only the additional range. Breathing or moving your arms is fine, walking or flying is not.

You can see more than 10 realities simultaneously. The more you exceed 10 realities the less you are aware of your own body and your surroundings.

title: (Brute/Mover) Alexandria
description_html:
You are nearly invulnerable. No effect or force can negatively affect you physically except for Sting or the Siberian. This extends even to the functions of your own body, meaning that you never tire, require no sustenance (air included), and even negative mental effects are limited to the point that you don't have to worry about stress doing permanent mental harm, as most of your mental faculties are off-loaded to your Shard. Even sleep is just for pleasure or relaxation rather than a need to refresh yourself.

You have incredible amounts of strength and can fly and move at supersonic speeds, with perfect maneuverability and reaction time to match. Your mind is enhanced just like your body, skyrocketing your mental capabilities to superhuman levels, with absolutely perfect memory retention and recall.

The field that pervades your body providing these abilities also extends itself to things you are touching, letting you ignore the effects of physics when you apply your strength and speed. You have more leverage than should be possible when you grab something, exert immense force with minor motions, large objects don't collapse under their weight, and catching or carrying people at extreme speeds won't harm them. You are an unstoppable force and an immovable object.

You have more leverage than should be possible when you grab something, exert immense force with minor motions, large objects don't collapse under their weight, and catching or carrying people at extreme speeds won't harm them. You are an unstoppable force and an immovable object.

addons.title: Ereshkigal
addons.description_html:
When 'claiming' parahumans, your shard now takes over the entirety of the associated shard network and transfers it to your dimension instead of just a select sub-network. This means that, instead of only acquiring a specific parahuman and their direct shards, you can access their entire shard network. As such, you can generate shades of other hosts, even if they died years ago or are still living, by using the mental 'imprints' of hosts from the shard network. These shards can be accessed directly in your dimension and you can exchange energy between them to boost specific shades or recharge them.

The shades of parahumans you produce by using their shard 'imprints' no longer fade over time, rather they retain all of their abilities, memories and intelligence as they were in life and are completely loyal to you. Your shades also no longer have any range limitations and you retain constant awareness of them, enabling you to mentally command them at any distance. You have a greatly increased number of shades that you can have active at full power at once, up to 9 total, and Negentropy will increase your maximum limit of shades by 1 every month.

Your power sight is also far clearer, allowing you to perfectly comprehend the inner mechanisms of parahuman's shards, their history and their powers. A word of warning; claiming highly important shards will draw the attention of the Entity if they're part of its network.

addons.title: Paramount Shades
addons.description_html: Your shades can now use Paramount. When you summon a shade, you may give it any power you could access through Paramount, on top of whatever power that shade may possess. Each shade has its own separate Paramount budget. Shades do not have the build up time that Paramount typically has, able to swap abilities on a moments notice. This also gives you access to Blank Shades, these are shadowy non-descript shades granted a power you can access through Paramount. They are not claimed from dead parahumans and do not come with a pre-existing identity or original powers. If you possess Negentropy or are Shardless, you gain the ability to shape your Blank Shades into any appearance you prefer. If you possess Elfame, any power you claim is automatically liquidated into Paramount. Instead of remaining only as a shade’s original power, its SP value is permanently added to your Paramount budget. This increase applies to every Paramount budget you control, including each shade’s separate budget. The liquidated power is also added to your Paramount inventory, allowing you and your shades to call upon it through Paramount normally. Because the claimed power has been liquidated, the shade it came from no longer has to keep that power as its inherent ability, allowing you to reshape or rewrite that shade’s basic ability at will. Any upgrades or fusions utilizing Paramount are also carried over.

title: (Trump/Master) Butcher
description_html: You have an altered version of the Butcher's power. When you die, you reincarnate into either the last person to attack you or the one who killed you (your choice). You retain all your original powers at 100%, as well as those of your most recent incarnation, but all powers of those in between are half as strong. All the minds of the people who have killed you are in a mental room with you and can communicate with you. You control the room but cannot mute or remove any of the people there, but you can put them to sleep (which would, effectively, mute them unless they snore). You control who is in charge of the body. You can access any of the memories of people in your mental room and give them to others in the room, including yourself.

addons.title: Butchered Rebirth
addons.description_html: At any time, you can choose whether you possess someone new if you die or if Rebirth will activate and resurrect you in a copy of your current body. If you choose for Rebirth to activate, your powers will remain unaltered, letting you keep your current body’s power at full strength; however, this still relies on having Rebirth charges when you die, otherwise Butcher will activate as normal. You can also, at any time, spend Rebirth charges to resurrect and free a person from your collective. Anyone you resurrect in this manner will be completely removed from your collective, resurrected in a copy of their body as it was when you first possessed them. If you resurrect anyone with this addon, both you and that person will retain access to their power, though they’ll have it at full power while your version will still be subject to the Butcher Shard’s mechanics. If you resurrect someone while still possessing their original body, you’ll still keep that body; they’ll just get a copy. If a person you resurrect with this addon later becomes the target for your Butcher power again, you won’t gain a second copy of their power. Although, like always, while in their body, you’ll have access to the full strength of that power.

title: (Blaster/Mover) Legend
description_html:
Your very being is entwined with energy on fundamental levels. You can fire blasts of light whose properties and effects are within your control. Forking or homing lasers, freeze beams, disintegrating spheres that orbit around you in a pattern, and even beam lasers that heal. All of these and more are within your capabilities. At its strongest, a single one of these can easily destroy a skyscraper. You can fire a dozen blasts at once and coordinating such barrages is trivial for you.

You are also able to fly, reaching the speed of light in an instant. Your mind will automatically compensate for relativistic time dilation by slowing down or speeding up.

You can switch back and forth between a Breaker state that removes all physical needs and quickly restores you to perfect physical condition. In this state, most attacks are simply absorbed, with only the strongest able to put you down before the damage is gone. Your vision is perfect, as it encompasses the entire electromagnetic spectrum, and no longer degrades with distance.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Kingmaker
description_html:
Kingmaker grants you the power of the ultimate wise old mentor archetype. With this Thinker ability, you can choose up to five parahumans to take in as students and intuitively understand their strengths, weaknesses, and optimal training methods. Through your guidance, even the most naive and unremarkable individuals with weak powers can be transformed into once-in-a-century geniuses, capable of achieving greatness and potentially challenging deities.

Your wisdom shapes their intellect and skills, empowering them to become heroes on the path of greatness. As the Kingmaker, you wield the ability to unlock and enhance the powers granted by shards, turning even the weakest powers into formidable forces capable of leaving an indelible mark on the world.

title: (Shaker/Trump) Genius Friends
description_html:
You have a shaker effect of approximately 10 meters that increases the natural intellect, ability to learn and process information of people in your range to equal 0.0001% of all of humanity. To visualise this, take every human alive, calculate their total mental capablities combined, and get exactly 0.0001% of it. That 0.0001% is the amount of brainpower those under the effect of your power gets. This allows you to teach and educate many people into becoming not just competent but pure geniuses unrivalled in their respective fields. 
 
The effect would naturally wear off once they leave your range; however, the skills and knowledge gained while under its effects will remain.

title: (Thinker) Precognition
description_html:
You have gained the ability to peer into the future, providing perfect knowledge of events that will transpire up to 100 days ahead from the viewpoint of your future self, this precognition has no blind spots. Within this temporal scope, you can perceive a single absolute future, a path that is predetermined to unfold unless you take action to alter it. This power bestows upon you the advantage of foreknowledge, enabling you to prepare, adapt, and potentially change the course of events.

However, wielding this formidable gift comes with two significant drawbacks. The first limitation is that your precognition ability can only be updated once a week. Once you intervene to alter the foreseen future, the knowledge of the consequences will not be revealed to you until the next update. Until then, you must navigate the altered timeline with uncertainty, eagerly awaiting the moment when your power will refresh and reveal the ramifications of your choices.

Upon every update of the future, you instantaneously experience all the emotions and sensations you would have encountered during the original 100-day timeframe. Though you will feel the pain, sadness, happiness, or other emotions that would have accompanied certain events, they are substantially muted. For instance, if you were destined to be stabbed in the original future, the pain you experience when actually stabbed is significantly reduced, dampened to a fraction of its actual intensity.

title: (Striker/Shaker) Bomber
description_html:
Through physical contact, you possess the ability to discreetly attach an imperceptible explosive device onto individuals and objects, That only you can see. The destructive potential of the device can be precisely calibrated, spanning from the potency of a conventional military hand grenade to that of the formidable GBU-43, colloquially known as the Mother of All Bombs (~11 tons TNT). At your discretion, you retain the capability to adjust the explosive yield at any given moment subsequent to attachment, as well as determine the desired time of detonation.

There is no limit to how many bombs you can attach at a time.

addons.title: Exotic Ordinance
addons.description_html: Your touch-applied devices are no longer restricted to conventional explosions, but can release any AoE-effect you can think of. You are able to freely adjust effective radius at will until the actual moment of detonation. The maximum range of your exotic explosions is two miles, the blast-radius of a MOAB. Though while you always have at least a rough idea of what the ultimate result of a detonation will be, sometimes the exact effect will be randomized. So while you know that anything caught in the blast will be completely destroyed, you may not know if that's because the blast will make everything it touches crumble to dust or because it creates a contained singularity that sucks it all into itself.

title: (Thinker) Polymath
description_html:
You have 7 slots (10 with negentropy) which can either be filled with a skill or a Thinker power.

When you slot in a skill, you can use it at the highest possible level. These skills include the mastery of a single style of martial arts, a field of medicine or science, cooking, juggling, and more. Anything that can be learned you can have. Skills that require a muscle memory provide it.

The Thinker powers you can have are limited to at most a rating of 5 on the PRT scale. Powers that operate on your senses and observations will tend to be more accurate than those that require external information (like precognition).

title: (Trump) Arcanist
description_html:
You have the ability to cast spells with a variety of magic that can reproduce the effect of non-Tinker powers. While your Shard provides you with a basic library of spells in each system and an intuitive knowledge of them, you will have to research and invent more powerful spells. Your spells will not be stronger than what Eidolon could do in his prime.

You have a pool of energy to cast spells, you have enough to cast your most powerful spells a dozen times in a short timespan. The pool takes 30 minutes to fully recharge. Permanent spells like summons, buffs, and auras reserve part of your reserve while they are active and release the energy when they are canceled or expire.

addons.title: Magik Meister
addons.description_html: Your Magik expands to new horizons. Cantrips can be cast without prior preparation at the cost of mana, proportional to their rank, if you have their formula memorized. The strength of your cantrips now scales based on Arcanist, with their highest rating equivalent to an 8 on the PRT scale. Cantrip sets transform into spell sets which allow you to prepare spells from any system and cast them without expending mana. Each spell set can accept 39 levels worth of spells, distributed however you want. Arcanist spells are assigned a level based on their strength. (Note: If you have upgrades, the value scales based on the highest number of total spell levels granted.) You also have the ability to prepare six focus spells which are automatically heightened any spell to the highest level you have discovered and successfully cast once across all systems. Focus spells have no mana cost and a fixed 2 second cooldown, regardless of level.

addons.title: Arcane Focuses
addons.description_html:
Your mastery of spellcasting and arcane constructs have fused into the creation of specialized Arcane Focuses. Now for every spell you possess or later develop, you gain access to a corresponding Arcane Focus Construct Scheme tailored to that spell and a narrow category of related effects.

Casting any spell through its specialized Arcane Focus significantly reduces its energy cost and moderately increases its power and stability. Simply holding any Arcane Focus, regardless of specialization, also triples your Arcanist energy regeneration rate, although this regeneration bonus does not stack with multiple Arcane Focuses.

Additional, you may freely draw arcane energy from either Armiger or Arcanist to fuel the other which has created a new ability. By deliberately destabilizing an Arcane Focus or other sustained construct, you may massively amplify a single spell cast through it. Doing so destroys the construct and permanently disperses its locked arcane energy, which then must be restored through Arcanist’s natural regeneration rather than instantly reclaimed.

title: (Trump/Brute) Martial Adept
description_html:
Your Shard grants you access to a basic library of supernatural combat disciplines: techniques, maneuvers, and invocations that channel energy through trained movement, weapon use, or sheer force of will. By executing these techniques, you can reproduce the effects of non-Tinker powers.

Some techniques enhance the user directly. These techniques reinforce the body, sharpen the senses, empower weapons, amplify strikes, or project attacks over great distances. Others manifest energy outward, allowing you to form barriers, unleash blasts, shape temporary constructs, manipulate the battlefield, or produce elemental, kinetic, and exotic effects.

You possess an intuitive understanding of the techniques granted to you, allowing you to perform them immediately. However, true mastery requires refinement and experimentation. With practice, you can modify existing techniques or develop entirely new ones, expanding the breadth and potency of your current disciplines.

At your peak, your overall power can rival that of Eidolon in his prime, though at the start, you are only at the level of a decently powerful street-tier cape.

You possess a reserve of energy that fuels your disciplines. Your reserve is sufficient to perform your most powerful techniques roughly a dozen times in quick succession, and fully replenishes after thirty minutes. Techniques that create lasting effects, such as sustained enhancements, constructs, or barriers, reserve a portion of this energy for as long as they remain active.

addons.title: Arcane Weaponmaster
addons.description_html: As a master of both arcane martial styles and summoning arcane implements, you may establish a flow between your disciplines and constructs that makes them become much more powerful in tandem than they would be individually. You may develop disciplines based on welding your arcane constructs as well as hone the powers of your constructs into new disciplines and techniques. You gain a library of schemes for use in conjunction with your disciplines that improve themselves as you hone them. You also gain an intuition for experimenting and training with your disciplines and schemes to find synergies. When you synergize construct abilities and disciplines simultaneously or in quick succession, you may trigger a combo and immediately perform another discipline or conjure another construct. Chaining these together will increase the power of subsequently executed disciplines and constructs. A properly executed and sustained combo could fell an Endbringer. You may choose to execute a power as the finishing move, which immediately releases all the built-up energy of the combo into that power’s effect before ending it. A power used without synergy has a chance to end the combo, as will failing to successfully use a power. Your combos will also instantly break if they overextend both your energy pool of arcane reserves, though one can sustain the other until the combo ends. Long-term effects triggered during a combo retain the benefits from it for up to an hour or six hours as a finishing move, or until the effect itself ends. With Arcane Focuses, you may cast spells or use a construct as a focus as part of your combos, which instead of building up power in the combo itself, extend your reserves for the length of it, allowing you to push the combo further. With Artificer<\i>, objects enchanted with patterns adapted from disciplines or arcane schemes can also be used in conjunction with and even become overcharged by combos.

You also gain an intuition for experimenting and training with your disciplines and schemes to find synergies. When you synergize construct abilities and disciplines simultaneously or in quick succession, you may trigger a combo and immediately perform another discipline or conjure another construct. Chaining these together will increase the power of subsequently executed disciplines and constructs. A properly executed and sustained combo could fell an Endbringer. You may choose to execute a power as the finishing move, which immediately releases all the built-up energy of the combo into that power’s effect before ending it. A power used without synergy has a chance to end the combo, as will failing to successfully use a power. Your combos will also instantly break if they overextend both your energy pool of arcane reserves, though one can sustain the other until the combo ends. Long-term effects triggered during a combo retain the benefits from it for up to an hour or six hours as a finishing move, or until the effect itself ends. With Arcane Focuses, you may cast spells or use a construct as a focus as part of your combos, which instead of building up power in the combo itself, extend your reserves for the length of it, allowing you to push the combo further. With Artificer<\i>, objects enchanted with patterns adapted from disciplines or arcane schemes can also be used in conjunction with and even become overcharged by combos.
addons.title: Arcane Weaponmaster

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Your Shard grants you access to a basic library of supernatural combat disciplines: techniques, maneuvers, and invocations that channel energy through trained movement, weapon use, or sheer force of will. By executing these techniques, you can reproduce the effects of non-Tinker powers.

Some techniques enhance the user directly. These techniques reinforce the body, sharpen the senses, empower weapons, amplify strikes, or project attacks over great distances. Others manifest energy outward, allowing you to form barriers, unleash blasts, shape temporary constructs, manipulate the battlefield, or produce elemental, kinetic, and exotic effects.

You possess an intuitive understanding of the techniques granted to you, allowing you to perform them immediately. However, true mastery requires refinement and experimentation. With practice, you can modify existing techniques or develop entirely new ones, expanding the breadth and potency of your current disciplines.

At your peak, your overall power can rival that of Eidolon in his prime, though at the start, you are only at the level of a decently powerful street-tier cape.

You possess a reserve of energy that fuels your disciplines. Your reserve is sufficient to perform your most powerful techniques roughly a dozen times in quick succession, and fully replenishes after thirty minutes. Techniques that create lasting effects, such as sustained enhancements, constructs, or barriers, reserve a portion of this energy for as long as they remain active.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Trump/Brute) Martial Adept

title: (Trump/Tinker) Armiger
description_html:
You possess the ability to manifest temporary weapons, armor, and accessory constructs made from condensed arcane energy.  Each construct is shaped from an arcane scheme, a structured blueprint capable of reproducing the effects of non-Tinker powers, provided those effects are embodied in physical form.

You begin with a vast library of inefficient schemes spanning a wide range of power levels. While fully functional, these initial schemes consume excessive arcane energy due to structural waste and design inefficiencies. As you study and refine this library you will be able to create more efficient schemes, reducing their energy cost.

You also possess a fixed Arcane Reserve. Manifesting a construct locks a portion of this reserve for as long as the construct remains active. When dismissed, the allocated energy is immediately returned. The more powerful or inefficient a construct’s scheme, the greater portion of your reserve that must be locked to sustain it. 

However, regardless of efficiency, no construct’s power can be greater than what Eidolon could summon in his prime. Otherwise, constructs have few limitations with no inherent range limit or attention required once manifested. 

In the beginning, you will be able to manifest simultaneously up to five constructs each worth 7 SP. With mastery and optimization, you may sustain a few dozen Tier 1 equivalent constructs at once.

addons.title: Orange Transparent Chainsaws
addons.description_html: Using the block logic of your grids, you may increase the efficiency and ease of construction of your Armiger schemes. By imagining and manifesting individual pieces of a scheme in the shape of blocks, you will gain a much more intuitive understanding of how arcane energy flows through them and how their effects manifest. This block based construction also makes the constructs more modular and reconfigurable, though they may not be reconstructed while manifested. You may also roll random restrictions that you may choose to apply to schemes that not only reduce the draw of your arcane reserves, but can provide boosts if successfully designed around. You may directly manifest your active grids as arcane constructs using both your grid energy and arcane reserves at a slightly more efficient rate for both. You can also transcribe grid patterns into schemes for use as arcane constructs when not in either an active or inactive grid, though they become more costly unless refined and improved. You gain new blocks that may be configured on a grid to provide additional effects or enhancement to a manifested arcane construct or to set an active grid to convert grid energy into additional arcane reserves instead of usable powers. With Build it Brick by Brick, you may prepay for power bricks with a portion of your arcane reserves which may be paid back with Artificer charges or grid energy. You may also transcribe arcane construct schemes into instruction manuals so that you can build them with enchanted bricks. Lastly, you can do the opposite and record brick constructs you have built as arcane schemes. Optionally, your arcane constructs can take a much blockier toyetic aesthetic.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Artificer
description_html:
You can enchant objects with non-Tinker powers by touching them, with a maximum of three enchantments on a single object. You can choose whether the object grants the wielder use of the power, or has a variant of the power itself. This power does not allow creating Variable Trump powers like Eidolon, picking from a fixed set is possible like Othala's power. At their highest, your enchantments will be on the same level as what Eidolon could do in his prime.

To enchant an object you need a pattern and enough charges to empower the object. Patterns can be researched by tasking your Shard to research a power, this usually takes 6-8 hours per power. You can have up to 3 (5 with negentropy) concurrent research. You gain 12 charges (18 with Negentropy) every day at midnight. Charges do not expire.

The strength of the power is proportional to the number of charges invested, with the minimum being 3 charges. The efficiency of charges drops by 20% recursively (100% - 80% - 64% - 51% - 40% - etc.) for every 36 charges invested into a single power up to a maximum of 216, reaching the level of Eidolon. It takes 30 seconds to empower an object regardless of the number of charges used.

addons.title: Administrator's Engineer
addons.description_html:
You can now place your charges and enchantments into (Trump) Manager’s slots, allowing you to use the abilities directly.

Likewise, by applying more charges to an ability, you can improve upon it, further refining it. This applies to both abilities derived from enchantments and abilities copied and stolen by others.

Powers replicate and/or stolen by (Trump) Manager now also have their pattern automatically recorded for replication by (Trump/Tinker) Artificer. Alongside this, you can now also place powers held inside manager into objects like you would with your enchantments.

addons.title: Arcane Foundry
addons.description_html:
Your mastery of construct schemes and enchantment patterns have fused into a unified arcane production system, granting you two new abilities. 

First, you may prepay enchantments on physical objects or constructs using your Arcane Reserve, temporarily locking a portion of that reserve in place of charges. You may later invest Artificer charges to repay this cost and reclaim the locked reserve, effectively treating your reserve as a loan. Once fully repaid, the construct stabilizes into a permanent enchanted object no longer sustained by your Arcane Reserve.

Second, you may record Improved Arcane Schemes within your Armiger library. These schemes may incorporate up to three Artificer enchantments in addition to their native Armiger effect while only requiring Arcane Reserve equivalent to the scheme’s base ability. Improved Schemes are unique and cannot be manifested more than once, functioning instead as singular items stored within your Armiger library, effectively transforming it into a pocket inventory for enchanted equipment.

Furthermore, if you delete an Improved Scheme from your Armiger library, you recover 75% of all charges invested into its enchantments but at the cost of permanently destroying the item in the process.

addons.description_html:
You no longer need to rely solely on your Shard to research patterns. You have the ability to study and understand existing patterns, derive new ones, and include elements from your spells, techniques, and invocations; your Shard will validate the patterns for problems and point out errors if there are any.

Objects can be enchanted using the energy from your pool instead of charges, you can also spend charges to reduce the energy cost and vice-versa.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Alchemist
description_html:
You can create potions from formulas that will have power-like effects when consumed and the ability to create transmutation circles to change materials into others.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to develop new formulas. Natural ingredients as well as brewing equipment are required to create the potions. Consuming too many potions in a short amount of time creates Toxicity and can have adverse health effects on the user. The effect of your potions will fade once it's purged from the drinker's blood. Those potions are limited to powers that can be expressed physically such as regeneration, super strength, enhanced senses, invisibility, etc. At their most powerful they will be as strong as a mid-tier cape.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to create transmutation circles. To perform a transmutation, you need to inscribe the circle on a surface and place the required ingredients inside then touch the circle to activate it. You cannot create materials with power-like properties unless you can study them, this applies to Tinker materials (like alloys). You are not limited in size however the objects must fit within the transmutation circle, at big enough sizes this means taking into account the Earth's curvature. The time to transmute is proportional to the volume.

addons.title: Enchanting Alchemy
addons.description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to enchant your ingredients, equipment, and/or potions to greatly empower what you can create. The more enchantments, the greater the effects.

You may also expend charges to bypass the traditional requirements for brewing potions. A single charge can remove the need for a transmutation circle, automatically transmuting the required ingredients. Two can be used to create the potions immediately upon having all the necessary ingredients.

Conversely, your Alchemy can also augment your Artifice. You can create highly toxic potions that temporarily accelerate your charge generation, transmute metamaterials that are highly receptive to enchantments, and brew alchemical solvents to dissolve enchanted items and reclaim a portion of invested charges.

Finally, potions are no longer limited solely to physically expressed powers.

addons.title: Toxic Love
addons.description_html:
Your mastery of alchemical brews allows you and others to better handle the buildup of Toxicity from potion consumption. When consuming potions of weaker potency, the body absorbs them with minimal to no Toxicity buildup, enabling frequent use without consequence. However, higher-potency potions still create Toxicity at the normal rate. This refined control allows you to experiment and blend weaker potions without risking rapid Toxicity buildup, even during extended use.

Additionally, you can now create special Detoxifying Elixirs that can actively purge Toxicity from your system when ingested. When used in moderation, they effectively reduce Toxicity buildup, allowing for a reset to potion use. However, over-reliance on these elixirs may cause the body to destabilize, rapidly increasing Toxicity instead, potentially pushing the drinker into dangerous levels without warning.

addons.title: Enchanting Alchemy

addons.text:
Your mastery of alchemical brews allows you and others to better handle the buildup of Toxicity from potion consumption. When consuming potions of weaker potency, the body absorbs them with minimal to no Toxicity buildup, enabling frequent use without consequence. However, higher-potency potions still create Toxicity at the normal rate. This refined control allows you to experiment and blend weaker potions without risking rapid Toxicity buildup, even during extended use.

Additionally, you can now create special Detoxifying Elixirs that can actively purge Toxicity from your system when ingested. When used in moderation, they effectively reduce Toxicity buildup, allowing for a reset to potion use. However, over-reliance on these elixirs may cause the body to destabilize, rapidly increasing Toxicity instead, potentially pushing the drinker into dangerous levels without warning.
addons.title: Toxic Love

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You can create potions from formulas that will have power-like effects when consumed and the ability to create transmutation circles to change materials into others.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to develop new formulas. Natural ingredients as well as brewing equipment are required to create the potions. Consuming too many potions in a short amount of time creates Toxicity and can have adverse health effects on the user. The effect of your potions will fade once it's purged from the drinker's blood. Those potions are limited to powers that can be expressed physically such as regeneration, super strength, enhanced senses, invisibility, etc. At their most powerful they will be as strong as a mid-tier cape.

You have intuitive knowledge of how to create transmutation circles. To perform a transmutation, you need to inscribe the circle on a surface and place the required ingredients inside then touch the circle to activate it. You cannot create materials with power-like properties unless you can study them, this applies to Tinker materials (like alloys). You are not limited in size however the objects must fit within the transmutation circle, at big enough sizes this means taking into account the Earth's curvature. The time to transmute is proportional to the volume.

title: (Trump/Master) Magical Menagerie
description_html:
You can summon fantastical creatures, beasts and beings of your own design, customising their appearance and bestowing them with non-Tinker powers of your choice.

Your creations can take a myriad of forms, whether a serpent that turns into living lightning, a fox cloaked in illusions or a cyclops with a high Brute rating. Each day you receive 1 Charge. By spending 2 Charges, you can manifest a new, very weak creature with abilities equivalent to 1 SP in combined strength, or, alternatively, you can invest Charges to empower an existing creature. Your Charges stockpile and do not expire.

A creature's overall potency scales with the total Charges invested in it, increasing by approximately 1 SP for every 2 Charges spent. As such, they would reach 2 SP after 4 Charges, 3 SP after 6 Charges and so on, until capping off at 15 SP with 30 Charges. For example, an avian beast that might initially only levitate could, through further investment, progress until they can fly at hypersonic speeds.

Their baseline physiology consists of crystalline-like flesh which is as durable as steel and they can range in size from as small as a cat up to as large as a pony. You are aware of all your creatures and may mentally communicate with them to issue directives. They are intelligent, loyal to fault and can act autonomously per your will.

You can summon your creations within your local vicinity as well as de-summon them at any time. They naturally regenerate, healing from major wounds in under a week, but can be destroyed if damaged enough. Your creatures cannot possess fully variable Trump powers, like Eidolon, but more limited versions, akin to Othala, are feasible.

title: (Trump/Changer) Wildshape
description_html: You can shapeshift into various forms, fantastical creatures of your own design, each with their own set of powers — a black panther able to meld with shadows, a massive hawk that rides on air currents at the speed of sound, a owlbear that calls on the power of nature; your imagination, and the number of charges at your disposal, are the only limits. Each day you gain 6 charges (or 9 with Negentropy); they can be spent to design a new form or to improve an existing one. It takes 3 charges to create a new simple form, based on an existing animal of medium size (ex: wolf); each size increment beyond this requires three more charges. You can also spend charges to alter the form with more exotic traits, such as hardened scales and a prehensile bladed tail for your panther form; the number of charges this takes depends on how complex the changes are and how far they deviate from the base template; purely cosmetic changes, such as an exotic fur color or patterns, cost a single charge. Your other powers still work while transformed. On top of this, you can use charges to grant your forms non-Tinker powers. Each form can have a maximum of three distinct powers, and their potency scales with the total number of charges invested. It takes 3 charges to create a power with a PRT rating of 1, with each level costing an additional number of charges equal to that level times tree; for example, a pattern with a rating of 3 costs 18 charges, and the maximum rating of 8 costs 108 charges. You cannot possess fully variable Trump powers, like Eidolon, but more limited versions, akin to Othala, are feasible. Instead of dedicated powers, you can also use part of your power capacity to alter your other powers, such as boosting the effects of Arcanist while in your moonkin form; the number of charges scales the same way as powers, in increments of 20% up to 200%. You can create as many templates as you want but only 3 can be active at once. It takes 5 minutes to switch active templates, during which both templates are unavailable. You can spend 30 charges to increase the number of active templates, up to a maximum of 9. If your Shard runs out of energy while you are transformed, you will be stuck in whichever form you were in at the time.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Cartomancy
description_html:
You have the ability to create Cards of Power that grant a variety of effects for the user. However, your Cards cannot produce effects stronger than what Eidolon could have achieved in his prime.

You gain 6 charges (9 with Negentropy) every 24 hours. It only takes a single charge to create a Card with a PRT rating of 1. You can upgrade a Card to a higher rating, with each level costing a number of charges equal to that level. For example, a Card with a PRT 2 rating costs 3 charges total, while a PRT 10 rating costs 55 charges.

There are two types of Cards you can create: Spell Cards, which apply effects to you or the environment, and Summon Cards, which manifest objects or beings of various forms to aid you.

Spell Cards can invoke any singular effect you can imagine, such as manipulating elements, granting flight, or healing. The only restriction is that they cannot generate new powers themselves.

Summon Cards can create objects or beings of your design. They can generate multiple instances if appropriate—such as a swarm of Bees. Each object or summon has three slots (five with Negentropy) for pre-loading powers via Spell Cards.

Your Deck can hold up to 40 Cards (60 with Negentropy), serving as a reserve from which you draw new Cards. Additionally, you have three slots (five with Negentropy) for activating Spell Cards and three slots (five with Negentropy) for Summon Cards.

When in use, the Cards hover in mid-air before you, glowing with a golden light. They are constructs formed by your power and are immune to all conventional attacks, though all-or-nothing attacks can damage or destroy them.

At the start of combat, you can “draw” your hand of five Cards (seven with Negentropy), and you can draw a new Card every few minutes to replenish your hand.
