addons.title: Reciprocal Research
addons.description_html:
You may now use your ability to research power Patterns with Artificer to reduce the creation cost of Summon Cards and Spell Cards that share similar abilities.

When creating a new card, you may designate up to three related power Patterns to influence its design. The first related Pattern reduces the card’s creation cost by a 1/4th, the second reduces it by 1/3rd, and the third reduces it by 1/2 of the original cost. Only Patterns that are meaningfully related to the intended card will provide benefits with those that are too conceptually distant having no effect.

Furthermore, this relationship is reciprocal. When enchanting an object using a power Pattern, you may designate up to three related cards you possess to reduce the enchantment cost using the same ratios listed above. When creating a card or power Patten you will instinctively understand what kind of enchantments and cards they can be used to create in the future.

Finally, your charge economies are now fully interoperable. Charges generated by Artificer and Cartomancy may be freely spent as though they belonged to either system.

addons.title: Fusion Cards
addons.description_html:
You can now fuse Cards together. 

These Fusion Cards can be created by combining multiple cards to create a single, more powerful composite card, provided the contributing cards follow a coherent thematic or mechanical logic. 

For example, fusing a Young Dragon Summon Card with a Fireball Spell Card could produce an Elder Fire-Breathing Dragon Summon Card, while combining a Fireball Spell with a Wind Bind Spell might yield a Fire Tornado Spell Card.

To perform a fusion, you simply select two or more cards outside of battle and expend charges. The chosen cards are then consumed, and a newly created Fusion Card is immediately generated.

The charge cost for this fusion scales with the number of cards fused, the complexity of the resulting effect, and how far the fusion deviates from the original components.

addons.title: "Its not Cheating, its the Heart of the Cards!"
addons.description_html:
Your arcane power has harmonized with your Cartomancy system, allowing you to subtly influence the fate of your draws. By expending arcane energy, you may generate Destiny, a temporary fleeting resource used to manipulate probability.

When drawing a Card, you may spend Destiny to bias the probability toward a specific Card currently in your Deck. The more Destiny invested, the greater the likelihood the desired Card is drawn with minor investments slightly tilting probability, and substantial amounts making the desired Card overwhelmingly more likely. 

Furthermore, if you refrain from manipulating your draws for a significant period of time, you begin passively accumulating small amounts of Destiny, even if your arcane energy is depleted.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Grimoire of Shards
description_html:
This power manifests as a large book (20x30cm) which has a thick cover decorated with strange yet mesmerizing patterns. The book generates 6 charges (9 with Negentropy) every 24 hours; they can be spent to create new power patterns and record them inside of the book. 

It takes one charge to create a power with a PRT rating of 1, with each level costing an additional number of charges equal to that level; for example, a pattern with a rating of 3 costs 6 charges, and one with a rating of 10 costs 55. The rating of the power is fixed at creation time and cannot be changed after the fact.

A pattern takes 3 pages for a power with a rating of 1, and one additional page for each level, up to 12; in total, the book has 250 pages, 150 of which can be used to write powers, while the rest is reserved for components. You can only create a pattern if the book has a enough blank pages in a row. You can erase a power from the book but not move them.

Patterns are split into rectangular regions made up of two types of components: dense sequences of square characters, and complex circuit-like diagrams. You only have a basic understanding of this system. You can copy blocks into the back 100 pages of the book and re-use them to modify existing powers, or to reduce the cost of creating new powers, the blocks are not consumed in the process.

Every power with a rating above 1 has its pattern scrambled beyond the first three pages. As you use the power, the pages will clear up and the power will become stronger; the time depends on the final strength, a few hours for weak powers and up to eight weeks for the strongest. Powers also drain energy a battery inside of the book, which takes 30 minutes to fully recharge; depending on the type powers, such as ongoing effects, they can also siphon off part of the regeneration or reserve part of the pool.

The book can hover around you within arm's reach, its position is locked relative to you, and can be mentally directed. You can stash the book away into a pocket dimension but lose the ability to use the powers stored within.

Finally, you can spend charges to upgrade some aspects of the book: 5 charges to add 10 more pages to either section or 5 charges to increase the size of the battery or recharge rate in 10% increments, up to 100%. You can only spent 60 charges in total for upgrades, this information is shown inside the back cover, and can spend 10 charges to reset them. You can also create more books, 30 charges for the first, 60 for the second, 90 for the third, and so on; the books share charges but each has its own battery and upgrades; each book also increases the number of charges generated by 2 every cycle up to 12.

title: (Master/Trump) Doll Master
description_html:
You can summon and control dolls. You can create an arbitrary amount of dolls but only have up to 10 active dolls at once. You can see, hear, and feel (but not smell and taste) through your dolls. Your maximum control range is 1000 meters, if a doll goes outside that range it will deactivate. Your capacity to multitask matches the amount of dolls you have active. You cannot summon your dolls further than at arm's length (~60cm or 2ft).

By default the dolls you create have the same strength, speed, and resistance as your own body but no other powers. When created they will not have any clothes. The size of your dolls can range from 10cm to 80cm and must have a human form.

title: (Trump) Replicator
description_html:
You have the ability to copy extremely weakened versions of  the powers of Parahumans and three slots to use those powers with. To copy a Parahuman's power you must get within a meter of them. If you copy the power of an Endbringer or Entity, you get every single power they have separately, instead of just one power.

You can switch what power is in your slots at will. Every day you get a charge (two with Negentropy) you can use to increase the strength of a power, though you can save these charges as well. Once a power reaches the same strength as the original, you can no longer dump charges into it.

On average it takes 7 charges to fully charge a weak power, 14 charges to fully upgrade a mid-level power, 21 charges to fully upgrade a high-level power, and 28 charges to fully upgrade an extremely powerful power.

You can also use those charges to increase how many slots you have, to a maximum of five. It takes 30 charges to fully increase the number of slots you have, though before you fully gain a new slot you can place an even weaker version of a power in that slot. For example, if you have a slot that has 15 charges put into it, the power is half as powerful as it would be if it were in a full slot. You can increase the number of daily charges by investing 60 and 90 charges, up to a maximum of 3 (or 5 with Negentropy).

Your powers, even when strengthened to their max, will never be the same as the original Parahuman's power. Instead, they will be a side-grade, a power that could have come from the Parahuman's Shard, but didn't. You can spend 3 charges to reroll the power expression.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Omni-Kinesis
description_html:
In a radius of 50 meters around you, with nothing but your will alone, you are capable of shaping the physical world. Moving objects, generating and manipulating all forms of energy or matter, or even creating constructs of everything the physical world has to offer.

The world is a vast ocean of vibration, matter, and energy to your senses, and all it takes is a thought to send it moving according to your wishes. Complex systems such as biology and technology will require a great deal of practice before you can reliably work them the same way you would matter and energy, with other powers here being far better at doing so and developing faster.

title: (Master/Tinker) Peacebringer
description_html:
The counterpart to the vicious power of the Endbringer, you gain immense power in conflict resolution, gaining these abilities to help you resolve conflict.

You're enveloped in a passive aura around you, equal to half a mile radius, completely disabling a Shard's Conflict Drive. This has the effect of soothing emotions, canceling violent impulses, and inducing minor joy and euphoria in all those within your aura range.

You can cancel any powers actively being used for conflict within your line of sight. You gain a Thinker ability which lets you sense all violent emotions, thoughts, and actions within your aura range.

You also become a Free Tinker, with minor enhancements, however, you are given a massive boost in one area under a period of 6 hours after you witness active conflict that could be best stopped by that specialization, e.g., you see pyrokinetics fight, you get a massive bonus in cryogenics, heat absorption, and dispersion Tinkertech specialties.

You are not given incredible strength, only equal to a Brute 4, your speed equal to a Mover 8, while your durability and stamina get massive boosts, giving you enough to go at your best for at least 3 days straight and your durability is strong enough to easily tank Endbringer attacks and at least 10 full-power Entity attacks.

title: (Thinker/Trump) [Query] [Response]
description_html:
You gain the conscious ability to reach out and speak to other Shards, allowing you to have reciprocal understanding and transmission between you and Shards.

You can use this to request [Data] packet transfers between your Shard and themselves and gather environmental or personal information they might have access to, such as [Host-Data] and [Power/Expression-Data.Ping] enabling your Shard to replicate their powers or implement it on either of your current powers. This relies on your ability to get the Shard to agree with your request and comply with their demands or trade.

You gain an awareness of a Shard's current [Power/Expression] and [Designation/Function] within 30ft of its user and a burst of information pertaining to their rank, function, and potential power within the Entity network when you connect with them for the first time. This power also assures that the Shards you interact with will not report back on your abilities, interactions, or plans (with Shards unable to sense your Negentropy unless you bring it up).

title: (Master/Trump) Logic Virus
description_html:
Your body emits an undetectable virus within a small range of 5ft around you. You can choose which people are actively infected with a thought, as everyone touched by the aura their infection lays dormant.

The actively infected limit is 200 and Shard users take up more than one slot depending on ability, Eidolon, for example, takes 100 while Alexandria takes 35.

Endbringer's cores are the only part that can be infected with this power, the range still applies but it must be concerning the core. An active Infected Endbringer costs 120 (you'll need some help for this one, for sure).

The infected will begin to act differently from their normal selves, becoming more powerful ability-wise as well, they will also begin to hate what you tell them to and think about things as you do. These changes are not instant but slow-going, taking about a week.

While you can change an Active Infected back to a Dormant Infected, this will take only 30 seconds and will remember everything they did during their active time. They will almost certainly assume you Mastered them if you ever gave them direct commands but will assume nothing other than the fact that they were acting strange if all you did was a subtle influence.

After activation, they will be incredibly loyal to you and never question why, they will hang on to your every word and command even dying for you. When not near you they will act on your mental commands, or in your best interests (with Entities being immune).

description_html: You can give yourself any one of the Tier 1 powers in this CYOA. The power takes a couple of minutes to build up strength, although it's still usable before reaching full strength. Possessing Negentropy or being Shardless removes the need to access from an existing list, instead allowing you to summon any power you can think of that is equal to a T1 power. You also gain a secondary thinker power that is a catalogue of the current list of T1 powers, which now includes all powers from Power Copy, as well as all Upgrades and Fusions that don't exceed 15 SP, and allows you to instantly and intuitively choose from it. It will continue to expand as you summon new powers.

title: (Trump) Randomizer
description_html: Every day you get to roll for 3 random powers. However, these powers are completely random, last for a random amount of time, and how powerful these abilities are is also completely random (never higher than a 9). After a power disappears, you can roll for another power. There is a 1 in 100 chance that a random power is permanent and will not disappear. This chance is not affected by luck powers. When you get a permanent power, you gain another slot to roll powers in so that you are always able to roll for 3 powers. The powers may be inconvenient to you, such as an aura that causes everyone within to have bad luck, including you.

description_html:

title: (Trump/Thinker) Who Do You Think I Am?
description_html:
You will have the powers, skills, and abilities people of a certain collective think you have. For instance, if you choose the PRT you will have all the abilities, powers, and skills that they think you possess. The more people in a collective the more stable this power is. And over a certain amount, the powers gained are much stronger than what anyone thinks. If the majority of the global population thinks you have something, you possess that power permanently. However, you cannot become strong enough to destroy the planet. But if they think you can move the stars, you'll be able to gain a power that lets it seem like you can.

You can swap between which collective you are currently gaining powers from, but it takes a couple of minutes. The more a collective disagrees with what you possess, the more unreliable and weaker it is.

Your consciousness is maintained even in death, allowing you to resurrect yourself.

description_html:

The world becomes your canvas as you create towering manufacturing complexes, interconnected networks of production facilities, and vast supply chains spanning entire continents. Your mastery of mega factory technology propels you to the forefront of innovation and economic prosperity, forever shaping the destiny of civilizations.

title: (Master/Tinker) Master of Green
description_html:
You possess the power to manipulate plants in countless ways, shaping them to meet your every need or desire. 

This power gives you an unlimited capacity to multitask and complete mental awareness over all plants within a 1 km radius of yourself. You can control plants within this radius but it is limited to those you have directly interacted with; for example, planting, watering, tinkering or physical contact. Through this, you can make any plants under your control grow, move and act as you desire.

You can massively accelerate the growth of any plants under your control, enabling them to develop within days rather than months or years. You are capable of enhancing their strength and durability to be equal to the toughest natural woods and can increase their size significantly beyond what's normally possible. You can freely modify their shape if you have enough plant material to work with and adjust the characteristics of the plants under your control to possess particular properties. This encompasses natural properties that plant species have, such as toxin production, fire-resistant bark etc, but can also include the properties of plants that you subsequently create through the tinker aspect of this power.

Your tinker focus is broad and versatile, allowing you to tinker with any plant species you come across and beyond. You can vastly improve and expand upon the original properties of plants, such as augmenting their ability to photosynthesis, or also develop completely new properties in your plants such as secreting strong acids, generating bioelectricity or actively camouflaging. You can intermix different species of plants together to form hybrids and create entirely new species to suit your purposes such as predatorial meat-eating trees, flowers with explosive seeds and much, much more. This power noticeably improves and synergises well with any other plant-based power.

title: (Shaker/Mover) Nyx
description_html:
You now have the ability to manipulate darkness and shadows with precision and control. Able to create, shape, and harness them for various purposes. While Darkness is mostly used to cloud everything into complete obscurity, it can also be harnessed as both the absence of light and a tangible substance. With it, you possess the capacity to manipulate entities existing within darkness, establish and dissolve shields and areas of absolute darkness, construct tools and weaponry sharp enough to rend through steel like a hot knife through butter, make shadowy servants that are able to go toe to toe with high-level brutes, teleport vast distances by traversing through shadows, your versatility with this power is bound only by the extent of your imagination. Your range extends within a radius of 200 meters around you. You also get unlimited multitasking with this.
It is worth noting that powers based on light are particularly potent against you. However, your ability to withstand and resist these light-based abilities increases in darker environments, allowing you to maintain a stronger defense against them.

title: (Trump/Striker) Fictiportation
description_html:
Imagine being able to pull out any object from your favourite stories, as long as it fits on a screen or a page. You can reach out and grab anything from fiction, whether it's a magic wand, a lightsaber, or a sonic screwdriver. The only catch is that the more powerful the item is, the more energy it drains from you. The more popular and widely known the item is on the other hand, the easier it is for you to access it. So you can't just grab some obscure artefact from a forgotten book and expect it to work. But you can use Harry Potter's invisibility cloak or Doctor Who's psychic paper with no problem. 

You start out being able to summon objects equivalent to a PRT Rating 5 in power if they're somewhat well-known. Over time this power will grow, particularly with practice and usage, allowing you to summon stronger and more obscure objects. The maximum power of an object you could theoretically acquire is limited to a PRT Rating 10.

title: (Changer/Brute) Carrion
description_html:
You have gained the ability to transform into a nightmarish creature of flesh and bones. Your body undergoes a terrifying metamorphosis, granting you a range of unique biological abilities and advantages, turning you into a grotesque amalgamation of writhing tendrils, razor-sharp teeth, and flexible appendages. Your very form is now highly malleable, granting you the ability to shapeshift into any form you can think of and allowing you to effortlessly navigate through cramped spaces and contort yourself to fit into tight crevices.

Your physical prowess is greatly enhanced, enabling you to shatter barriers and crush obstacles with your raw strength. Additionally, your regenerative capabilities become extraordinary, allowing you to heal and adapt rapidly from any wounds and instantaneously reattach severed body parts.

In this form, you possess an arsenal of biological attacks. Your tendrils can lash out, ensnaring and pulling enemies towards you, while your teeth can tear through flesh and bone effortlessly. Consuming the biomass of defeated foes replenishes your vitality and grants you knowledge of those you've devoured. The more biomass you possess the stronger you become. 

Your biological adaptations extend to your sensory capabilities as well. Your perception is heightened, allowing you to sense the biological composition of living creatures and analyze their vulnerabilities. This enhanced awareness grants you a form of weak precognition, enabling you to anticipate your opponent's moves to some extent.

title: (Changer/Master) The Flesh That Hungers
description_html:
You've gained the ability to generate a flesh seed from your own blood, which, when planted into the ground, triggers a macabre transformation of the surrounding land and living creatures.

At its initial stage, the flesh seed will sprout into small, grotesque plants that will begin to twist the other flora and fauna around it into biological abominations. These abominations exhibit a primal nature, driven by their insatiable hunger for flesh and their instinct to grow and adapt. As you progress and nourish your creations, they evolve and become increasingly formidable, growing larger, more complex, and more dangerous.

The twisted biome you cultivate possesses a symbiotic relationship with you. As the progenitor of this horrific ecosystem, you share a psychic link with the creatures and plants under your control, allowing you to exert influence over their actions and direct their growth. Through this connection, you gain an understanding of their needs and motivations, enhancing your ability to guide and command them.

As the twisted biome expands, it begins to exert an influence over the surrounding environment, gradually warping and distorting the land. This transformation grants you an increasingly advantageous position, as the corrupted environment supports the growth of even more formidable and monstrous beings.

title: (Shaker) Liminal Landscaper
description_html: You have 3 regenerating charges of power a day that can be invested into a [Liminal Threshold], which can be defined as the boundary between any two differentiated areas, investing a charge of power into the Liminal Threshold creates a separate layer of reality called the Liminal Landscape, that things cross into if they pass over the invested liminal threshold. This is a directional threshold, and connected thresholds can be used to implement other bits and pieces into the landscape. Each charge increases the size of the Landscape as well as the depth of your control over it. Your control over the liminal space is determined by the amount of charges you have, + whatever charges are invested in the landscape. You are able to change multiple properties of the landscape beside the topology, within the landscape you can summon or create tools/interfaces in order to allow you to change and manipulate any of the sensorial features of the Landscape Such as sound, lighting, smell, and various other cosmetic or aesthetic things. You cannot directly control around living things, but your speed of change is rapid outside that area.

title: (Striker/Shaker) Overhaul
description_html:
You have gained the incredible power to reconstruct the molecular structures of anything you touch with astounding precision. By making contact with an object or individual, you instantly comprehend their molecular arrangements, granting you the power to rearrange and alter them at will.

With this knowledge, you hold the ability to reconstruct your own body, granting you the power of pseudo-shape-shifting. Through precise manipulation of your molecular structure, you can adapt your physical form to suit various situations or assume different identities.
Initially, the range of your Overhaul power spans approximately 99 meters from your point of contact. However, as you grow in mastery and experience, both the potency and range of your abilities will expand over time. This gradual growth ensures that you can exert your influence over a broader area and manipulate molecules with increasing finesse.

In addition to these extraordinary capabilities, Overhaul grants you the option to disassemble, restore, or reshape any target you touch. Whether it is living or non-living, the choice rests in your hands.

title: (Thinker) Simulacrum Advisor
description_html:
You possess the ability to create flawless simulations of any individual from around the world within your mind. These simulations act as your personal teachers and advisors, dedicated to guiding and supporting you in your endeavors. Regardless of the person's identity, they willingly offer their knowledge and expertise, without any ulterior motives or intentions to harm or betray you.

Engaging with a simulated advisor allows you to benefit greatly from their wisdom and experience. While learning under their guidance, you experience twice the benefits, while requiring only half the effort. This advantage accelerates your learning and enables you to acquire any skill that your simulated advisor has mastered.

It is important to note that while the simulations can impart knowledge and skills, they cannot grant you powers or abilities that are beyond your inherent potential. You can only acquire abilities that align with your existing capabilities, and the range of expertise possessed by your simulated advisors.

You are capable of maintaining one simulation at a time, ensuring a focused and dedicated learning experience. Although you can create simulations of anyone, you can only change the individual being simulated once every three days. However, you have the freedom to drop the simulation at any time should you desire a change or feel the need to explore a different mentor.

title: (Tinker) Research And Development
description_html: You are an Omni-Tinker with access to every technology tree, however, your access is initially limited, but as you create Tinkertech, your access to these trees expands. Initially, your inventions closely resemble conventional technology. Yet, by crafting Tinkertech, you unlock greater access to every technology tree involved in its creation. Furthermore, studying Parahumans and other Tinkers' technology grants partial access to their respective trees. With extensive analysis, you can eventually gain full access to any capability possessed by those Tinkers, and even create Tinkertech that replicates or is based on any power you have sufficiently analyzed.

addons.title: Innovation
addons.description_html:
Your power serves a unique purpose beyond merely stress-testing the Entity scientific database from the ground up. It is tailored to detect anything overlooked by the Pair, deemed unreliable to test, or considered a dead end. Specifically, your ability is honed to challenge the scientific database against any new phenomena it encounters, including Out of Context anomalies or forbidden avenues like the spatial camouflage of Core Shards or the Virtual Space called the Firmament/Shard Space.

As a result, your only limitations lie in phenomenons you can only personally research for various reasons. You possess the capability to investigate phenomena such as Magic, Psionics, QI/CHI, or any Out of Context problems you encounter, even without possessing Esoteric Knowledge (Your research speed will accelerate tremendous if you have it though).

addons.title: Unity of Magic and Technology
addons.description_html:
Your shard was designed to bridge the gap between the mystical and the technological. Your spells, techniques, enchantments and schemes are no longer restricted from Tinker effects, and you may integrate your arcane abilities into your tinkertech.

You can create magical effects that encode or teach schematics or partial tech trees (full tech trees with Archmage) you have already researched, instantly assemble blueprints, or provide insight into your tinker research. You can also cast or enchant tinker-adjacent effects like conjuring bound tools, transmuting resources, or fueling tinkertech with your own energies. 

Tech trees for arcane implements such as data-storage tomes, electronic totems, wands and staves, biotinkered familiars, power-generating altars and more that can interface with and enhance your arcane systems become available to you. You may also use your arcane techniques to create magitech components for tinkertech; such as runic engravings, elemental crystals, alchemical materials, mythical creature cells, mana-based energy systems and more.

You may use the knowledge gathered by researching spells and patterns, honing techniques and disciplines, or refining schemes in order to invent new tinkertech and unlock tech trees based on the principles of those arcane abilities. Similarly, when you research or iterate on your own tech trees or analyze other tinkertech and powers, then you may contribute your findings and innovations to your arcane knowledge as well.

title: (Master/Shaker) Goddess
description_html:
You have six powers:

Your primary power is a Master power that lets you influence anyone in your vicinity, which realigns parahuman cognition into being your subjects.

The second power is telekinesis; as a powerful long-range expression of this ability you can fly, have super-strength, and manipulate objects and people. Your telekinesis manifests as fractal patterns in the air, and although you are only capable of moving inorganic objects, you are capable of seizing people by their clothes.

Third, you have a touch-based Trump ability that lets you tune abilities and defenses in a manner akin to Scion.

Fourth, you have a danger sense. Your danger sense will alert you to the strength and direction of any danger that you face. If the danger is overwhelming, such as in the case of Scion or Contessa, you will feel danger with a distinct lack of direction.

Fifth, you have a personal power battery, that you can tap to strengthen your abilities for limited amounts of time. When used in conjunction with your Master ability, the influence can spread between capes like a virus.

The sixth power is unknown. You may freely decide what it is so long as it's no stronger than high Tier 1.

title: (Tinker) Machine Army
description_html:
You’re a Tinker capable of creating The Machine Army, a swarm of self-replicating, self-enhancing AI machines that even without a Tinker to maintain them, could take over a town and remain a persistent problem for years, capable of incorporating foreign Tinkertech and spreading even through multiple attempts to contain them. The Machine Army has a multitudinous decentralized cell structure, with all cells marching to a common purpose while still independent.

The Machine Army by design will take the time to 'seed' solid surfaces, wherever they go, with metallic-looking ores for future machine growth. If left unattended, these seeds will hatch into new and full Machine Army installations, they are hard to make out and find due to being partially extradimensional.

The Machine Army can infect a building and slowly, but steadily, replace the entire structure with murderous facsimiles. The same buildings later can be armed and put on tracks, turning them into massive siege weapons. Machine Army collects and recycles organic matter and sometimes uses its victims as parts of mechanisms. 

The Machine Army lays traps for people by becoming buildings, or more accurately, becoming facsimiles of buildings, in an attempt to lure people inside. Until a target enters, the machines remain dormant, but when individuals wander into the trap they will activate and kill the intruders.

Even without actively interfering with them they can adapt continuously about once every year or two, discovering a new trick or piece of research that could then be incorporated into their arsenal, some examples being: 
-Big cannon-drones. Which have serious destructive power. 
-Slave-Mechs. Drones which captured people to use as both hostage and power supply. If a captured hostage had powers and/or a trigger event while captured, the relevant machine would try to borrow the hostage's powers to empower itself.
-Meat lockers. These drones run organic computers and act with fervor and unpredictability.
-Inter-dimensional technology. To compress itself into interdimensional pockets that will pop open and continue to spread if they are attacked.

As the Tinker capable of creating this swarm you can greatly influence how The Machine Army acts and develops, like branching out their capabilities and making them develop flight, shielding, or intelligence. Using the Tinkertech of others to greatly advance their versatility, or altering their behaviors and breeding cycles, whether by planting hidden seeds of them all over the country or taking over the ocean with none the wiser. 

Although there's quite a lot of ways you can focus their growth it's still going to take them time to improve, even though your oversight over that growth can drastically speed up the timetable as you prune and lead them towards the functions you desire them to excel in.

Lastly you're exceedingly capable at subsuming self-improving machines and putting a leash on them, be it your own or those of others who’ve gone rogue.

title: (Shaker) Phir Sē
description_html:
You can make golden doorways back in time for around a few minutes. It takes concentration to open them and maintain them, so you can only open them nearby or through a screen. It gets harder and harder to chain multiple portals so you can't travel through days and days on end. Anyone passing through will replace their past selves but now have their future's injuries and possessions.

You can make a "time bomb" by looping light between two portals, aided by your power to become increasingly powerful with time.

(You're unable to go before your entry unless you have Homecoming.)

title: (Master/Trump) Ribbons
description_html: You are able to create ribbons from your body that you have precise telekinetic control over. By default they are as strong as steel, and they can get stronger by leeching powers off of living parahumans they touch. As you drain parahumans, their powers get weak and weaker until they are gone forever. While you do not get these powers yourself, you will have control over the different powers that your ribbons manifest. Your ribbons may have an unlimited number of powers, and they all share them with each other, making it impossible to lose them without outside trump influence. It takes 8 minutes to completely drain a parahuman's powers, and you may turn off the leeching at any time.

addons.title: Ribbon Constructs
addons.description_html:
Your ribbons have learned from your ability to create hardlight constructs, gaining a new application. Separate from your hardlight limit, you can shape your ribbons into constructs, capable of perfectly mimicking the shape and properties of matter, subject to the same requirements as your hardlight, i.e. understanding blueprints and chemical makeup.

Of course, as you can simply create more ribbons you’re not really bound by a total mass limit, however in order to exert control over your ribbon constructs you must have a ribbon remain in contact with them. 

Additionally, created constructs can express drained powers like normal, allowing newfound applications such as a gun which fires a combination of Blaster powers or a physical barrier imbued with a Brute power for durability.

addons.title: Candeloro
addons.description_html: Your ribbons have subsumed your Breaker power, transforming it. Rather than simply cloaking yourself in metallic ribbons, you instead directly convert your body into the same kind of power draining ribbons you produce. This conversion is not permanent and can be undone at will, and while if the ribbons that made up your body were destroyed you will reform damaged, you can also heal by simply absorbing other ribbons to replace the lost ones. You can even selectively convert only part of your body into ribbons instead of a full transformation, allowing for things like unraveling into ribbons to dodge attacks or briefly transforming a wounded region to absorb ribbons to heal. This transformation retains all of (Breaker) Lord of Loss’s benefits, however as you are composed of your power draining ribbons you can also drain power and express drained powers. As a side effect, this allows you to effectively sidestep the limitation of being unable to use drained powers yourself while transformed.

title: (Trump/Master) Magical Plant
description_html:
You can grow magical plants that can grow Shards of their own, causing them to gain powers. When you first plant them, you can choose a theme that the power will take on, though the exact specifics will be random. They grow at a rate of 1 SP every 3 days, but the growing rate halves every 15 SP. Every day you can choose to either sow a new plant or boost the growth of a previous plant, causing it to instantly grow 3 days of growth in any direction you want. The ways these plants may manifest their powers vary, but you have a natural psychic link with your plants, allowing you to control their powers. 

These manifestations may be things like plants that shoot fireballs, slow time around them, or even grow fruit that when consumed give temporary powers. By taking care of and showing love to your plants, you can slightly encourage how the plants improve their powers, with their surrounding environment playing a heavy factor. New plants may germinate from the seeds of these plants, though they will only start half as strong as the original, and grow half as fast.

addons.title: Verdant Patron
addons.description_html:
Your connection to plant life has expanded beyond just the magical plants you sow. Now, any plant under your control—whether ordinary or supernatural—can develop powers over time. You are no longer bound by the slow, halving growth rate of your magical plants, as even mundane flora can be uplifted through your influence, starting with minor enhancements like increased resilience, faster growth, or subtle elemental affinities. Over time, these normal plants can grow into something far more powerful, gaining abilities similar to—but not quite as strong as—your magical plants.

This greatly expands your influence, as you’re no longer limited to the plants you personally sow. Forests, gardens, and even wild weeds can become conduits for power, growing stronger the longer they remain under your watch. Because you can now enhance all plants under your control, you have more ways to support and accelerate the growth of your magical plants. A grove of empowered trees could feed life energy into a newly planted magical seedling, speeding its development. You can crossbreed between plants, creating new hybrids that has the strength of both its parents. Even weeds and invasive species become valuable assets, growing into defensive barriers or spreading new abilities through the land like wildfire.

Your power is no longer limited to what you plant yourself. Every root, stem, and leaf you command has the potential to become something extraordinary. With time, even the most unassuming plant could evolve into a force of nature, and the forests under your dominion could grow into realms of power, reshaped entirely by your will.

title: (Striker/Shaker) Tyrant
description_html:
You possess near-absolute dominion over all forces within a 15cm radius of your body. In combat, you can unleash punches and strikes that appear ordinary but carry unimaginable force, amplifying the energy behind them to levels beyond comprehension, resulting in devastating impacts akin to meteoric collisions. Or, through your precise control over kinetic energy, effortlessly drain the momentum of bullets fired at you, suspending them in mid-air as harmless projectiles.

Beyond raw strength, you can even manipulate all electromagnetic fields near you. With a touch, you can render electronic devices useless or generate devastating surges.

Furthermore, your mind is enhanced, enabling subconscious calculations of the forces you control with precision. This heightened cognitive ability allows you to effortlessly and intuitively manage the vast array of forces at your disposal, ensuring unparalleled and seamless control over the forces within your 15cm radius.

title: (Breaker) How The Turns Have Tabled!
description_html:
You have gained the power of Inversion, allowing you to manipulate the cause and effect of your actions within a 30-minute timeframe. With this ability, you can achieve astonishing feats by bending time to your advantage.

In your everyday life, simple tasks like packing your bags, or cooking become instant as you invert cause and effect, making your bag already packed with precisely what you would have included, or a meal already cooked the moment you walked into the kitchen. However, the accuracy of the outcome decreases the further in time you go, due to the increasing variables of possibilities. Within the first 10 minutes, you maintain nearly 99% accuracy in achieving your intentions. At the 20-minute mark, your accuracy remains around 90%, while at the 30-minute limit, it decreases to 80%.

In combat, your actions become unpredictable and unstoppable. You can fire a gun, and by inverting cause and effect, the bullets appear to have already hit the target before you even pull the trigger. As with everyday tasks, your accuracy diminishes as you approach the 30-minute limit.

title: (Shaker) Natural World
description_html:
You are able to recreate any natural phenomenon you understand, such as combustion, gravity, erosion, or even atmospheric pressure. However, to do this, you must fully understand both how the phenomenon works and how it will interact with your target or surroundings. It is not enough to know that something happens—you need to know why and how.

The better your understanding, the stronger and more controlled your effects will be. If your knowledge is weak or incomplete, your power may be unstable, weak, or fail completely. Simple effects, like generating heat through basic combustion, may be relatively easy if you understand oxygen’s role in the reaction. title: (Stranger/Master) Identity
description_html:
After touching your target for a minute, you are capable of erasing your target's existence, including other people's memories of them and all traces of their identity in the form of photos, documents, and the like, preserving only your own memories of the target. This does not have an inherent protection from keeping others from noticing that they have lost their memories.

After you have erased their existence, the target becomes a featureless humanoid creature that you can control. This creature retains any skills or powers the target had. The target’s mind will be trapped in a room where they can experience everything their transformed body is experiencing.

You can undo this control, returning them to their original state and making all information of their existence return.

title: (Master) Cloning
description_html: You can absorb the DNA of a single parahuman via touch, which can be used to produce a single clone of that parahuman. You can create multiple clones of a specific Parahuman. The cloning process takes 180 minutes, and the user can only create one clone at a time. During the cloning process, minor alterations to the clone's physical appearance and power expression can be made. You have a telepathic link with the clones, allowing you to command them from afar. All clones produced retain the original's memories and are capable of acting on their own. They are able to solve complex problems and think for themselves, and are given autonomy to make their own decisions. They are still loyal to their creator, but they are not completely obedient and can act independently if they believe it will benefit the creator. You are unable to create clones from other clones.

title: (Tinker) Techno-Organic
description_html:
From Flesh to Metals. To veins and wires. From brains housing debatable definitions of sapience to powerful AI cores to blood and coolant; there is a long list of different specialties that can focus on either wetware or hardware. Sometimes merging in limited ways but all the same a difference between them. Biology can grow and evolve but can be slow when it comes to strong change. Technology is the aspect of progression and adaptation, able to be improved on countless times, but it is static if nothing pushes it forward, it will stagnate and rust.

But you? You, my good friend, are the singularity in both fields. You specialize in Techno-Organics or Bio-Mechatronics, deleting the boundaries between hard and wetware to create something better than the sum of its parts. From a set of power armor that can fused and stored within one's body granting increased protection to access to advanced weapons and digital systems. Creating modules that absorb other unclaimed tech and adapting to a system. Devices that can regenerate or even T.O.-nanites that can think and make quick adjustments faster than an average nanite could. Produce advanced T.O.-ware that can grant someone advanced nanotechnosis with nothing but a simple pill or shot maybe even a way to transfer one's consciousness perfectly with no error after enough study. Beasts of all shapes and sizes can be made, all outfitted with technology weaponry integrated into them so deeply that their descendants will have their modifications. The sky is the limit and nothing can hold you back.

title: (Tinker) Supervillain
description_html:
Unleash your inner Bond villain and turn any object into a reality-warping device—whether it be a gun, car, or even toaster—granting it phenomenal power. Convert your weapon into a devastating, space-shattering super beam; transform your car into a space-time manipulation device; or even turn your toaster into a device that can heat the entire world and launch it off its orbit.

However, these devices will come with a high price, requiring vast amounts of resources and manpower. Specific rare elements serve as the cornerstones of the devices—elements that cannot be fabricated in a lab or purchased commercially, but are found in locations that may be dangerous and inaccessible.

Obtaining these resources can consist of a trip to a challenging location, such as a deep-sea trench for heavy water, a core sample from an unstable glacier, geodes from the Earth's mantle, or mineral deposits from the dark side of the moon.

Other resources may require materials from someone’s possession or even be regarded as national treasures—such as the Hope Diamond—to work. The actual diamond itself is needed, not a similar stone or even an atomically perfect replica, as there is always a crucial component that facilitates the enormous power of these superweapons.

Your arsenal of super devices grows with your familiarity with technology and your ability to apply those specialties to new weaponry—such as robotic giant robots that grow as they eat metal, or mutagenic spores that can mutate the planet.

title: (Master) Undead
description_html:
You are capable of reviving deceased individuals and returning them to life. They will all have the (Brute) Zombie power. The longer a subject has been deceased before resurrection, the less memories and mannerisms they will retain. 

Zombies are free to act independently, though those who have been dead for longer will display less independent thought. The power of a revived individual will affect the amount of points required to control them. You start off with 100 points (150 with Negentrophy).

A zombie of an ordinary human will take up one point, while a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T1 will take up 5 points, a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T2 will take up 20 points, and a zombie of a parahuman with a power equivalent to T3 will take up 60 points. Finally, zombies of ordinary animals will take up less than two points, depending on the abilities of the animal.

title: (Thinker) Clairvoyant
description_html: Your senses have been greatly expanded. You can now extend your senses, for example, to see wide areas, multiple things at once, in other universes, whole cities, anyone, and anything. You can even recognize someone calling your name in an entirely different universe. You can scale your ability up and down to your normal senses at any time, and you can choose which senses get amplified and which don't. You can choose to exclude certain areas or subjects from your sight if you wish. You have also been granted the ability to actually make sense of everything you see, capable of easily handling the load of information that comes with seeing everything at once. Looking at everything at once is no more difficult than looking at a single thing at once in normal vision. You can bestow your vision on anyone you touch as well, and you can optionally choose to withhold your ability to withstand the information load to paralyze those you touch.

title: (Master/Thinker) Memetic King
description_html: You harbor an unparalleled awareness and insight into all entities that possess knowledge of you. This ability manifests as a sixth sense that enables you to detect their presence and discern the depth and nature of the information they hold about you. You can subtly manipulate those who are privy to your existence, as the number and specificity of those who know you dictate the extent of your control. Once at least 200 individuals possess knowledge of you, you can possess one person to act on your behalf for 10 minutes. Upon surpassing 500 individuals possessing knowledge of you, you are capable of possessing three individuals simultaneously for 1 hour. With more than 1000  individuals possessing knowledge of you, you can possess 10 people simultaneously indefinitely, with this cap increasing with further exposure. Your capacity to multitask scales with the number of individuals you can possess.

title: (Tinker/Trump) Embrace the Punk, Become PUNK
description_html:
Choose a Punk specialization (Atompunk, Dieselpunk, Biopunk, Arcanepunk, Clockpunk, Nanopunk, etc.) and gain beginner-level knowledge of it. At level 0, you acquire basic knowledge of personal gadgets, equipment, and tools to Tinker. As you progress and reach an arbitrary level of production/infrastructure, you have the option to either level up within the same specialization or choose another one. A level-up is qualitative, allowing you to comprehend and produce more complex and far-reaching technologies, such as vehicles, bases, and troupe equipment.

At level 5, you become proficient in building all non-space-specific Tech of that specialization, giving you the ability to create entire continental structures and make world modifications. This includes societal, mechanical, auto-catalytic, or mental constructions, such as designing governmental structures or ideologies for the masses.

All level 2 specializations synergize in a positive feedback loop, allowing you to produce increasingly advanced Tinkertech and push the boundaries of what's possible within each specialization, capable of merging multiple Punk styles seamlessly so they're not separated.

title: (Trump) Fading Star
description_html:
You have a trump version of Leet’s power, meaning you can manifest and use any possible combinations of powers at any level of strength a Shard can hand out to a host in a normal Cycle. These powers and any effects that rely on those powers last for up to a day each, then fade away.

Unfortunately, this power comes with drawbacks similar to Leet. While you can attempt to manifest the same power on separate occasions, the more alike a power you manifest is to a power you have previously manifested, the worse it is. This manifests in multiple ways: the power might be weaker, less accurate, harder to control, or fail to activate at all.

You can’t summon another copy of a power while you have a version of that power summoned, and while nothing is stopping you from using hundreds of different powers at once to overcome the weaknesses of repeated powers with sheer quantity, your power will be far more critical of you and the data you generate the more powers you use at once, leading to if you aren’t a good host and have a good relationship with your power for your power to start sabotaging your powers more severely. For example, a power to generate flames might not come with resistance to flames and might be extremely difficult to control.

If you use every possible power that can be handed out during a Cycle at once but don’t generate as much data as a Cycle in its entirety does in a day; well, you might be able to fight The Warrior’s avatar to a standstill while the entity is playing around for that period but at the end, your power will levy severe penalties against you regardless of your previous relationship with your power, unless you reached endgame QA and Taylor level host-Shard bond affinity.

title: (Master) Dragon-Mail
description_html:
Your allies are mushy, squishy and weak. Your enemies are dangerous and powerful. There are ways around this, but you cannot allow your allies to die so easily. As such, those you designate as allies grow powerful biological scales over themselves, capable of stopping most kinetic impacts (up to even Behemoth punching them) and even esoteric defenses that allow your allies to withstand up to 40% of the damage they would normally take by the enemy.

The scales have a third function. As the biological scales grow over your allies, they undergo a biological change, allowing them regeneration comparable to Lung in his base form, as well as Breaker defenses half that of Immune Response. These biological alterations fade with the scales after the battle ends, but they will allow your allies even further survivability. 

If you do not have allies, you can instead grow them from yourself, biological living entities made of these same scales. They are much weaker, and far more stupid, and will only ever last two minutes, but you can create a dozen before replenishing.

title: (Tinker/Trump) Power Tinker
description_html:
You are a genuine power Tinker, meaning you create devices that interact with powers in general including your own. 

This power has a lot of leeway in how you go about it. Maybe you give a mundane individual the potential for a power via a simulated Trigger Event, giving them an appropriate ability based on the Shard they connect with and the parameters of the simulated Trigger. Or instead, you force a Second Trigger on an already powered individual. 

You are also able to make devices that empower and refuel Shards, make it easier for their users to control their abilities or use them for longer periods overall, or make temporary or permanent alterations to their powers. 

Though there is a drawback: the creation of these devices is especially costly and complicated at first. This power is unable to interact with itself.

title: (Tinker) Cause And Effects
description_html: You possess a unique ability to harness the laws of cause and effect, allowing you to create technology that can bend and manipulate reality in incredible ways. Your creations are capable of achieving seemingly impossible feats. such as the creation of a spear that's able to strike a lethal blow through the heart regardless of the circumstances, or the creation of a machine that can simulate the effects of a cause, giving you a prediction of the future. However, you must acknowledge that this power is not without flaws, as some effects are simply impossible to achieve, such as trying to strike a lethal blow through the heart when the target has no heart. Your technology is extremely costly to create, and it is considered a blindspot due to its effects.

title: (Tinker/Stranger) Might Make Other Tinkers Mad
description_html:
Whenever you encounter a problem, this power will provide you a mental list of Tinker-tech blueprints that, in some way, provide a solution to that problem, all generated from a decently advanced but generalized Tinker-tech database. Mentally selecting one of these blueprints will cause your power to fabricate the selected option, making it instantly appear either in your hands, on your person, or nearby, whichever is most convenient. 

Your power will do its best to provide a variety of options for each problem you encounter, although they won’t necessarily be perfect solutions. For difficult problems, this will often require a level of trial and error on your part with the different solutions it provides to reach a satisfactory result.

For example, say you are fighting Lung and need to deal with him before he hurts anyone. A few of the options your power could provide might be giant robots designed to distract him and lure him away from populated areas, power armor, forcefield generators, fire negating technology, bombs that could destroy him before he has a chance to ramp up, or even a machine gun loaded with Tinker-tech tranquilizer rounds.

This is real Tinker-tech made from real materials and is not dependent on your power to exist besides creating them in the first place.

You are a real Tinker, being able to mentally draw upon your power’s tech base to Tinker just like any ordinary Tinker. This lets you manually build any of the technology your power mentally provides you the blueprints for, should you desire. In the same vein, you are able to maintain and modify any technology you or your power have produced.

You are able to mentally save any of the blueprints your power provides, so you have access to them even when the problem that prompted them disappears.

You can use your Tinker capabilities to rapidly and mentally alter the design of the blueprints your power provides, allowing you to adapt as a situation evolves or make the designs better fit the problem at hand. This does not alter technology already created by you or your power.

The tech base of this power does not include megastructures. This power also cannot fabricate anything past a 500-meter radius of your body, which includes any technology that would surpass that radius in size.

title: (Trump) Connection
description_html:
With a touch, you can alter the power of a parahuman by modifying the Corona Pollentia. Doing this makes the mind of the Shard and its Host slowly merge, resulting in the shard having greater control and the Host’s mind degrading, the more you modify the connection the quicker the merge happens and the more the host power is amplified. With a touch, you can return the connection to normal, but the Host’s mind will need time to become whole again, the further the Host and Shard are merged the longer it will take for the Host’s mind to recover.

When you alter the connection between Host and Shard you can give the host a new power that the Shard could have given during the Host’s Trigger Event by sacrificing parts of the existing power with the new power potency being directly proportional to the sacrifice, for example, giving a pyrokinetic the capacity to slowly fly by reducing their control over their fire.

addons.title: [Directive]
addons.description_html: Your ability to communicate with or influence Shards has influenced Connection. Now, when using Connection on someone, if their Shard’s ranking is lower than yours you can give them Directives, missions/orders they are compelled to complete. Once the effects of Connection fade, any Directives given also fade. If someone’s Shard has a ranking greater than or equal to yours you cannot force Directives on them, however you can attempt to negotiate with their Shard and get it to willingly accept a Directive. If you have [Broadcast] then you can force Directives on Shards with an equal ranking to your own, although you still need to negotiate with those of a higher ranking. Lastly, [Broadcast] also allows you to remotely cancel the effects of Connection, allowing you to revert someone under the effects of Connection to their normal state at will, regardless of range.

This power can also be used by you.

title: (Shaker/Stranger) Call of Oblivion
description_html:
Anything that hears you sing has their perception of you erased; this affects any senses, even power-granted ones. They can't see, smell, hear, or even feel you. Do note that even if someone can't feel their hands touching your face, they can still feel their own hand being stopped by something.

Your singing can also make someone act upon their intrusive thoughts; someone driving could end up hitting a tree because they thought of it or jumping off a cliff.

Anyone killed by you, be it directly or indirectly, has memories of them erased from this world. Their parents do not recognize the face on the pictures of their house, and their significant other can't seem to remember who they lived with.

(This doesn't work through recordings or electronics; it also can't affect entities.)

title: (Master/Trump) Multiversal Emulator
description_html:
You are now the proud owner of a Multiversal Emulator. Searching the multiverse, your shard will project a random sentient minion that will emulate a real person. They can be anything, from a mighty wizard to a seasoned knight, and even, perhaps, a talking vending machine.

While you can command this minion, they are an independent person who will be loyal to you. While they will reflect the personality of who they emulate, they will retain the memories of each interaction and mannerism. 

These projections will never be someone ordinary, and will always carry unique powers and skills. Each emulation comes with an energy pool of 20 “points”, and has a handful of skills and powers you can learn from them. Each skill/power is 10 points worth, and they can be acquired either by training, or by spending energy to acquire them. Your emulation can also use this energy to use special actions such as using their powers or delivering special attacks. When the current emulation runs out of energy, they will disappear and be replaced by a new one. At the end of each emulation, they may leave an item associated with them.

The range of your emulation is up to two hundred meters from you. The Emulation can’t be permanently killed and will respawn an hour later if so. Negentropy raises the emulation energy pool to 30, and Esoteric Knowledge makes your power authentic copies rather than your shard emulating them. Shardless counts as you having both perks.

description_html:
Anyone and everyone fears you; they believe you are the strongest and most dangerous, to the point they don't dare even try to confront you. This is the effect of your power, which can affect any biological lifeform, no matter the range. There won't be any particular reason why they believe this, and even when confronted about their logical fallacy, they will still think you are the strongest, unable to see reality.

Be ready for everyone, including friends, family or lovers to fear your every actions. Unless if you take Holding Back.

title: (Breaker) Nano Cells
description_html:
Your cells are like Nanomachines now!

Your cells are now as small as nanometers and can do many things. Including, but not limited to: resisting extreme temperatures, changing your appearance, living without a brain, virtually limitless memory, unlimited multitasking, super computer-like thinking speed, superhuman capabilities, hardening at will, and so much more!

There are some things you should be aware of. Your cells perform worse the farther away they are from you, with a limit of 100km before they become inert. Your cells do improve, but it will take 10 years before there is a noticeable difference. Like nanomachines, you are still limited to the resources you have at your disposal. You can also specialize cells, but it would make them worse at other tasks.

addons.title: Greyed Shape
addons.description_html:
Your cells developed technorganic traits through your Tinker Specialty, recovering their cellular structure while retaining their programmable micro-tech capabilities, a fusion of both mechanical and organic worlds both in body and mind, using biology’s malleability and growth capacity in conjunction with technology's ability to adapt and progress, you become a more versatile and adaptable being through this mutation.

Among the many functions available to you is: full control of adaptations for any environment, obstacle, or threat; interfacing faculties on both technological and organic fronts; changing into a living factory/energy plant/arsenal through self-created constructs/mechanics from one’s body; a fully cybernetic mind; lastly, full awareness and control of oneself at a macroscopic and microscopic level. All already possible uses of your original power are pushed to the forefront.

Your cells’ degradation rate is slowed, when they could’ve died 100km away from you, they behave more akin to airborne viruses having slighter better reach and survivability, by the time your cellular improvement is continuously experimental, with a notable upgrade over months, although more comprehensive in scope.

title: (Master/Trump) Pokémon Go
description_html:
You gain the power of a Pokémon Master in the real world due to your ability to create random Pokémon relatively nearby, although your control over this is lacking in terms of both how many you create and what specific Pokémon you create. You also have the ability to influence what Pokémon you create by controlling where you create them, since your power creates Pokémon in environments suitable for them. Additionally, this comes with a few auxiliary powers to suit this power. 

You start out with 10 Pokéballs and 5 Potions in a limited sized personal pocket dimension which can be accessed from your pockets as well as a personal bag like a backpack, the first Pokémon created by this power will be Starter Pokémon of which you will be able to catch one of your choice before the rest try to escape, you gain a Thinker power aiding in finding, understanding, caring for, interacting with, and training Pokémon, and finally, through traveling and conflict, you randomly get more Pokémon equipment such as Pokéballs, Potions, Evolution Stones, Berries, and Key Items like Fishing Rods specialized in catching Water-type Pokémon, with less 'valuable' items obviously being more common. 

As a last few important notes; This cannot create Legendary and Mythical Pokémon, Pokédex entries such as Drifloon kidnapping children may be inaccurate, Pokémon naturally heal through rest, Pokémon can subsist off of both food suitable for them and conventional food, Pokémon can learn more than four moves, and Pokémon are generally relatively benign unless they are disturbed.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Feast
description_html:
In your eyes, all Parahumans and power effects (including yourself) around you have an energy pool inside them; the stronger the powers, the more energy they contain. The longer you look at this energy, the more you know about the power, initially gaining one to two-word generalizations like "Awareness" or "Heat Generation". As you look more, you start to know things like "Always On" or "Needs Touch". Look long enough, and you will know everything about a power, including its weaknesses and applications. Seeing the power in action increases the speed at which you acquire knowledge about it.

With a touch, you can drain that energy; it takes longer to totally drain the more energy there is; draining a power effect will weaken it until it ceases to exist, and draining a parahuman will undermine their power to the point it’s obsolete and they aren’t capable of using it. You can drain energy at range and affect multiple targets, but it's slower than using touch, becoming even slower with distance, and the more targets you are draining simultaneously. With time, a parahuman will regain their power; the longer it takes, the stronger the power is. You can also do the opposite, being able to transfer the energy you collected — following the same rules as draining — allowing you to apply your capacity to boost and create new aspects of powers into ones that aren't your own.

You can expend energy to temporarily boost part of a power. Like increasing range, decreasing the time necessary to do something, or giving a new aspect to it. ¼ of that boost becomes permanent; a power that temporarily gained 6 meters to its range now has permanently an additional 1.50 (or one and a half) meters to its range. If you temporarily gave (Trump) Eidolon an extra slot, you would permanently have it but only be able to slot powers that are ¼ the strength.

Creating new aspects will cost more energy than boosting an existing one and will cost more the more it deviates from the theme and mechanics of the power, new aspects take more energy to boost compared to the base power. Giving your Water Manipulation the capacity to see the future by looking at water would take much less energy than giving your Earth Manipulation precognition while giving your Water Manipulation the capacity to control Ice would take even less energy.

Any powers you enhance will start releasing electricity-like energy or a glow when they are used. This energy/glow happens either on the power itself or on the part of your body where it originates from. Sometimes both happen to either.

This power is best used in bursts to conserve the stockpiled energy and because continuous use won't keep increasing the permanent boost. Powers affected by Feast cannot affect Feast.

title: (Shaker) Snapshots
description_html:
You can create ‘saves’ of the area and people around you. The longer you stand still while taking the save, the wider the range becomes. Once you take a save it’s stored within your power. You can have up to 7 saves at once.

You can summon these saves at anytime, allowing you to swap your current surroundings with any previously captured moment in an instance in a manner similar to that of Labyrinth. The saves will act normally, and will not know that they are not the real deal, although they can deduce it with time. This means that if one of the saves sees you as an enemy, then they will attack you like normal.

The duration of your summoned saves depends on its size and your experience. The bigger the summoned saves, the harder it is to maintain. Once the save is dismissed, the area returns back to how it was before you deployed your save.

Note: Entity Avatars and Endbringers can be saved, but unless you have Queen Shard they will be limited at the power level of what they have shown during their fights. If you have Negentropy and Queen Shard you can create saves of the Entities true body.

title: (Trump) The Arena
description_html:
This power is designed to study and learn all martial arts techniques and other ways of fighting for future cycles. The Shard will learn and study these forms of combat from fictional sources or even real sources and then allow you to learn them. Mastery in the arena demands dedication, requiring individuals to immerse themselves in training to attain power.

The Arena, a distinct world accessible at will, allows participants to physically enter an environment similar to either a Dojo or an Arena, depending on their needs. This enables interaction with others and the surroundings. Although impervious to death within the arena, the user will feel pain. You are the only one who can enter the Arena, and you will exit the arena from the location that you entered from.  

Upon entering, individuals acquire an energy pool utilized to summon either fictional or real personas willing to impart their arts and fighting styles. Each mastery requires a year or more of dedicated training, limiting the summoning of new mentors until a sufficient level of expertise is reached. Mastery expands the energy pool and enables the summoning of more formidable mentors. Regular training within the arena contributes to energy growth, albeit at a lesser rate than mastering new skills.  

Potential mentors can include martial artists, ranged fighters, and even skilled swordsmen, encompassing any physically oriented entities. Summoning high-caliber figures requires substantial energy. Students may use energy to learn specific powers or skills from their mentors, creating a weaker version that necessitates further training for enhancement. Only one power or skill per teacher can be copied, and simultaneous summoning of multiple mentors is prohibited. You could instead choose to summon waves of enemies to fight to your heart's content or to train.

The arena introduces a slight time dilation effect, allowing individuals to progress in strength over time, breaking limitations through sustained effort and dedication.

With negentropy, the ability to copy multiple powers or skills arises, contingent on available energy. The energy pool experiences significant growth during arena training or general mastery, presenting an enhanced avenue for personal development.

All Replicated Esoteric Energies are not real and can only be imitated unless you take Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge.

title: (Changer) Bio-Assimilation
description_html:
Upon consuming biomass, you are capable of collecting and storing genetic data, as well as absorbing a special type of energy called Bio Energy. 

Utilising Bio Energy, you are able to change and modify your biological makeup using the genetic information you have stored. The more complex the genetic information, such as that of a Kryptonian, the greater amount of energy is required to transform your body into the desired state.

You may also utilise Bio Energy in a few additional ways. If you are in need of a specific sort of biomass to carry out a particular transformation, you may utilise Bio Energy to generate it. If you have sustained wounds or injuries, you may employ Bio Energy to promote healing. Additionally, you are able to tap into the potential of Bio Energy to temporarily enhance the capabilities of your physiology.
 
If the amount of Bio Energy stored within you exceeds a particular threshold, your body will initiate a process wherein you evolve in an accelerated manner, optimising your current biological state before storing the genetic data of your enhanced form.

You gain a few additional changes, your jaw is greatly boosted, allowing you to chew through steel. In addition to that, your stomach acids are able to break down practically any organic material.

title: (Shaker/Master) Beasts of Gaia
description_html:
You now possess the ability to call and summon animals to aid you. You can radiate an inaudible frequency reaching up to five kilometers that any non-sapient animals will feel compelled to follow. Additionally, you can summon a single non-sapient animal of your choice at a time from anywhere on Earth–you can choose to summon any animal possessing a certain characteristic, any animal of a specific species, or even a specific animal such as your pet. 

You can even access the past and summon any animal or creature to the present moment. This includes alternate Earths where different species may have thrived. You can send it back to where you summoned it from and summon a different animal at any time, and if it sustains significant injuries, it will be automatically unsummoned and returned to its original location. You will receive detailed descriptions of all creatures available for summoning. It's worth noting that animals or creatures brought from the past to the present cannot breed.

Any such called or summoned creature will be loyal to you and will be empowered similarly to a mid-range Brute; a monkey could flip a car, while an elephant might be able to win a toss-up against a tinkertech monster truck. You can also share the senses of any animal you called or summoned, and even communicate with them.

Over time, this power will induce physical changes in the user, such as small fangs, slit eyes, claws, or even a tail. Additionally, you gain heightened senses akin to those of the animals you control. Eventually, your ability to communicate with animals you summoned or called will be extended to every animal.

If you have Negentropy, you can now summon up to three animals simultaneously, and the number of animals you can summon will grow over time.

title: (Shaker/Master) Grimm Pools
description_html: You are capable of making monsters that spawn from pools of a black, tar-like substance that drops from your body. The shape, abilities, and size of these Grimm are decided by you and the size of the pools from which they spawn. Grimm made by this power are all highly aggressive, can sense negative emotions, are made of the same substance that created them, and have boney protrusions coming from their body, usually in the form of masks or armor. There is no limit to how big your Grimm can be, however it takes increasingly more stamina to do so. You have a slight master power that lets you command them telepathically, however you cannot command Grimm that are too far away to hear you. You can only grant abilities that are equal to or less than 10 SP.

title: (Master/Thinker) Personal Army
description_html: You have your own personal army with technology equivalent to World War 2 comprised of 1000 soldiers, 300 armoured personal carriers, 240 armoured cars, 25 tanks, 30 fighters, and 15 bombers. They are appropriately manned with the required personnel. If you summon them, it will look like they come out of a portal. They aren't exactly resistant to master effects, but their loyalty will never waiver. You always know where your soldiers and equipment are and if they are still in working condition. Any information they gather will be known to you. They also know what you know and what you want them to do.

addons.title: Bad Company
addons.description_html:
Your soldiers aren't tall anymore—quite short, in fact. But not to worry, they aren't any weaker because of it. If anything, they're stronger.

Your soldiers, tanks, and other units shrink down to miniature toy versions of themselves. However, they retain all their original power—speed, strength, firepower, and more—as if they were still full-sized. Each individual can return to their original size if needed. For vehicles, the driver determines the size, with it's passengers shrinking accordingly.

Optionally, your soldiers can be green.
