title: (Trump) Idle Manifestation
description_html:
Every day, you gain 5 random very weak Abilities, and you can use as many as you want simultaneously. The strength of what you receive fluctuates a little bit, but it will never be very powerful nor completely useless, going from slightly below T0 and T0 to rarely low T1.

Abilities are divided into three categories: Minus, Plus and Equal. Minus are powers like slight resistance to heat or launching things you are touching as if you used your hands. Plus are skills like being better at throwing knives or crafting medicine. Equal are a combination of Minus and Plus, essentially Abilities that contain both a power and a skill, like being able to walk on any surface combined with a very good balance.

Each power has a level starting at 0 and can go up to 10, and repetitive use will raise their level; the time it takes to do so depends on their strength and level. When an Ability reaches level 10, it will either evolve itself or allow you to fuse it with another Ability that has reached its limit; doing either of them makes the Ability level 0 again, though it doesn't become weaker. Levelling up an Ability adds its initial strength to itself. Example: When "Resist an additional 100 degrees of heat" becomes level 1, the 100 degrees would become 200, another level up would raise it to 300, etc. Example of the Evolution of an Ability: The capacity to generate fire from your fingers becomes the capacity to create fire from your entire hand. Example of the Fusion of Abilities: "Increased Memory Retention" with "Being able to think faster" would result in "Even better memory and thinking speed and the capacity to play your memories like a video in an instant.".

When you receive copies of an Ability you already possess, you can feed it to that Ability to raise its level, skipping the time necessary to train it entirely. All of your Abilities have names that you can use to search for them using a mental search engine.

addons.title: Esoteric Manifestation
addons.description_html:
Your Abilities are now Esoteric in origin, what this means is that the Abilities you gain no longer need to be bound to the logics of the world, though they may cost MP, SP or even HP. Actual Time Travel, Magic and conceptual things are now eventually within your grasp.

The Abilities you receive start 10% stronger.

addons.description_html:
Your Abilities become valid targets to be granted to someone, more specifically, their Unevolved/Unfused/Unleveled selves are the valid targets. Essentially, it allows you to grant to someone an Ability at the strength it was when you first got it.

This works exactly like Endow, you just can use your Abilities in place of a T0.

addons.title: 108+ Manifestations
addons.description_html:
By keeping a Skill for a time, you will gain an Ability that not only is a copy of that Skill but also is 108/108 of the original Skill at the time of the copy instead of 1/108. This allows you to retain the Skill while freeing up a slot for something else.

What this means is that if you copied the capacity to create fire at 1/108, and later the original user of the power was capable of controlling fire in addition to increasing the output of their fire, when you receive the Ability based on that Skill, you won't be able to control and create fire at the same level the original user can now; you will only be able to create fire at the same level they could when you copied it.

These Abilities do not count towards your daily limit of 5 Abilities.

addons.title: Ink Manifested
addons.description_html:
‘The skin of your non-dominant hand has the color of a canvas, drawings representing your Abilities fade in and out of it. You can feel sensations and feelings coming from them—almost like they are alive—the warmth of your Fire Creation, the confidence of your Forcefield, the giddiness of your Flight.’
 By writing or drawing on this canvas you can direct what Abilities you will receive daily. Draw a sword and you could receive the capacity to create swords you have wielded, write Fire and you could receive the capacity to absorb it. Your Abilities have gained a level of sentience and perhaps even sapience depending on what they are. This intelligence increases when they level up. As the one they are bound to, your Abilities will use their newfound intelligence to help you, maybe your Future Sight is constantly communicating with your Danger Sense and Forcefield in order to protect you, or maybe a Multitasking-dependent power starts using its own mind to manage itself.

title: (Mover/Breaker) Starburst
description_html:
You are capable of travelling at incredibly high speeds, up to Mach 600. Your movements create a shockwave that can knock nearby objects (or people) off their feet, and you can use your own body as a weapon, ramming into targets at incredibly high speeds. Your body is also empowered to the degree needed to operate at such high speeds.

You are also capable of breaking your body into millions of tiny fragments made of plasma, which can move separately and recombine at will, dramatically increasing your maneuverability and evasiveness.

Transforming into your Breaker form and reconstituting immediately heals you, and you’ll automatically shift into your Breaker form if enough damage is taken.

You have a secondary Thinker ability that allows you to perceive and navigate through your surroundings at high speeds, detecting obstacles and predicting your enemies' movements.

title: (Striker/Trump) Override
description_html:
By touching a Parahuman you gain the capacity to activate, shut down, and control their power not as if it was yours to begin, but beyond, Clockblocker never knows how long his power lasts but you would, Eidolon can't choose his powers but you can. You gain access to the Shard's data acquired from studying that specific powerset and ones similar to it, what this means is that you can use a Parahuman's power better than they ever could. When you are no longer touching said Parahuman you lose the control you have over their power but retain the data acquired.

When you override a Parahuman's control over their power it mutates, becoming detrimental to them and beneficial to you. The mutation disappears when they are no longer affected by your power, resurfacing every time they try using their power against or on you. If you took control over Teacher's power it would alter the loyalty aspect depending on what would be beneficial to you, like changing who is loyal to who or changing loyalty to disobedience, the other aspect of the power is able to cause minor boosts to any power without shifting its parameters and the Thinker/Tinker powers it gifts is slightly stronger.

As long as they are being affected by your power you can steal the protection against their own powers any Parahuman has and either use it yourself, give it to something else, or return it.

If a power has "something" it can't affect, like inorganic or organic matter, it will treat you as that "something" and if a power bypasses the Manton Limit it will suddenly have one when it is used on you e.g. Cherish would be unable to sense or affect your emotions because to her power you have none. Behemoth would be unable to use his Kill Aura on you. You can turn it off/on, alternatively you can instead selectively blacklist certain powers from being affected by this and apply conditions to this blacklist, allowing you to for example be only affected by Panacea if she is healing you in a way you approve.

addons.title: Treason is Forbidden
addons.description_html:
You can blacklist powers from working against or on you at all and can apply conditions to each blacklist. Punch a Brute? Their durability doesn't work if you are the one doing the damage, a Blaster shoots at you? Their attack will either pass through you harmlessly or will simply disappear if it touches you, Clairvoyant? He cannot see you and things around you appear in a different way so they don't give away there is supposed to be something there. You can turn this on/off at will.

If a power is being used against or on you, you can change its Manton Limit or add one if it doesn't have it. You can also do this to those you are overriding. Though applying conditions you can make it switch between what it originally was and what you changed it to, you can apply conditions to switch between multiple Manton Limits.

When you are no longer touching said Parahuman you lose the control you have over their power but retain the data acquired.

When you override a Parahuman's control over their power it mutates, becoming detrimental to them and beneficial to you. The mutation disappears when they are no longer affected by your power, resurfacing every time they try using their power against or on you. If you took control over Teacher's power it would alter the loyalty aspect depending on what would be beneficial to you, like changing who is loyal to who or changing loyalty to disobedience, the other aspect of the power is able to cause minor boosts to any power without shifting its parameters and the Thinker/Tinker powers it gifts is slightly stronger.

As long as they are being affected by your power you can steal the protection against their own powers any Parahuman has and either use it yourself, give it to something else, or return it.

If a power has "something" it can't affect, like inorganic or organic matter, it will treat you as that "something" and if a power bypasses the Manton Limit it will suddenly have one when it is used on you e.g. Cherish would be unable to sense or affect your emotions because to her power you have none. Behemoth would be unable to use his Kill Aura on you. You can turn it off/on, alternatively you can instead selectively blacklist certain powers from being affected by this and apply conditions to this blacklist, allowing you to for example be only affected by Panacea if she is healing you in a way you approve.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Musketeer
description_html:
Your shard enables you to summon single-use muskets around you, which turn into mist and disappear after use. These muskets are extremely durable, capable of withstanding multiple hits from mid to high-tier brutes before breaking. Additionally, they have virtually zero bullet drop when fired. You can choose how powerful each musket is when summoning it. Once fired, the musket ball can be strong enough to pierce titanium and even cause high-tier brutes to have second thoughts. You can summon as many muskets as you want, but you are only limited to having 200 active muskets around you at a time.

Your shard also grants you the power of telekinesis when summoning your muskets, along with excellent marksmanship. This telekinesis allows you to manipulate and control the muskets as if they were another limb, knowing their exact positions and where they are aiming at all times. The telekinesis also extends to controlling the musket ball once fired, making it easier for you to hit your targets accurately.

Although you have perfect control over the muskets when they are close to you, your telekinetic control weakens with distance, reducing both accuracy and control.

title: (Trump) Evolution and Escalation
description_html:
You have gained access to three types of power slots: the Source, the Evolver, and Storage. The Source power slot can interface and copy the ability of any Parahuman you know of while the Evolver power slot starts with any power you can think of with a limit of 5 SP. The Source power slot and any other power you have will then, upon your choice, feed its usage, data, and analysis to the evolver power slot, slowly evolving the power inside into new forms over time through the source’s usage which will cause the Evolver power to take on capabilities and characteristics of the Source power’s [Data].

However, this is a slow process with many powers taking months to evolve due to the growing time tripling in length for every doubling of SP past the beginning 5 SP until the maximum of 20 SP (or never if you have Negentropy). You can then store these evolved powers into one of 5 Storage slots where they can held in their current state until you wish to use them by placing them inside the evolver slot again.

If you have Negentropy you can generate a new Source slot by deleting a power and its [Data] worth 20 SP or more, a new Evolver slot for a power worth 10 SP or more, and a new Storage slot for a large fight’s worth of [Data] and power. If you have Esoteric Knowledge you can copy powers from a person (real or fictional) you know of with powers equal to or less than 20 SP.

title: (Trump) Ephemeral
description_html:
You have a single (three with Negentropy) slot that is filled with a random power of varying strength that is designed to help you in some way. This power lasts anywhere between 1 to 10 seconds and you do not receive a power that you couldn't use within those seconds, so you wouldn't receive a power that would let you see powers if there is no powers nearby. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon and any active external power effects cease to exist after the power is substituted while permanent ones stay.

What power is given to help you will be always mostly random even if the situation is the same, instead of always receiving some sort of Brute power everytime you are about to be hit you might end up with reactive teleportation for example.

You consciously and unconsciously know what each power you receive can do and can use them as if you had them for years.

title: (Trump) Battery Powered
description_html:
You have a collection of powers that you can choose to use. You are limited to only one at a time if particularly powerful, three at a time if very weak, or two at a time if anywhere between both. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon. Each power has a sort of battery filled with energy that is consumed when you slot that power. Emptying a battery makes a power temporarily unusable until it is filled again by removing the power from the slot and waiting.

The strength of the power determines how much energy it consumes while slotted, your strongest powers last less than 10 seconds while your weakest lasts 1 minute.

Negentropy increases the limit of the amount of Powerful/Weak/Middle powers by one. It also increases the battery life of yours powers, your strongest powers last 30 seconds while your weakest last 2 minutes.

title: (Trump) Decaying Strength
description_html:
You have a collection of powers that you can choose to use. You are limited to only one at a time if particularly powerful, three at a time if very weak, or two at a time if anywhere between both. These powers can be as strong as prime Eidolon. Every time a power is used it decays until it is completely unusable, when not in use it will regenerate. This decay affects aspects of the power, so sometimes it will affect the entire power, only a part of it or switch between what it is affecting, e.g fire creation and manipulation? Using it would for example eventually remove the creation aspect leaving only manipulation and using the manipulation would eventually remove that too.

The strength of the power determines how much use is needed to completely decay it and how long it takes to regenerate. Very powerful? A couple uses are enough to become unusable and would take a while to completely regenerate, very weak? Should last you a while and would take a couple minutes to completely regenerate.

Negentropy increases the limit of the amount of Powerful/Weak/Middle powers by one. It also doubles the amount of uses a power needs to completely decay and halves the time it needs to regenerate.

title: (Trump) Suite of Powers
description_html:
You have five powers: Super Strength, Invulnerability, Flight, Variable Vision, and Super Speed. These five powers however are not always at their full strength as you can only have one active at full power at a time while the others only work at a diminished capacity.

Your Super Strength at full power would allow you to surpass even the strength of Alexandria and allow you to dig into the upper layers of an Endbringer, then again, it wouldn't do much to the deeper layers. In its weakened state your super strength decreases significantly however you would still be allowed to exert enough strength to the point where lifting 20 tons would be difficult but not extremely tiring.

Your Invulnerability at full power would allow you to withstand attacks from even the strongest of foes as it would function similarly to Glory Girl’s shunting ability as any incoming attacks would not damage you, however, this would not discount the fact that physical impact will still move your body through space. In its weakened state, regardless, your invulnerability would function in a much more mundane form by dispersing impacts to your body up to a point where getting hit with a car wouldn’t hurt but having a semi-truck fall on you would almost surely kill you.

Your Flight at full power would allow you to fly at hypersonic speeds easily surpassing the speed of sound by many times. However, in its weakened state, your flight would permit you to fly on a level below the speed of sound yet still extremely fast.

Your Variable Vision, unlike your other powers, is a miniature collection of vision-based abilities such as laser vision, x-ray vision, and telescopic vision. At full power your laser vision would be comparable in strength to a standard blast from legend, your X-ray vision would allow you to see through anything even dimensionally distorted space, and your telescopic vision would defy the curvature of the planet and allow you to see up to 100 kilometers away. However in their weakened state, your laser vision would be comparable in strength to run-of-the-mill bullets in terms of power, your X-ray vision would decrease to the point where heavy metals would be too dense to see through, and your telescopic vision would reach a mere kilometers away.

Finally, your Super Speed at full power would allow you to move through and perceive the world around you at Mach speeds. In its weakened state, however, your physical and mental speed would decrease to around that matching a bullet train.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Unity of All
description_html:
Oneness. Harmony. Synthesis. Concepts Shards or Entities are aware of yet wholly unfamiliar in a closer view. It is to be expected, naturally, that while the beings are terrifyingly intelligent in terms of critical thinking, both in technical and adaptive means, they lack any capacity for lateral or abstract thinking for the life of them. That is why the Cycle exists: on the back of other species they draw upon their creativity to find the solution of limited resources, of Entropy.

Taking notice, the Entities endeavored to study these notions in the only way they could: missing the forests for the trees.

What they come up with is still commendable all the same by their standards, as this power is the result of applying the value of Unity in their eyes. 

You can unify and merge with any and every material or tangible object, either a person or parahuman, an element or component of your vicinity or world (like the asphalt of the pavement or the phenomenon of friction), with your unification being targeted or indiscriminate. 

A Targeted Unity is to a specific singular object/person or several: linking with a person melds and links you to this person mentally and physically, linking their mind, body, or powers (if they are a parahuman) in the process, which grants amalgamating, morphing and connecting capabilities at a physical and paranatural level; linking to an object or a particular part of your area like a wall, you either merge with it while also possessing it, progressing and evolving through the object’s inherent traits or aspects, among other tricks; linking with particular physical phenomena, from kinetic energy, mass, to multi-dimensionality, grants control of this physical aspect of reality, receiving traits from it, and a Breaker form based on the physics in question.

This type is almost instantaneous on objects and aspects of the world, the effectivity on people, conversely, depends on the person’s compliance and/or nature, respectively. 

An Indiscriminate Unity is to a general area: the environment of the city district, a park’s nature, giving control, awareness, and understanding to these areas in regards to the union’s focus, with all the earlier applications of Targeted Unity both less potent yet varied. This type of Unity is limited to never going further from an area of 300m², withal the ease and performance are proportionally better the closer it is to you.

Be it as it may, all of this can’t last forever, as being powered on limited reserves, it lasts no longer than 2 hours of union on either type. All-or-nothing effects, Endbringers, and Entities can soundly reject this power.

Negentropy removes the energy costs, your union lasting permanently, and Shardless (while doing the same as Negentropy) also extends the power’s sphere of influence to roads untold: all roads of the supernatural and metaphysical, encompassing all existence; mutates this into being more abstract, as a result.

addons.description_html:
With Unity, your merging with your passenger applies the ideas of Communion, seamlessly establishing a connection where there is more synchronization between the Host and Shard, avoiding the mental degradation through the communion’s deeper connection and understanding, which in turn helps with directly communicating and endearing oneself to your Shard knowing their preferences and utility function. Exchanging a single point Corona Pollentia and Gemma with being spiderwebbed across your brain, allowing your power’s grasp and variable strength to be magnified the more you commune and act conforming your Shard’s objectives and simple [Data] collection.

This agreement is enough to side-step some of this power (and Shard)’s imposed restrictions to a degree.

What follows is the humanization of your Shard, growingly becoming fully sentient, in turn.

addons.title: [Otherness]
addons.description_html:
Entropic Decay supplements Unity manifesting its dark reflection, that is Distinction or Disunity, granting them the additional application to forgo or deny anything from reality, using Entropy as the basis for their separation.
 
Being innately extensive it only applies Indiscriminately or when Targeting overarching components of reality; forgoing or denying anything causes you to be independent from any part or concept within an area of 300m², being outside or separate of any physical law in your range, an expression of freedom with the repercussion of a Pseudo-Breaker form conveying this. 

This, unironically, causes immutability from All-or-Nothing powers like Sting or Stilling, as you forsake the very foundations of which their All-or-Nothing effects originate for them to affect you.

addons.title: [Concert]
addons.description_html:
Your Networking abilities are built up and given wider access through Unity, coalescing into one. Cornerstone aids in the affinity, both in an individual and parahuman perspective, allowing full malleability, synthesis, and all-around sensitivity of the members’ entirety. Quartermaster aids in the members' maintenance or guidance, evolving this into a Union with all of the parts being metaphorically One. All powers, skills, and perks percolate and consolidate into a repository of knowledge and power, acting in concert with the needs and wants of the Union, being more responsive and adaptive.

All members have the same abilities to share in the performance.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Oneness. Harmony. Synthesis. Concepts Shards or Entities are aware of yet wholly unfamiliar in a closer view. It is to be expected, naturally, that while the beings are terrifyingly intelligent in terms of critical thinking, both in technical and adaptive means, they lack any capacity for lateral or abstract thinking for the life of them. That is why the Cycle exists: on the back of other species they draw upon their creativity to find the solution of limited resources, of Entropy.

Taking notice, the Entities endeavored to study these notions in the only way they could: missing the forests for the trees.

What they come up with is still commendable all the same by their standards, as this power is the result of applying the value of Unity in their eyes. 

You can unify and merge with any and every material or tangible object, either a person or parahuman, an element or component of your vicinity or world (like the asphalt of the pavement or the phenomenon of friction), with your unification being targeted or indiscriminate. 

A Targeted Unity is to a specific singular object/person or several: linking with a person melds and links you to this person mentally and physically, linking their mind, body, or powers (if they are a parahuman) in the process, which grants amalgamating, morphing and connecting capabilities at a physical and paranatural level; linking to an object or a particular part of your area like a wall, you either merge with it while also possessing it, progressing and evolving through the object’s inherent traits or aspects, among other tricks; linking with particular physical phenomena, from kinetic energy, mass, to multi-dimensionality, grants control of this physical aspect of reality, receiving traits from it, and a Breaker form based on the physics in question.

This type is almost instantaneous on objects and aspects of the world, the effectivity on people, conversely, depends on the person’s compliance and/or nature, respectively. 

An Indiscriminate Unity is to a general area: the environment of the city district, a park’s nature, giving control, awareness, and understanding to these areas in regards to the union’s focus, with all the earlier applications of Targeted Unity both less potent yet varied. This type of Unity is limited to never going further from an area of 300m², withal the ease and performance are proportionally better the closer it is to you.

Be it as it may, all of this can’t last forever, as being powered on limited reserves, it lasts no longer than 2 hours of union on either type. All-or-nothing effects, Endbringers, and Entities can soundly reject this power.

Negentropy removes the energy costs, your union lasting permanently, and Shardless (while doing the same as Negentropy) also extends the power’s sphere of influence to roads untold: all roads of the supernatural and metaphysical, encompassing all existence; mutates this into being more abstract, as a result.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Breaker/Trump) Unity of All

title: (Shaker/Master) I Heard A Rumour
description_html:
You have the ability to warp reality, creating creatures, objects and locations born from the collective imagination and beliefs of people, which are known as ‘Rumours’.

For example, if people start to believe that there are 10 sets of swings in a park, you can manifest it into reality. Similarly, if people believe a serial killer is on the loose, hunting them in particular, you can bring this figure to life. 

The strength, duration, and intelligence of these ‘Rumours’ are directly proportional to the number of people who believe in their existence. The more widespread and fervent the belief, the stronger and more autonomous the ‘Rumour’ becomes. Conversely, if people start to uncover the truth—that these phenomena are merely products of your power—the ‘Rumour’ weakens and may eventually dissipate.

Intelligent ‘Rumours,’ such as beings with thoughts and personalities, remain loyal to you. However, their loyalty is not absolute; they possess a degree of free will and can make independent choices. Non-intelligent ‘Rumours,’ such as objects or simple creatures, are completely obedient to your will without question or deviation.

title: (Tinker/Trump) Tactical Cape
description_html:
You have the ability to create Tinkertech that mimics or emulates superpowers. You can design gloves that grant Tactile Telekinesis or cryokinesis, helmets that allow you to control others or provide extra information based on inference, guns that shoots fireballs or other energy blasts, armors that can rewind time at intervals or make you difficult to perceive. The more exotic or powerful a power is, the more expensive and rare the required materials.

You have Two slots to assign a PRT classifications to your Tinkertech, which are rotated each week. These slots allow you to create powers based on one of the twelve power classifications. The first slot is for method specializations, determining how the tech will function overall. The second slot is for broad specializations, specifying how the tech will achieve its effect. After choosing a classification, you will need to rotate that slot a specified number of times before it can be selected again. You will always be able to service, repair and rebuild as exact as before any Tinkertech completed before the change.

A more in depth example would be a bracelet with automatic "luck" manipulation based on Micro Telekinesis within a radius around you.  The method specialisation would be Shaker because it interacts with the environment and the broad specialisation would be Thinker because it will scan, calculate and send instructions to what to do.

addons.title: Imitation is the sincerest form of flattery
addons.description_html:
When you have the opportunity to study a cape's power in person, you can incorporate it as a third pseudo-slot for a Narrow specialization. This allows you to integrate that exact power or a similar expression of it into the tech you create or update. This specialization excels in building tech that heavily utilizes the studied power but offers limited customization. For instance, you could develop super-evolving tech using Crawler's power or improved time-reset devices with Alabaster's power. If the studied power belongs to a Tinker, you gain broader customization abilities, though you won't exceed that cape's expertise.

Once a power is sufficiently analyzed, it can be integrated into any Tinkertech you build, regardless of the need for in-person study. Power synergy allows combining multiple studied powers to create unique, hybrid abilities in your tech.

title: (Master/Mover) Hell on Earth
description_html:
You gain access to a testing world for the Shards, a hellish landscape covered by an eternal fog. This world serves as a brutal testing ground where experiments are conducted by the shards, often leaving the environment scarred and warped. Within this world reside Parahumans, or what can barely be considered Parahumans, twisted so greatly by their Trigger Events that they have become monstrous in both form and mind. Many have lost their human appearance entirely, while others only vaguely resemble their former selves, their grotesque mutations making them more beast than human. Over time, the extreme conditions have forced the few non-parahumans to evolve into far stronger variants of themselves. Through your connection to this world, you have two powerful abilities.

First, you can summon any parahuman from this world to aid you. Your power helps you select the most suitable parahuman for your needs, presenting you with a list of potential candidates, each with their specific abilities and characteristics. These summoned beings are loyal to you and will follow your orders, but will still retain their monstrous tendencies. The strongest being that you can summon is around canon start Eidolon level. You can summon no more than one at a time (three with Negentropy).

Second, you can trap anyone into this hellish world. To do so, all you need to do is touch them. Once trapped, they are subjected to the same harsh conditions and relentless torment that have shaped the current inhabitants. This can be a fate worse than death, as the eternal fog and constant threat of attack from monstrous parahumans ensure that escape is nearly impossible. Additionally, you possess constant omniscience regarding those you have sent to this world. This means you have an unerring awareness of their status, actions, and location at all times. If you wish, you can bring them back from the testing world at any moment.

addons.title: Depths Of Hell
addons.description_html: (Trump) Faerie Queen has interacted with your power, granting you access to any parahumans who died in the testing world, including those you send there. You can now summon any of your parahumans as Shades. The benefits of Shades include their effective immortality and absolute loyalty, but they are limited to your immediate area. Additionally, you can choose to summon any Shade as a monstrous parahuman. This form gives them some independence and allows them to operate far from you, but with the drawbacks of limited control and the risk of their death. The amount of Shades and Monsterous Parahumans you can summon at once does not change.

addons.title: Heart of Hell
addons.description_html: Through you, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form has established a connection to the testing world. From this link, it has gained the power of the core entity of the testing world, an Endbringer-like being that manages the experiments of the shards in their absence, manifesting as an ever-present fog. Typically passive, this entity works only to prevent the world from collapsing, ensuring the experiments continue uninterrupted. Empowered by this connection, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form can now transform into a fog that can freely teleport people within it. Wherever they appear, a smaller fog acts as a gate. They can use this as a weapon by shredding anyone in the fog, simply by teleporting different pieces of them to different locations. Additionally, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form gains a potent master power within its fog. This power amplifies the trauma of a target’s trigger event, forcing them to relive increasingly horrific versions of said event. It will also induce vivid, horrifying hallucinations that draw upon the deepest fears and regrets of those within it. At times, these nightmares also take the form as tangible constructs from the memories and fears of those trapped within it. Lastly, through your connection to this entity, you can also control the version staying within the testing world, allowing you even greater control over the world. You can also use this control to have your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form’s fog directly teleport people into the testing world. If you have Kaleidoscopic Hells, you or your Endbringer can also access alternate versions of these powers, such as a fog of flame and ash, as long as it’s overall equal or weaker in strength.

addons.title: Kaleidoscopic Hells
addons.description_html:
Your access has reached even further. You can now view alternate realities of these testing worlds, where different types of tests and results have emerged. Through this, you can summon alternate versions of your original roster of parahumans, each with unique abilities and characteristics based on the variations in their testing environments and the conditions they experienced.

For example, a testing world that is an infernal landscape of perpetual fire and brimstone. Or a gravity-altered testing world that alter the way humans evolve. Another possible testing world where all humans are under mind control to be constantly happy and content even as their bodies perish. There could even be a testing world where shards have insects trigger instead.

Each version of the Testing world is as hellish as the last, if not more so. Some may even be completely dead as experiments could have gone overboard.

Whenever you choose to banish people into testing worlds, you can choose which of the many worlds you have access to that you want them to go into.

addons.text: (Trump) Faerie Queen has interacted with your power, granting you access to any parahumans who died in the testing world, including those you send there. You can now summon any of your parahumans as Shades. The benefits of Shades include their effective immortality and absolute loyalty, but they are limited to your immediate area. Additionally, you can choose to summon any Shade as a monstrous parahuman. This form gives them some independence and allows them to operate far from you, but with the drawbacks of limited control and the risk of their death. The amount of Shades and Monsterous Parahumans you can summon at once does not change.
addons.title: Depths Of Hell

addons.text: Through you, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form has established a connection to the testing world. From this link, it has gained the power of the core entity of the testing world, an Endbringer-like being that manages the experiments of the shards in their absence, manifesting as an ever-present fog. Typically passive, this entity works only to prevent the world from collapsing, ensuring the experiments continue uninterrupted. Empowered by this connection, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form can now transform into a fog that can freely teleport people within it. Wherever they appear, a smaller fog acts as a gate. They can use this as a weapon by shredding anyone in the fog, simply by teleporting different pieces of them to different locations. Additionally, your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form gains a potent master power within its fog. This power amplifies the trauma of a target’s trigger event, forcing them to relive increasingly horrific versions of said event. It will also induce vivid, horrifying hallucinations that draw upon the deepest fears and regrets of those within it. At times, these nightmares also take the form as tangible constructs from the memories and fears of those trapped within it. Lastly, through your connection to this entity, you can also control the version staying within the testing world, allowing you even greater control over the world. You can also use this control to have your Endbringer or Endbringer-Form’s fog directly teleport people into the testing world. If you have Kaleidoscopic Hells, you or your Endbringer can also access alternate versions of these powers, such as a fog of flame and ash, as long as it’s overall equal or weaker in strength.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You gain access to a testing world for the Shards, a hellish landscape covered by an eternal fog. This world serves as a brutal testing ground where experiments are conducted by the shards, often leaving the environment scarred and warped. Within this world reside Parahumans, or what can barely be considered Parahumans, twisted so greatly by their Trigger Events that they have become monstrous in both form and mind. Many have lost their human appearance entirely, while others only vaguely resemble their former selves, their grotesque mutations making them more beast than human. Over time, the extreme conditions have forced the few non-parahumans to evolve into far stronger variants of themselves. Through your connection to this world, you have two powerful abilities.

First, you can summon any parahuman from this world to aid you. Your power helps you select the most suitable parahuman for your needs, presenting you with a list of potential candidates, each with their specific abilities and characteristics. These summoned beings are loyal to you and will follow your orders, but will still retain their monstrous tendencies. The strongest being that you can summon is around canon start Eidolon level. You can summon no more than one at a time (three with Negentropy).

Second, you can trap anyone into this hellish world. To do so, all you need to do is touch them. Once trapped, they are subjected to the same harsh conditions and relentless torment that have shaped the current inhabitants. This can be a fate worse than death, as the eternal fog and constant threat of attack from monstrous parahumans ensure that escape is nearly impossible. Additionally, you possess constant omniscience regarding those you have sent to this world. This means you have an unerring awareness of their status, actions, and location at all times. If you wish, you can bring them back from the testing world at any moment.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Master/Mover) Hell on Earth

title: (Shaker/Stranger) Retroactive Change
description_html:
You can retroactively alter events up to 3 months into the past, with the extent of the change directly affecting the level of “pushback” you will experience. Pushback causes details of your change to become blurry and beyond your control, introducing random elements that fit with the alterations you made. The more significant the alteration, the more unpredictable these details will become. The more changes made to the environment and people related to the change, the greater the pushback you will experience. Additionally, pushback increases with the number of people aware of the original timeline, as their collective knowledge creates resistance to the change. If there is more than a thousand people aware of the original timeline, then alteration is practically impossible.

When you alter the past, the new version of events replaces the knowledge related to the original timeline for most individuals. However, certain Thinker powers can resist this alteration, allowing their users to retain information from the original timeline. Some powers may even grant the ability to perceive what the timeline was before the change, providing insight into both versions of events.

The changes must meet these requirements: they must make sense and be possible within the context of the timeline. Additionally, you cannot add new information into people’s minds; you can only replace existing memories. This limitation prevents you from affecting the past of individuals unrelated to the event you are changing.

For example, you can prevent a catastrophic industrial accident from two months ago that caused a trigger by ensuring a faulty safety valve is replaced a week before the event. However, pushback causes a minor attack on the facility. People directly involved retain their memories of the changes and those who would have died in the event are now alive, with the person who triggered never triggering here.

title: (Trump) Art of Symbolism
description_html:
When a person triggers, their Shard—the source of their powers—scans the world for context and human concepts. This is why powers can sometimes seem illogical or oddly specific. For example, Taylor Hebert can control crabs because her shard interpreted them as "creepy crawlies," similar to the insects she commands, even though crabs aren't insects. Similarly, Dauntless can create a lance that shoots lightning because the shard associated a lance with the power to strike from a distance, but it wouldn't allow him to create something like enhanced eyesight because that concept didn't align with the shard's understanding of what a lance should do.

Your Shard, however, is unique. It specializes in the use of human context, all the way down to human culture and ritualistic actions grounded in symbolism. This means your powers are shaped not just by random associations but by the deep, often culturally ingrained meanings behind symbols and actions.

For example, fire, in most contexts, represents destruction, and through a simple ritual invoking this symbolism, you could create a flame that annihilates whatever it touches. But fire is also a symbol of creation and the growth of civilization—think of the fire that warms a hearth or forges tools. By tapping into this aspect of fire's symbolism, you could turn a flame from a match into fire that repairs and enhances technology, using flames to weld broken machines back together or even to upgrade them.

title: (Master) God-Chooser
description_html:
Any act of worship—including prayers, rituals, and offerings—performed around or by you generates energy that you can harness, with offerings generating the most. The energy produced is proportional to the sincerity and intensity of the worship. Regular, heartfelt prayers yield more energy than casual or insincere acts. This energy is stored in a personal reservoir dedicated to the specific entity or deity that was worshiped. You can use this accumulated energy to summon these entities, granting them physical form as Divine Embodiments, golden spectral beings that exude a sense of divinity.

Divine Embodiments have a base strength level of up to 15 SP (20 SP if you have Negentropy). You can expend additional stored energy to enhance their power beyond this base level. The more energy you use, the stronger the Divine Embodiment becomes. However, increasing an entity’s strength by using more energy reduces the duration of its manifestation.

By worshiping living beings, you can summon a Divine Embodiment that mirrors the original’s abilities and skills, still limited by the base total of 15 SP. You cannot summon a Divine Embodiment of yourself.

You can convert stored energy between different entities’ reservoirs, but this process is inefficient and results in energy loss. The energy loss is less if the two entities are related, such as beings from the same pantheon or alternate versions of one another, like Zeus and Jupiter.

addons.title: Self Made God
addons.description_html:
Each time someone prays to you, the energy of their prayer is stored in a personal reservoir dedicated for you. This allows you to summon your own Divine Embodiment, which possesses all your powers except for (Master) God-Chooser. Summoning and maintaining your own Divine Embodiment costs 3-5 times more energy than summoning an average Divine Embodiment.

Furthermore, you can use the act of prayer directed at you as a vector for your abilities. For instance, you can summon a Divine Embodiment at the location where someone is praying to you.

addons.title: Mortal Pantheon
addons.description_html:
You can gather prayer energy from places of worship, such as churches or idols, where others have prayed. This energy is less potent than if you had been present during the prayers.

Your connection to those who pray to you has strengthened, allowing you to hear their exact prayers. Additionally, you can grant your Divine Embodiments to others, bestowing upon them the strength and abilities of the Divine Embodiment. You can also imbue yourself with the power of a Divine Embodiment. When someone is imbued with a Divine Embodiment, their appearance changes to resemble the Divine Embodiment, gaining a golden hue and divine aura.

If you imbue yourself with your own Divine Embodiment, the strength of your powers increases exponentially. However, this rapidly depletes your prayer energy reserves. Imbuing someone with their own Divine Embodiment boost their power exponentially as well, the cost lower than when doing it to yourself.

title: (Thinker/Master) Azulhod Playwright
description_html:
You now have an awareness of a "Book of Your Life" in the back of your mind. This book can be as detailed as you wish to read, ranging from a brief summary of day-by-day to an exhaustive account of events, including the number of bathroom breaks you’ve taken. It is retroactive, containing a complete record of your life, and actively updates with your current experiences.

The real power comes when you shift the "point of view" (P.O.V.) of the book to any person within your line of sight. The book will then start documenting their life from that moment, covering both their past and their near future. The longer you observe someone, the more detailed and extensive the book becomes regarding their life. This power also allows you to dictate how their life will unfold by writing events that could happen to them.

These events, within logical boundaries of plausibility, quality, and engagement, will come true. The people you write about will be unaware of your influence, believing they are simply living their everyday life without realizing they are being manipulated and controlled.

Plausibility: Measures how likely an event is to occur, from a bodybuilder falling down stairs and breaking their neck to Zion’s core Shard exploding randomly.

Quality: Measures how well the event is written, avoiding Plot-Holes, Deus-Ex-Machina, and other inconsistencies that might undermine the narrative, otherwise vague wording or ambiguous syntax can create loopholes which others can exploit.

Engagement: Reflects your Shard’s desire for a well-written story. It will actively help, hinder, or simply observe based on the quality of your narrative and how engaging it is.

Your Shard aims to have a well-crafted history in its database, influencing the outcome based on how compelling your narrative is and if they are Hostile, Neutral or Friendly.

addons.description_html:
You internal library have become a repository of books for the Playwright, making all books from the P.O.V. of others gain two additional page "colors". These colors are White with Black characters that represent a actual fact know to be true, Black Page with Yellow characters as a bellow 50% certainty of the fact and Yellow Page with White letters representing a fact with 50%+ certainty.

When a book is composed of primary white pages and the majority of the minority is Yellow pages, you won't need light of sight for it to update it pages anymore and is able to write on it even if you have another book chosen as a P.O.V..

As a result of the high resolution senses Mental Faculty gives, your book updates quickly and have other ways to be interpreted, using other sense as a example such as AudioBooks. You still only can choose one P.O.V. to update at time unless the new condition is true.

addons.title: Clock King
addons.description_html:
Your mastery as a Playwright has now intertwined with your unparalleled strategic abilities, transforming you into a figure of almost omnipotent influence.

The book's predictive power has evolved beyond merely forecasting immediate futures. It now grants you the ability to simulate and visualize complex, branching scenarios that extend weeks, months, or even years into the future and anticipate every possible action, reaction, and consequence with near-perfect accuracy. This allows you to orchestrate events on a vast scale, subtly nudging the lives of others with minute adjustments that set off far-reaching and intricate ripple effects, all meticulously aligned with your ultimate goals.

Your talent for creating sub-plans has also reached new heights. No longer confined to straightforward, linear strategies, you now weave vast networks of interconnected contingencies. Each decision and outcome is intricately designed to reinforce the next, creating a self-sustaining web of plans that adapt and evolve based on unfolding circumstances. Even in the rare event that one plan falters, the countless backups you’ve prepared ensure your overall strategy remains unshaken.

This level of planning has effectively made you untouchable—only the most unpredictable, out-of-context occurrences, beyond even the reach of your powers, could pose a threat to your designs.

Moreover, the subtlety of your manipulations has been refined to perfection. Your influence is so deeply embedded and expertly concealed that no one, not even those with enhanced perception or awareness, can detect the guiding hand behind their actions. Unless you choose to reveal your role, those you manipulate remain blissfully unaware, believing their decisions are entirely their own.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You now have an awareness of a "Book of Your Life" in the back of your mind. This book can be as detailed as you wish to read, ranging from a brief summary of day-by-day to an exhaustive account of events, including the number of bathroom breaks you’ve taken. It is retroactive, containing a complete record of your life, and actively updates with your current experiences.

The real power comes when you shift the "point of view" (P.O.V.) of the book to any person within your line of sight. The book will then start documenting their life from that moment, covering both their past and their near future. The longer you observe someone, the more detailed and extensive the book becomes regarding their life. This power also allows you to dictate how their life will unfold by writing events that could happen to them.

These events, within logical boundaries of plausibility, quality, and engagement, will come true. The people you write about will be unaware of your influence, believing they are simply living their everyday life without realizing they are being manipulated and controlled.

Plausibility: Measures how likely an event is to occur, from a bodybuilder falling down stairs and breaking their neck to Zion’s core Shard exploding randomly.

Quality: Measures how well the event is written, avoiding Plot-Holes, Deus-Ex-Machina, and other inconsistencies that might undermine the narrative, otherwise vague wording or ambiguous syntax can create loopholes which others can exploit.

Engagement: Reflects your Shard’s desire for a well-written story. It will actively help, hinder, or simply observe based on the quality of your narrative and how engaging it is.

Your Shard aims to have a well-crafted history in its database, influencing the outcome based on how compelling your narrative is and if they are Hostile, Neutral or Friendly.

title: (Brute/Striker) Barebones
description_html:
Your body is your ultimate weapon, and nothing would be as reliable as your own flesh and bones.

Every strike you deliver with your body with no aid of any external weapons—whether it’s a punch, kick, or a headbutt, etc—will always inflict disproportionate damage far beyond natural expectations, with a multiplier ranging from minimum x2 to max x1000. This number will apply at random, but the more successfully you land these strikes, the higher the chances that a double or triple-digit multiplier will apply. You have a secondary ability that would negate the effects of Newton's Third law on your body after a multiplier applies. This doesn't enhance your durability, just ensures that you yourself wouldn't incur any physical damage no matter how high the multiplier applied would be, 

You can turn this on/off at will but do note that if you let the power on even outside a combat situation, the multipliers would still apply. From innocently trying to pet a cat and accidentally turning it into a meat paste to shaking someone's hand and crushing it, you have no control over how the multiplier would apply.

Furthermore, you possess perfect balance and coordination, along with an uncanny, prodigious talent for mastering and acclimating hand-to-hand combat and martial arts techniques.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Action at a Distance
description_html:
The power you now possess manifests as an invisible, nigh-inviolable, kinetic force that you can exert at will. This ability operates through mirroring your actions; by physically moving your body, you can generate physical forces whose motion and direction correlate exactly with your own movements... almost as if your limbs were the force itself. Essentially, this power produces telekinetic effects mimicking the motions of your body, whether via your arms, hands, legs, feet, head or otherwise.

For example, you could crush an individual by clenching your fist, pick up a large object by miming the action with your hand or send a target flying away with a flick of your finger. Even if fully restrained, you could use the motion of your breathing to burst out of your constraints or exert your power via your eye movements. You can also apply this force to yourself, such as lifting yourself into the air by imitating the motion with your hands.

You have perfect innate control over the magnitude of the forces generated, their point of origin and the precise size and shape of the area they affect. The total maximum force you could potentially output at once is roughly equivalent to lifting the Eiffel Tower. The speed at which your forces move directly matches the speed of your own motions. This power only operates through consciously controllable bodily movements, so actions like your heartbeat have no effect.

This power can be exerted from across the planet with no reduction in strength; however, you can only generate forces within areas that you are presently aware of. Significant overuse or outputting vast amounts of force will drain your stamina, causing you to become exhausted.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Conceptual Tinker
description_html:
You have been given the strange ability to scan any object, person, or power that is within 100m of you that you can see into a list of conceptual elements that make up said scanned item much like chemical elements in a periodic table. 

You can then steal or copy these conceptual elements into a catalogue. Conceptual elements copied or stolen in this form have two important components: concept and quality of concept. The former is determined by the underline human understanding of the object and about 150 different versions exist. The latter is determined by the strength of the item it was copied from and can range from 1 to 10. 

If an object, person, or power is copied then you only receive a few random concepts from the scanned item and you cannot scan the same item again for 24 hours. If an object’s concepts are stolen you destroy the object and receive all of the concepts that the object has. The same goes for powers but you must have consent of the owner of that power to destroy it (they can be mastered at the time of consent). You cannot steal concepts from a person. 

However, the point of scanning these items is to combine stored conceptual elements into new objects and powers. While simple powers like shooting a fireball may only require 5 or so concepts of poor quality, more powerful abilities like those found in Tier 3 abilities can require several hundred concepts of the highest quality. In effect you are building powers and powered items much like how a chemical molecule is made from individual atoms. 

While you can create a theoretically infinite amount of items and powers using this power, each item can only have a single power (given at creation) and each power created alone expresses itself as a cauldron-like vial. As such it is massively unsafe to give powers to someone who already has powers.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You have been given the strange ability to scan any object, person, or power that is within 100m of you that you can see into a list of conceptual elements that make up said scanned item much like chemical elements in a periodic table. 

You can then steal or copy these conceptual elements into a catalogue. Conceptual elements copied or stolen in this form have two important components: concept and quality of concept. The former is determined by the underline human understanding of the object and about 150 different versions exist. The latter is determined by the strength of the item it was copied from and can range from 1 to 10. 

If an object, person, or power is copied then you only receive a few random concepts from the scanned item and you cannot scan the same item again for 24 hours. If an object’s concepts are stolen you destroy the object and receive all of the concepts that the object has. The same goes for powers but you must have consent of the owner of that power to destroy it (they can be mastered at the time of consent). You cannot steal concepts from a person. 

However, the point of scanning these items is to combine stored conceptual elements into new objects and powers. While simple powers like shooting a fireball may only require 5 or so concepts of poor quality, more powerful abilities like those found in Tier 3 abilities can require several hundred concepts of the highest quality. In effect you are building powers and powered items much like how a chemical molecule is made from individual atoms. 

While you can create a theoretically infinite amount of items and powers using this power, each item can only have a single power (given at creation) and each power created alone expresses itself as a cauldron-like vial. As such it is massively unsafe to give powers to someone who already has powers.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Trump/Tinker) Conceptual Tinker

title: (Trump) Earth Power
description_html:
You can obtain powers from minerals: By touching rare earthen items, such as crystals, high-quality pieces of stone/ore, or sufficiently similar items such as amber and pearls, you can ‘attune’ them to you, turning them into a focus that you can use to obtain various random low-mid-level power expressions. Attuning a garnet or ruby could provide pyrokinesis or some manner of strength/speed enhancement; a piece of iron ore or alloy could grant ferrokinesis or magnetokinesis; an obsidian piece could allow you to generate lava or clouds of volcanic ash.

There is no limit to the amount of minerals you can turn into potential powers at a time, aside from the energy reserves of your Shard, but using your power expressions requires an amount of conscious focus; the average person can harness about seven at a time without training or supplementary Thinker abilities. You can re-randomize your power expressions with only a moment of focus, but cannot control exactly how they manifest.

title: (Shaker/Striker) Rewired Control
description_html:
You can scramble how someone controls their body. Every try at moving a part is shifted to moving another one, and that shift is randomized every 5 seconds, the result is those affected having no chance of learning how to control their rewired body.

This effect can be applied to anyone within 30 meters of you or by leaving a mark on those you touched. This mark wears off after 1 hour.

There's one limitation. Control needs to be purposeful in order for it to be affected. Breathing? No effect, the person you are affecting starts consciously regulating their breathing? Now its scrambled.

title: (Brute/Trump) Anu
description_html:
Your power is a conceptual fusion of both Lung and Eidolon. That is to say, your power continually ramps up through raging conflict, which grants you new temporary powers. Then again, it isn't to say you can surely exploit it with nothing, as even outside of combat, your baseline grants you a low-level Alexandria package comparable to Glory Girl’s, alongside an additional low-level blaster power in similar potency to Lady Photon.

As your power ramps up, your baseline continuously grows next to your invulnerability branching out from general durability and adaptively developing immunities to the parahuman effects you’re battling against or alongside, your Brute and Blaster powers will similarly gain an adaptive diversity to be more formidable against powers you are contending on the fight’s both sides for any eventuality, while your flight speed continuously increases, your mind simultaneously improving to perceive and function at your constantly dashing speed and growth rate.

During this escalation, you’ll temporarily develop powers meant to aid you amidst your battles. Depending on the circumstance, these powers can fluctuate from solely meant for combat i.e. a striker power meant to disintegrate what you touch, to utility-based powers i.e. a Thinker power focusing on target location. The powers’ growth rate is naturally equivalent to your baseline powers, though developing new powers will delay your growth rate.

Finally, you can affect your growth rate. Like Lung, you are capable of charging up in anticipation of a fight to accelerate your ramping up, yet, unlike Lung, you are fully capable of beginning to ramp up outside of battle, although it would be extremely slow on top of only being capable of reaching a mid-level Brute and Blaster for your baseline. Additionally, this control over your growth rises in effectiveness in combat, being able to “steer” it in certain directions, e.g. from focusing on escalating your invulnerability to directing it to develop a new power to assist you.

addons.description_html:
Your power's adaptations are now permanent, while still following the rules of your power and the need to ramp up into total immunity. At their base level, they make you resistant to those powers.

Additionally, powers that you gain throughout ramping up now become permanent. Yet, your additional powers can be strongest when non-ramped up is equivalent to a high T1 power.

title: (Tinker/Breaker) My Many Masks
description_html:
You can create special masks that allow the wearer to transform into different forms, with each form tied to a specific set of powers.

Each mask has a unique design that reflects the powers it holds. You could for example make a mask with dark, charred material, with glowing cracks of orange and red that resemble molten lava. The eyes of the mask could shine with an intense, fiery glow, while the surface would feel rough, like scales hardened by heat. When worn, this mask would transform the user into a salamander-like creature with the ability to breathe fire.

By improving on the design of the mask, you can cause these forms to unlock additional sub-abilities that complement the main power. For the earlier example, this might involve gaining resistance to extreme temperatures, the ability to absorb fire to increase strength, or even the power to combust their own body. If you have other tinker abilities, then integrating them into the mask may result in non tinker variants of them appearing in the form.

These masks are not limited to their creator. Once made, anyone can wear them and gain access to their abilities.

title: (Master/Brute) Degeneration
description_html:
You now have a powerful regeneration, one that even works on severed body parts that regenerate into clones. How long a clone is made depends on what they regenerate from. If you are perfectly cut in half you can regenerate into two of you in less than an hour. These clones have separate minds but are loyal to you and each other. They have all your perks and powers, however they will be limited to being clones of your base form.

You can fuse with your clones to become stronger versions of yourself, each one building on the powers. 100 of you fused would be equal to 10x your base power. However, the more you fuse the more “distorted” you become, both physically and mentally. Certain traits may become exaggerated and you may have issues mentally if a clone deviated too much from the original, which happens naturally the longer the clone exists independently.

title: (Trump) Completely Mundane
description_html:
You can see and by default interact with the world as if shard based effects did not exist, phasing straight through the results of all powers. Due to this, you cannot be targeted, detected or otherwise affected by any power or results caused by the effects of powers unless you explicitly allow them to affect you.

For example, you would be completely immune to impacts from objects launched/transported via powers (such as via telekinetic force or it being teleported to fall upon you); be unharmed by people made to hurt you by a Master or Thinker (unless they were going to attack you solely because of mundane influences anyway); walk straight over/through gaps or obstructions caused by powers as if they had never happened; take blows from a skill Thinker as if they had whatever skill level they naturally had; ignore the effects of all Tinkertech; etc.

title: (Thinker) Celestial Library
description_html:
Your mind has an ever-changing library that contains all the memories of any Celestial body you have visited or interacted with in the form of books; it has everything that happened on and in it and everything that it witnessed. You access it through a mental copy of your real body and without some sort of enhanced multitasking you can't concentrate on both your real body and the copy at the same, thus to fully utilize your library you need to stop controlling your body, and concentrate on your copy.

By saying keywords you can navigate this knowledge, resulting in bookshelves (and books themselves) temporarily disappear and rearrange, the books itself will also change with text disappearing and reallocating if the said text doesn't fit your criteria. You decide what a keyword means when you add it and can change its meaning later; what this mean is that for example it cannot contain "Integrity" and its synonyms and "Integrity" is case-insensitive, it must contain both "Love" and "Peace" or "Apathy" and "War". As an example, with the correct keywords and meanings, you could very quickly find the book containing the story of someone's life.

title: (Striker/Trump) Bleeding Heart
description_html:
You have now gained the ability to induce continuous bleeding in almost anything.

When you inflict an opening on a entity, you can decide which aspect of that entity will bleed. It can be as tangible as blood, bones, or organs, or as intangible as their very essence. You can drain their strength, agility, intelligence, charisma, or wisdom, etc. Any attribute is fair game, but you cannot drain their life directly, it has to be one aspect that makes the entire whole.

The rate of depletion depends entirely on the target and the chosen stat. Draining a normal human’s fully out of their strength might take mere seconds, while sapping the power of a superhuman giant could require minutes or even hours. Regardless of the time, the victim weakens steadily in that stat, with every passing moment as the bleeding persists.

When a chosen attribute is fully depleted, the outcome varies. Vital aspects, such as blood or organs, lead to death. Draining intelligence could leave them a mindless husk, while depleting strength might render them utterly paralyzed. The consequences are as diverse as the attributes you choose to bleed.

You can only deplete three aspects at a time, but you control when to stop the bleeding. To restart or target a new attribute, you must inflict another opening on the target.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Orbital Downpour
description_html:
Reflecting the most popular tactics sci-fi has for planetary invasion, you can orbitally bombard areas of several kilometers no more than 10km² with a variety of exotic Blaster effects, ranging from MASER (Microwave Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) orbital beam to orbital barrages made from MCEs (Magnetocaloric Effect), are a few examples potent enough to “glass” the area, and those are tame examples of your repertoire; to name the more "effective" of the bunch, you can choose matter-annihilating beams (Damsel), dimensional shunting beams (Scrub), or smaller orbs that explode with sufficient kinetic and plasmatic force to level building or lower-Endbringer layers (Flashbang), anything achievable by a host with Blaster powers within a [Cycle], and more.

To accomplish this, you passively generate orbs of undifferentiated energy at low Earth orbit around 10km² of your surrounding area, the orb’s formation lasting from 1 to 3 hours depending on the Blaster effect’s nature and potency. Once complete, you have to lay out the orb’s Blaster type and orbital location, engendering an element of precaution or planning for such a destructive ability.

title: (Thinker/Stranger) Angel Investor
description_html:
You have a pool of 100 'shares' which you can invest into any 'event.' 

Every action that could potentially be committed by a person, no matter how implausible, counts as an event. The more important an event is, the larger the total pool of shares. These 'shares' are controlled by various precognitives and actors who influence the event (whether for or against). For example, a major event such as Eidolon's clone unveiling Cauldron would have ~400 shares, most of which would be owned by the Simurgh. Incredibly minor events such as what your mom makes for breakfast only have 1 share. 

When you spend your shares, the total pool is expanded to include what you have invested in the event. The larger stake you have, the greater control you gain over the event. For example, if you had a 30% stake you would gain knowledge regarding the various individuals needed to cause the event, as well as how to manipulate them to do so. If you have a majority share (>50%), you can control some specifics about the event, such as making an Alexandria clone reveal Cauldron rather than Eidolon. The more shares you have in an event, the harder it is for other precogs to detect and influence things related to that event.

If an event happens exactly as you plan it, your maximum capacity of shares is increased by 10% of the total pool of shares for the event, rounding down. If an event does not occur or occurs in a way different from what you expected, you could lower your maximum capacity of shares depending on the degree to which the event differed from your predictions.

You can purchase shares in an event from other precognitives in exchange for shares in other events. If they are willing, you can do so at any mutually agreed ratio. However, you can also forcefully purchase their shares in an event at a 3:1 ratio. You can also sell your shares to other precogs in exchange for shares they have in other events, but cannot do so forcefully.

title: (Trump) Heart Is An Awesome Power
description_html:
You can modify/boost your powers through weird logic as long as it makes sense and you can justify it. The new effect is capped at half the SP of the power or 10 SP, whichever is higher. A power can only have one of those effects at a time, though you can freely change it to something else or discard the effect to return the power to normal.

You could, for example, bypass the Manton Limit on your Water Manipulation power by thinking that you should logically be able to manipulate someone's blood because Water is Water, or you could reinterpret the capacity to manipulate Fire as the manipulation of Heat itself and thus be able to freeze stuff by removing their heat.

Now, so long as you can find some form of logic - no matter how complex or bizarre - to make it make sense in your head, you can have your powers act in any way you see fit. There is one caveat however; unless you take Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless you are still restricted to things Shards are capable of.

title: (Thinker/Master) Sonder
description_html:
Some say psychic capes’ impossibility is down to requiring a higher processing and storage human brains can’t afford or aren’t capable of sustaining. Still, knowing the other side of the story and being familiar with parahuman powers’ true source, boasting all requisites, who’s to stop them from playing by said “rules”? Now you’re looking at the answer.

Initially, over a couple of weeks, you’ll be increasingly aware of a mental “switch” allowing you to peer into other’s surface thoughts when touching them.

It’ll manifest as a minor form of tactile telepathy, with a connection brittle enough to just gaze at visual, auditory, and mental surface-level thoughts, pressing on further into a mindscape strains one’s brain to the point of headaches and potential aneurysms. Despite this, your Shard’s development window results in your power’s absurd growth rate.

During your power’s steady practice for a few more weeks, you’ll wind up sensing and interpreting the emotions and thoughts of others at arm’s length, then outright “speaking” or broadcasting your thoughts to other people, until a serviceable amount of control over the mindscape of whoever else to sift through their knowledge or transmit information to anyone nearby. A month passes and animals start pinging off your power, while they process the world differently you parse their mental make-up well enough to communicate with them subconsciously. 

Ultimately, you’ll have full access and control to any mind, sapient or non-sapient. Usually manifesting through peering into another’s mindscape or psyche, your power’s versatility grows apace with your potency to the point of extracting or scouring information from others, common Master tactics such as manipulating thoughts, ideas, dreams, emotions, and memories to profoundly warp their minds for them be utterly different from who they were before, creating hallucinations/illusions through hotwiring regions of the brain, leaving a “bug” to monitor anyone over long distances or other functions, create and dispatch mental images/tags capable of Master and Stranger flexible effects all over your vicinity, up to fashioning Anti-Master/Stranger countermeasures, and that’s simply scratching the surface…

This is best described as a comprehensive administration of psychological and neurological aspects of [Host] species, you most of all: this translates to direct and total control of your mental structure, from altering one’s wiring and functions of your brain to managing your emotions, sensations, perceptions, consciousness, memories, and personality through your mindscape, effectively turning your mind into a customizable part of yourself. addons.title: Psychokinesis
addons.description_html:
Sonder unlocks another power associated with psychics, specifically the ability to move and manipulate matter with your mind, also known as telekinesis. 

Initially, your telekinesis is weak and has a range that only extends an inch beyond your skin; however, like your telepathy, it has an incredible ability to grow as you use it.

As matter and energy are the same, you will eventually learn to manipulate it; however, as it lacks solid form, it requires much greater control to achieve the same level of fine control as matter manipulation.  

The growth vectors shared between your telepathy and telekinesis, such as range and precision, are mirrored and remain the same. Even if you only train your telekinesis range, your telepathy will also benefit from the enhanced range.

Given enough time and effort, your telekinesis could grow to become as versatile as Omni-Kinesis and with a much greater range.

addons.title: Absolute Territory Field
addons.description_html: Your ability to impose new rules on reality has driven Psychokinesis to ever greater heights. Within your Territory - the range of your psychic powers - you can nigh-instantaneously create, alter, or remove bounded fields, up to creating a bounded field encompassing your entire range and anchored to yourself. Much like your telekinesis, the strength and versatility of this ability rises with use and time, allowing you to in time enact more potent rules or layer multiple rules on top of each other. Upgrades to (Shaker) Edict and (Shaker/Stranger) Bounded Fields also affect your Territory, increasing your base starting potency and versatility.
