addons.title: [Connectivity] Issues
addons.description_html:
Sonder’s limits now stretch as far as the Shards themselves, able to feel and tap into the residuals of Parahuman’s connection with Shards as another aspect of your powers to nudge and modify its effects. Your abilities on their approach; (Trump) Connection will remotely focus on the Host’s Corona Pollentia, while (Thinker/Trump) [Query][Response] can target the Shard itself.

With (Trump) Connection you develop two techniques, FLOOD and SPIKE: FLOOD is characterized by psionic inundation from the Shard’s limited bleedover with its Host, causing immense pain with a risk of brain damage and the Corona Pollentia, short-circuiting or smothering power expressions on your effective range, and SPIKE is the sudden and violent form of psychic attack to the Host made from snapping a cape’s connection that is often deadly for most. 

With (Thinker/Trump) [Query][Response] you develop two techniques, PING and LOOP: PING is a psionic calling, the Shard Network’s method of establishing contact usually hurtful once heard by Hosts by how “loud” it is, incapacitating nearby capes, and LOOP created a dangerous feedback loop between Host and their Shards for their powers to fatally backfire by sharpening/accelerating their connection.

Eventually, or by already procuring both, you gain the full range of techniques and comprehend that residuals from Shard-Host connection are the result of a Host’s psychic byproduct as a product of conscious thought leaking through their connection, something you can somewhat exploit in time. This psychic residual energy has interdimensional traits that can interact with the space-time continuum, with several implications for what you’re capable of.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Machine Powered
description_html:
Your mindscape is now divided into two endless layers and you can freely switch your Mental Self between them.

The first layer is a Workshop that adapts based on what you can make. It gives you basic equipment you need to tinker, storage space and a testing area. The equipment is truly basic, if you want better equipment you must make it yourself. The storage space changes and expands based on what you are storing, you may find weapon racks within it if you can make guns or a garage for a Tinker speciality in vehicles. The testing area too changes based on what you testing, like a target practice for your weaponry or a open sky for you jetpack.

The second layer is filled with towering piles of junk that adapts based on want you can make. You can scavenge this place for materials to make things within your Workshop. Of course the quality of the material varies, sometimes you may be lucky and find something in perfect condition but more often than not it will be all damaged goods.

You gain powers based on things made within your Workshop, those powers work similarly to said creations. The same way your creations affect your powers your powers affect your creations. Of course not all of your creations will be able to give you a power but most will. 

As a example, a laser gun that can continuously fire for 3 seconds before you need to stop due to it overheating and that can do this 10 times before the battery is spent would produce a similar Blaster power that originates from your hand that would cause your hands to burn up and  use the energy from the laser gun as fuel. it would be accompanied with a mental catalog of all batteries that can be used on the laser gun and an awareness of how full they are, with you needing to manually reload the laser gun to be able to use your Blaster power.

title: (Striker/Trump) Touch of Improvement
description_html:
By touching something you can enhance it; this gives it a random power and changes it. The bigger than you something is, the longer it'll take to be affected. The change is based on the power, and the power is based on what you enhanced. Sometimes the change doesn't alter what you enhanced but instead changes how it affects things around itself. You can create a sapient being by enhancing something, but you can't enhance something that is already sapient.

What you enhance is attuned to you; thus, for example, sentient beings are loyal to you, and the powers of an object can only be used by you. You can shift the attunement of an enhanced to someone else to allow them to use/command it instead, and you can take back the attunement at any time.

The changes something can have are varied. From physical changes like a gun gaining an intricate design, to mental changes like a toy car becoming sentient, to even spiritual changes if you have Esoteric Knowledge.

You can freely randomize once again the power and thus the change of an enhanced, but in order to do so, you must be touching said enhanced.

title: (Shaker/Trump) A Crown Of Diamonds
description_html: When you are directly responsible for killing something—or they die within 200 meters of you—a white crystal representing everything they are is made. Those crystals are automatically stored in a personal pocket dimension that can only be used for them. The origin of a crystal is called, well, their Origin. You can summon up to 12 of those crystals to outside your pocket dimension, 6 of them surrounding your head—three in each side—and 6 that can be telekinetically moved around; the head crystals are called Mind Crystals while the telekinetically-controlled crystals are called Body Crystals. Both your senses and those of the Origin can be used through the crystals—though what senses from the Origin can be used depends on whether its a Body or Mind Crystal. Mind Crystals allow you to use anything related to the mind that they contain—memories, knowledge, Tinker and Thinker powers, etc. Body Crystals allow you to use anything related to the body that they contain—muscle memory, appearance, Brute and Changer powers, etc. Things that are related to both mind and body or neither can be used regardless of whether the crystal is a Mind or Body one. Using what a crystal contains causes it to darken, when it becomes completely black the crystal will becomes useless and dissipate into dust, duration depends on what is being used but even the heaviest of usages would still yield a minimum of one hour of constant use unless you keep spamming your capacity to restore/remove. To use what a crystal contains you have two methods, Add and Replace. With Add you can use what the crystal contains as long as the crystal is still there. With Replace you can make something you want to use permanent at the cost of you needing to, well, replace something to do so—like replacing your arm with the arm of an Origin who had a Brute power, thus having enhanced durability on that arm—, this method still causes the crystal to darken and will do so even if the crystal was unsummoned. You can return replaced parts back to normal, though obviously you lose the benefit you replaced them for in the first place. Those crystals can assume a single mundane property—can't be a property that would allow you to bypass the volume limit—from Origin and share it with all other summoned crystals, so for example if you set it to Durability the crystal would have the combined durability of everything the Origin has and had—cells, armor, clothes, weapons, etc. You can alter the volume of those crystals and reshape them—this process is slowed down or accelerated depending on their properties—, their minimum volume is that of a marble and their maximum is that of whoever they came from. Lastly, you can use what the Origin from your crystals has/had to restore yourself and what they didn't/don't have to remove something from you, so you could for example regenerate a limb or remove a Thinker Headache. Unlike using what a crystal contains for other things like powers doing this not only results in significant darkening every time its used but said darkening happens on all summoned crystals its connected to, meaning if you restored a body part all Body Crystals would darken and if you cured a Thinker Headache all Mind Crystals would be darkened.

To use what a crystal contains you have two methods, Add and Replace. With Add you can use what the crystal contains as long as the crystal is still there. With Replace you can make something you want to use permanent at the cost of you needing to, well, replace something to do so—like replacing your arm with the arm of an Origin who had a Brute power, thus having enhanced durability on that arm—, this method still causes the crystal to darken and will do so even if the crystal was unsummoned. You can return replaced parts back to normal, though obviously you lose the benefit you replaced them for in the first place.

title: (Thinker/Tinker) Precognitive Artistry
description_html:
You possess a remarkable ability to foresee the future through art. By focusing your thoughts on what is to come, you can access vivid visions that reveal upcoming events and circumstances. This capability also extends to recalling significant occurrences from the past, allowing you to paint them with precision and depth. However, it is important to note that your memories of the future can be fleeting and begin to diminish quickly if not immortalized on canvas. 

The accuracy and detail of your artistic representations are tied to the time frame you are exploring. The shorter the interval—whether focusing on the recent past or the near future—the clearer and more intricate your artwork will be. This clarity allows observers to decipher and understand the nuances of the events you depict. Your precognitive abilities are particularly effective in identifying large-scale, impactful events.

Your precognition can somewhat predict the Endbringers, such as telling if a city would be flooded or if it would be quarantined. Entities cannot be predicted. 
 
Moreover, the secondary function of this power is to enhance your talent as an artist.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Prior Phenomenon
description_html:
You are able to instantaneously modify the magnitude of physical phenomena within a 100-metre radius of yourself to match the magnitude of similar phenomena you have previously encountered within this range before. 

This power encompasses a multitude of natural physical quantities, forces and phenomena such as kinetic energy, electromagnetism, gravity, light, space-time etc. For example, if a lightning strike were to occur near you, you could adjust any subsequent electrical discharge within your range to match the intensity and power of that strike.

Conversely, you can also reduce the magnitude of phenomena, scaling them down to levels you have previously experienced. You could diminish the overall kinetic energy of a speeding bullet to match the fall of a feather or reduce the temperature of lava to that of ice.

Your influence extends to parahuman abilities, albeit with limitations. If you have observed a pyrokinetic producing flames that melt steel, you could adjust the intensity of another parahuman's fire to match. However, due to the immense variety of powers, you cannot alter those with notably different mechanisms of function and effect.

To support this power, you have a perfect mental recall of all phenomena you have encountered along with a complete awareness of all current phenomena within your range, enabling you to alter them with ease instinctively. This power is Manton Limited and does not work with overly esoteric or conceptual phenomena.

title: (Trump) Meme Lord
description_html: You will be given a vast repository of Memes (As in amusing images or jokes, not cultural ideas/concepts that spread) coming from various sources, such as some being from the internet, some fabricated by your Shard based off of your personal preference, and some taken from previous Cycles and adapted to fit the current one. You also have been given a perfect recollection of this ever-growing collection of memes in your head. What’s so powerful about them? Your ability to recreate them and produce various effects based on the meme being recreated. The closer you are able to re-enact the meme, the more powerful the meme’s effect will become based on your efforts. The popularity of a meme also affects the potency of the effect. An inside joke known to only a few hundred people wouldn’t fare much better, but a worldwide classic would be able to hit well above their ‘weight class’, so to speak. Your power is capable of producing secondary effects to assist in recreating these memes, such as producing a temporary Changer effect that transforms you into a monster, or a Master effect on a designated target to play an essential character in the meme. These secondary effects do not contribute to the potency of the primary effect, but having them happen outside of your power’s influence would. If a meme you re-enact creates an effect that would realistically harm you, such as using a meme that ends in a massive explosion, then so long as you explicitly being harmed isn’t an essential part of the source material, you will be immune to any damage that comes from them. If you produce an effect that persists after usage for a time, such as a Mover effect that makes you dodge any attack coming your way, or a Changer effect that rapidly ages you, you may cancel the effect or revert the changes made whenever you wish. There are a few limits to this power. Firstly, you cannot produce effects that (at their base level, without the boost from popularity) do anything more powerful than ‘city-level’, however that applies. Attempting to do so will either have the effect be downsized to conform to this limit, or nothing happens at all, leaving you looking like a massive idiot. Secondly, you cannot recreate two memes at the same time, and producing too many effects in a short timeframe will stress out your body and exhaust you. Finally, for a meme to be able to be recreated, they must be known by at least 100 people in the world, excluding yourself. Attempting this when not meeting this condition will have nothing happen, similar to the first limit.

title: (Master/Trump) Team Joe
description_html:
It's not what you think... you're actually an entity summoner based on said team.

You are able to generate five real human bodies where each one has its own power template below T2 and its own consciousness if you give them full autonomy. Your power templates are based on the class you have been designated, but you can customize them within the established limits and once done you can't modify them again except for your appearance, gender, sexuality and age which is modifiable as many times as you want:

Combatant: You have a triple combo of Brute/Think/Changer so you can choose a single power from your respective category or a combined power from your same classification. You have a personality of being someone who never gives up and is mute so you tend to communicate with people through sign language and you are always someone who keeps your promises. As long as the promise doesn't endanger your creator and his interests.

Shooter: He has a double Blaster/Stranger combo, so he can choose a single power from his respective category or a hybrid power from the same classification. He has a personality of being someone very proud, a certain level of apathy and hates losing in the face of any adversity or problem, which is not an impediment if his creator orders him to do otherwise.

Technician: He has a single three-branch Tinker power, so he can choose 3 specialties. He has a personality of being a show-off in his own abilities and when something goes wrong he rushes too much to fix something, he moderates himself only if someone supervises or prevents any reckless act.

Bomber: He has a double Mover/Shaker combo, so he can choose a single power from his respective category or a hybrid power from the same classification. He has a personality of being someone boastful, optimistic, cheerful and flirtatious with women/men, whose inclination depends on the gender and sexuality that has been customized.

Captain: He has a double Master/Breaker combo so he can choose a single power from his respective category or a combined power from the same classification. He has a rigid and bitter personality, but his actions show that he always cares about his subordinates and allies. In addition, he has a willingness to do anything to comply with the orders of his creator unless you set certain limits or criteria in the order given.

Keep in mind that these bodies can be controlled directly by supporting your abilities as a Master. That is, you are not only limited to giving orders, you can also possess them or simply act as a passenger within their mind.

You have a level of multitasking that is limited to the number of summoned bodies. For each summoned body, the range that can move away from its creator is 100 meters before it begins to have a lifespan of 24 hours if it goes beyond the established range. The Captain's powers do not affect this range of operation.

Even if you do not control it directly and give them complete autonomy, they will still be loyal to you and their level of multitasking does not degrade. Last but not least the Trump aspect is that you can embody part or all of the powers of the bodies you have created.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Fissures
description_html: Your Shard works as a peculiar tool, fending off the regions Entities dare not tread, Earths or Universes not interactable nor usable for their [Cycle], soft-locked in a one-way street. These Earths or Universes contain such horrors or anomalies Entities maintain a wide berth between. They come to call those regions “The Abyss”. Their findings, however, led up to your power. You open and close destructive fissures that peer into The Abyss. Fissures are holes or doors to those regions, unstable portals that last seconds to milliseconds, yet are highly disastrous, with stable portals lasting from minutes to years, depending on the Earth/Universe’s intent; you consciously have to close those portals yourself, unless you welcome something unsurmountable. A Fissure varies in breadth and magnitude, dictating the amount of kinetic and explosive force (only smaller than a pinprick or a ball), with the signs of an imminent Fissure being: an overwhelming sense of dread, heightened electrostatic activity (tingling skin, hair standing on its end, a crackle sounding everywhere as if lightning’s about to strike), and the faint whispers from another world once it’s too late. When it appears, it overlaps space with ours, increasing density it spikes air pressure around the Fissure in a flash of light and sound, having the markings of an explosion for those around Fissures, ejecting those within to the space between worlds and replacing them with something from The Abyss. These… creatures will be a size and weight proportional to the person taken, possess cognitohazardous effects, and aggressively tamper with electronics. You can fine-tune the duration and stability of your Fissures and automatically control what pops in them. Using this power is a careful line you do not cross. For things in the Abyss want to reach out.

raw_text_safe.title: Eradication

addons.title: The Door is Opened…
addons.description_html:
You’re now a living Fissure, a gateway to the horrors of the Multiverse the Entities tried to imprison to no avail. Your Breaker state now refracts and fractures reality destructively, manifesting the worst possibilities and never-before horrific dimensions you’re transformed into, causing several boons for what’s worth.

You can teleport via the Abyss as long you understand the time and place of where you end up, first passing through one of the Abyss’ Earths at the same spacetime placement you wished to go, with the option of creating the Fissure’s characteristic aftereffects; as you are a living Door for the Abyss, you might invite creature and lifeforms from these dimensions, using your Breaker state as a gateway, while also somewhat able to Master them into submission for later control and banishment.

It also acts defensively: anything that harms you, the Abyss responds in kind, for example, the explosive yields of missiles and artillery are absorbed into the Abyss and are then expelled in exotic radioactive shockwaves, anyone reaching your gaping doorway will be pulled through the Abyss’ phenomena to be either irreparably damaged or never to be seen again.

raw_object_text_safe.text: Your Shard works as a peculiar tool, fending off the regions Entities dare not tread, Earths or Universes not interactable nor usable for their [Cycle], soft-locked in a one-way street. These Earths or Universes contain such horrors or anomalies Entities maintain a wide berth between. They come to call those regions “The Abyss”. Their findings, however, led up to your power. You open and close destructive fissures that peer into The Abyss. Fissures are holes or doors to those regions, unstable portals that last seconds to milliseconds, yet are highly disastrous, with stable portals lasting from minutes to years, depending on the Earth/Universe’s intent; you consciously have to close those portals yourself, unless you welcome something unsurmountable. A Fissure varies in breadth and magnitude, dictating the amount of kinetic and explosive force (only smaller than a pinprick or a ball), with the signs of an imminent Fissure being: an overwhelming sense of dread, heightened electrostatic activity (tingling skin, hair standing on its end, a crackle sounding everywhere as if lightning’s about to strike), and the faint whispers from another world once it’s too late. When it appears, it overlaps space with ours, increasing density it spikes air pressure around the Fissure in a flash of light and sound, having the markings of an explosion for those around Fissures, ejecting those within to the space between worlds and replacing them with something from The Abyss. These… creatures will be a size and weight proportional to the person taken, possess cognitohazardous effects, and aggressively tamper with electronics. You can fine-tune the duration and stability of your Fissures and automatically control what pops in them. Using this power is a careful line you do not cross. For things in the Abyss want to reach out.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Fissures

title: (Breaker) Kaleidoscopic Fractural Flowering Lens
description_html:
Upon entering your Breaker state, you cease to be a singular entity and become a dimensional wound, a living rift where space itself splinters apart. The world around you shatters like glass, each fragment reflecting an ever-shifting kaleidoscope of alternate realities—as its structure bends and unravels in your presence.

Any force directed at you—be it physical, energetic, or otherwise—is absorbed, multiplied, and violently expelled in unpredictable directions. The way this manifests depends on whether the object passing through is inanimate or living.

A bullet fired at you will phase through your fractured form, slipping into countless alternate dimensions where it is copied, distorted, and redirected. When it finally erupts back into reality, it does so in a chaotic burst, appearing from multiple angles at once, altered in shape, velocity, or even composition. This turns any attempt to harm you into an unpredictable hazard for everyone nearby.

However, a living being that attempts to touch or strike you suffers something far worse. The moment their limb enters your fractured existence, it is pulled—into the chaotic tides of diverging realities. For an instant—or what feels like an eternity—it exists everywhere at once, experiencing the countless environments and forces of those splintered worlds. When it re-emerges into your anchored reality, it does so violently, splitting into a bloom of fractured limbs—temporary echoes of itself extending from your dimensional wound, all still tethered to the original body.

Every sensation these scattered limbs endure—every burn, freeze, crush, or twist—is fed back into the prime self simultaneously. This overwhelming sensory overload leaves them disoriented, their mind drowning in a flood of conflicting experiences. The effect lingers for a week before the echoes fade, but the trauma of enduring countless fragmented realities never truly disappears.

If their entire body is forced through you before a part is refracted back—they suffer something even more catastrophic. As their prime self is displaced, and flung into a random alternate dimension, while hollow echoes of their form emerge across countless fractured worlds. These are not mere copies but extensions of the original, all controlled by the same mind. Each one experiences a different reality, all at once, their thoughts and senses feeding back to the prime self in a deluge of conflicting input.

However, this is not a gift but a curse—as their mind alone bears the full weight of these experiences, unassisted with no help from their Shard, forcing them to live through these countless vessels simultaneously. Few can withstand this. Most are left broken, their consciousness unraveling under the strain. And while these echoes dissolve after a week, their original body remains lost in an unknown world, with no clear path home.

Lastly, this state grants you a unique mastery over light—though not sunlight. Any beam that enters your fractured form is refracted, intensified, and then unleashed in a dazzling burst. Unlike everything else that passes through you, you alone dictate where these beams emerge, allowing you to shape them with precision. Even the faint glow of a weak flashlight can be twisted—into a deadly weapon, its scattered rays striking with enough force to shatter stone.

title: (Master/Shaker) Cognitivore
description_html:
You consume the minds of cognitive beings to enhance and expand your own mental abilities. This process doesn’t involve physically devouring brains, but rather absorbing the cognitive essence, knowledge, memories, experiences, and mental energy of your targets. Those you feed on are left brain-dead, their minds hollowed out and their consciousness erased. If you consume only a portion of their cognitive essence or if the target has exceptional mental resilience, recovery is possible.

At the beginning, this manifests as accelerated thought processes, allowing you to analyse situations with incredible speed, make split-second decisions, and process complex information effortlessly. Your memory becomes near-perfect, capable of recalling even the smallest details with crystal clarity, and you can juggle multiple lines of thought simultaneously without confusion or fatigue.

As you continue to absorb more minds, your mental capabilities evolve beyond the limits of normal human cognition. You’ll reach a critical point—a bottleneck—where your brain undergoes a transformation. This is when your abilities shift from enhanced intellect to true psychic phenomena. You begin to perceive the hidden layers of consciousness, sensing the emotions and surface thoughts of those around you with ease. With further growth, you can establish telepathic links, allowing you to communicate silently and instantly over great distances.

Eventually, your mind’s influence extends beyond thought alone. You develop telekinetic abilities, enabling you to move, manipulate, or even crush objects with sheer willpower. The more cognitive energy you consume, the stronger these powers become, potentially allowing you to reshape your environment, control multiple objects at once, and exert influence over both minds and matter.

addons.title: Going Hollow
addons.description_html:
You consume not just thoughts and emotions, but the fragile threads that bind them—memories woven with feelings, identities anchored by both cognition and sentiment. Your hunger seeps into the deepest layers of the mind, devouring the very connection between who a person is and how they feel. By feeding on someone’s thoughts, you strip away the emotions tied to their memories and beliefs. Conversely, draining intense emotions allows you to unravel the cognitive structures built around them. This creates a vicious feedback loop: erasing one weakens the other until nothing remains.

Victims of your hunger aren’t left as simple empty shells; they become hollows; brain-dead, mindless husks with active bodies, entirely under your control. They retain basic motor functions but possess no will or awareness of their own. They exist only to carry out your commands; without explicit instructions, they will stand idle, even neglecting fundamental needs like eating or sleeping, eventually wasting away if left unattended.

Your regurgitation is no longer out of your control, and the fluid can now be a manifestation of everything you’ve devoured—not just raw emotions, but thoughts, memories, and desires distilled into a tangible, liquid form. This psychic substance is potent and dangerous; anyone who ingests it experiences an overwhelming surge of whatever essence it contains, whether it’s the clarity of a stolen memory, the burning drive of a devoured desire, or the free spirit of a dream. However, creating this fluid results in less growth and power from the original act of feeding.

addons.title: Psych Ward
addons.description_html:
Your mind now grows without limit, evolving even in the absence of external stimuli. The process that once required the consumption of other minds now unfolds naturally, though devouring cognitive beings still accelerates your development exponentially, flooding your consciousness with new pathways, insights, and raw psychic potential.

Your consciousness no longer resides solely within you; it stretches outward, saturating the world around you with psychic influence. In areas saturated by your psychic imprint, your abilities grow stronger, more precise, and significantly harder for others to resist, as if reality itself bends more easily to your will within these domains.

Even death cannot sever your hold on existence. If your body is destroyed, your mind persists as an independent, disembodied force—a living echo untethered by flesh. In this state, you can infiltrate the consciousness of others, embedding fragments of yourself within their minds. Given time, these fragments grow, corrupting and overwriting the host’s identity until you are reborn, reshaped by the vessel but retaining your essence.

However, this form of existence is not without limits. Without anchoring yourself to a physical body or remaining within areas marked by your psychic imprint, your consciousness begins to fade over time. The absence of a vessel or a tethered domain weakens your presence, eroding your mind into scattered echoes until nothing of you remains—just lingering fragments lost in the vast mental landscape you once dominated.

addons.title: Psionic Engine
addons.description_html:
Your hunger no longer stops at consuming minds; it now fuels an ever-expanding reservoir of psionic potential. Every thought, memory, emotion, or cognitive imprint you devour doesn’t just grant you fleeting insight—it becomes a permanent part of your evolving arsenal. The minds you consume act as blueprints, allowing you to intuitively reconstruct and refine abilities they had as psionic techniques.

You now possess a second energy reservoir—one with no upper limit, but which cannot replenish itself naturally. This pool is filled exclusively by converting the raw cognitive essence of what you consume into psionic energy. Cognitive material turned into psionic energy can no longer be used to grow or enhance your own mind.

Lastly you gain the ability to overload your psionic techniques, pushing them beyond their natural limitations. Overloaded abilities manifest with exponentially greater force, range, and complexity—transforming simple telekinetic blasts into city-level shockwaves or turning momentary mental intrusions into complete, instant domination. The only limit is the fuel you’re willing to burn.

addons.title: Recursive Wrinkles
addons.description_html: Your increased neural density and brain complexity compound with your burgeoning psychic prowess, qualitatively enhancing all effects Cognitivore can produce, from the speed you drain cognitive essence to the strength and control of your ability to affect physical reality with just your mind. More impressive however is the effect gathering cognitive essence has. When you gather cognitive energy your brain grows, forming more neurons and wrinkles and strengthening the effects of Opposite of A Smooth Brain. This has no upper limit, so if you absorb enough cognitive energy your brain can end up a recursive fractal, minorly warping space-time to grow endlessly denser and more complex. This forms a feedback loop which effectively doubles returns as absorbing cognitive provides the usual benefits but also strengthens Opposite of A Smooth Brain which in turn amplifies the benefits of Cognitivore even more. This is multiplicative and scales incredibly highly, meaning that with enough neural complexity you can perform feats like ripping buildings apart on a molecular level or creating shockwaves strong enough to level city blocks. If you possess Psych Ward then the passive cognitive improvement from it also applies, your brain passively growing ever more powerful.

This forms a feedback loop which effectively doubles returns as absorbing cognitive provides the usual benefits but also strengthens Opposite of A Smooth Brain which in turn amplifies the benefits of Cognitivore even more. This is multiplicative and scales incredibly highly, meaning that with enough neural complexity you can perform feats like ripping buildings apart on a molecular level or creating shockwaves strong enough to level city blocks. addons.description_html: You are capable of using the brains of everything under your control as extensions of your own mind, a distributed network of neural nodes. This allows you to draw on the cognitive energy and processing power of beings under your control, enabling feats of much greater strength than if you were merely using your own mental strength. The power you can draw from something is dependent on its own mental prowess.

addons.text:
You consume not just thoughts and emotions, but the fragile threads that bind them—memories woven with feelings, identities anchored by both cognition and sentiment. Your hunger seeps into the deepest layers of the mind, devouring the very connection between who a person is and how they feel. By feeding on someone’s thoughts, you strip away the emotions tied to their memories and beliefs. Conversely, draining intense emotions allows you to unravel the cognitive structures built around them. This creates a vicious feedback loop: erasing one weakens the other until nothing remains.

Victims of your hunger aren’t left as simple empty shells; they become hollows; brain-dead, mindless husks with active bodies, entirely under your control. They retain basic motor functions but possess no will or awareness of their own. They exist only to carry out your commands; without explicit instructions, they will stand idle, even neglecting fundamental needs like eating or sleeping, eventually wasting away if left unattended.

Your regurgitation is no longer out of your control, and the fluid can now be a manifestation of everything you’ve devoured—not just raw emotions, but thoughts, memories, and desires distilled into a tangible, liquid form. This psychic substance is potent and dangerous; anyone who ingests it experiences an overwhelming surge of whatever essence it contains, whether it’s the clarity of a stolen memory, the burning drive of a devoured desire, or the free spirit of a dream. However, creating this fluid results in less growth and power from the original act of feeding.
addons.title: Going Hollow

addons.text:
Your mind now grows without limit, evolving even in the absence of external stimuli. The process that once required the consumption of other minds now unfolds naturally, though devouring cognitive beings still accelerates your development exponentially, flooding your consciousness with new pathways, insights, and raw psychic potential.

Your consciousness no longer resides solely within you; it stretches outward, saturating the world around you with psychic influence. In areas saturated by your psychic imprint, your abilities grow stronger, more precise, and significantly harder for others to resist, as if reality itself bends more easily to your will within these domains.

Even death cannot sever your hold on existence. If your body is destroyed, your mind persists as an independent, disembodied force—a living echo untethered by flesh. In this state, you can infiltrate the consciousness of others, embedding fragments of yourself within their minds. Given time, these fragments grow, corrupting and overwriting the host’s identity until you are reborn, reshaped by the vessel but retaining your essence.

However, this form of existence is not without limits. Without anchoring yourself to a physical body or remaining within areas marked by your psychic imprint, your consciousness begins to fade over time. The absence of a vessel or a tethered domain weakens your presence, eroding your mind into scattered echoes until nothing of you remains—just lingering fragments lost in the vast mental landscape you once dominated.
addons.title: Psych Ward

addons.text:
Your hunger no longer stops at consuming minds; it now fuels an ever-expanding reservoir of psionic potential. Every thought, memory, emotion, or cognitive imprint you devour doesn’t just grant you fleeting insight—it becomes a permanent part of your evolving arsenal. The minds you consume act as blueprints, allowing you to intuitively reconstruct and refine abilities they had as psionic techniques.

You now possess a second energy reservoir—one with no upper limit, but which cannot replenish itself naturally. This pool is filled exclusively by converting the raw cognitive essence of what you consume into psionic energy. Cognitive material turned into psionic energy can no longer be used to grow or enhance your own mind.

Lastly you gain the ability to overload your psionic techniques, pushing them beyond their natural limitations. Overloaded abilities manifest with exponentially greater force, range, and complexity—transforming simple telekinetic blasts into city-level shockwaves or turning momentary mental intrusions into complete, instant domination. The only limit is the fuel you’re willing to burn.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You consume the minds of cognitive beings to enhance and expand your own mental abilities. This process doesn’t involve physically devouring brains, but rather absorbing the cognitive essence, knowledge, memories, experiences, and mental energy of your targets. Those you feed on are left brain-dead, their minds hollowed out and their consciousness erased. If you consume only a portion of their cognitive essence or if the target has exceptional mental resilience, recovery is possible.

At the beginning, this manifests as accelerated thought processes, allowing you to analyse situations with incredible speed, make split-second decisions, and process complex information effortlessly. Your memory becomes near-perfect, capable of recalling even the smallest details with crystal clarity, and you can juggle multiple lines of thought simultaneously without confusion or fatigue.

As you continue to absorb more minds, your mental capabilities evolve beyond the limits of normal human cognition. You’ll reach a critical point—a bottleneck—where your brain undergoes a transformation. This is when your abilities shift from enhanced intellect to true psychic phenomena. You begin to perceive the hidden layers of consciousness, sensing the emotions and surface thoughts of those around you with ease. With further growth, you can establish telepathic links, allowing you to communicate silently and instantly over great distances.

Eventually, your mind’s influence extends beyond thought alone. You develop telekinetic abilities, enabling you to move, manipulate, or even crush objects with sheer willpower. The more cognitive energy you consume, the stronger these powers become, potentially allowing you to reshape your environment, control multiple objects at once, and exert influence over both minds and matter.

title: (Trump) Constellations
description_html:
You can manifest tiny miniatures of existing stars that compose constellations and link them together in order to recreate their constellations. They can be manifested on either your surroundings, your body, or both.

Those constellations can be used to manifest a variety of effects based on them, while you can direct the effects some aspects are fixed and you are limited to a single interpretation per constellation at a time—this doesn't limit how many constellations you can use at once, just how many effects you could manifest from single constellation. Using Sagittarius as a example: You could shoot normal arrows that hit exactly where you want to, or instead shoot arrows made of boiling water basing it on the Teapot Asterism that can be found in constellation, or even base it on how Sagittarius in Astrology are said to be natural explorers and thus manifest arrows that lead you to somewhere you want to go by leaving behind a trail; or you could inspire yourself with Nergal and manifest wings out of the constellation in order to fly, since the effects originate from the constellations it would need to be in your back.

As might be obvious by now, without applying symbolism or knowing their composition your stars will be nothing but pretty lights. With 88 constellations to draw power from and countless ways to interpret then you have gained a very versatile ability, you might end up becoming obsessed with the stars but hey, that's a small price to pay for power.

(Note: If you are in a place where none of the 88 Constellations exist in order to learn them, your Shard will slowly drip feed you knowledge about them in order to allow you to use your power and will also allow you to use the local equivalent of the Constellations.)

title: (Tinker/Changer) Will Make Real Tinkers Mad
description_html:
You can now grow Tinkertech designs out of your body. To do this, you designate parts of your body with a ‘Tinker specialty’, these can range from a single hand to an entire limb, each of which is able to operate their ‘specialty’ independently to a maximum of seven independent ‘zones’. Each of these ‘zones’ will then begin to grow technology within them matching the ‘specialty’ chosen. The longer a zone has the same specialty, the more dense and layered the technology will be, operating new functions and modes.

For instance, you can select a ‘Gun’ specialty within your arm, and expect continued development of firearm technologies, laser cannons, aiming assistance and so forth within it. These will continue to grow, and cannot be stopped, eventually completely subsuming the limb and making it very difficult to fully utilise outside of its specialty. 

Changing the specialty causes the non-relevant technology within the zone to jettison itself from your body, your flesh quickly regenerating around where it was. Any of this technology is treated as regular, if damaged, tinkertec and is unlikely to be useful unless repaired or reattached with an appropriate specialty. Any technology that fits within the new specialty can remain, though stringent links will cause loss of efficiency within these pieces.

addons.title: My Power Does The Workshopping For Me
addons.description_html: Now instead of having the Tinkertech appendage fall off in the case of incompatible specialties you can instead shunt off the old one entirely into another space. title: (Master) Grave Caller
description_html:
You gain the ability to revive beings who died. But you need to spend a special energy to do so which you only gain by killing other sentient beings and burying them in the ground. While you have to personally bury the corpses, you can kill by indirect methods like paying others to kill for you or spreading diseases. The amount of energy gained depends on the fame and reputation they have obtained during their lives, so killing a famous hero or celebrity would net you enough energy to revive several non-remarkable people. But this is also true in reverse, as reviving a well-known historical figure could cost the lives of thousands.

The energy gained is also affected by the emotional investment towards the killed being, so a widely beloved or hated person will give much more compared to a person who is just known by a lot of people, but nobody really cares about them.

The revived beings will always be perfectly loyal and servile towards you, and they are mastered in a way where their personality will morph to gain an overwhelming respect and gratitude towards you for being revived, making their new purpose in life to serve you. The revived will always return to the form and age they were most famous for.

If you are Shardless/Negentropic, then those who are revived will be affected by their reputation gaining minor powers in line with them, or even have their original powers boosted and/or changed in minor ways to fit their history.

Finally, if you have Homecoming, it becomes possible to revive dead fictional beings by reaching into their universe, but their cost will be calculated based on their fame in their original setting.

title: (Master) Elemental Snakes
description_html:
You can summon up to 200 flying Snakes made from common elements such as earth, water, fire, and wind, and more basic esoteric ones such as light or shadow. Those snakes are controlled with your mind similar to how Skitter controls bugs alongside a small multitasking power to help with control. Those snakes all can control the element they are made from akin to a mid-T1 shaker/blaster power each, shooting a fireball or razor-sharp wind wave.

Those snakes also have the physical strength to lift a normal car on their own, and the only way to kill one is to injure them with an opposing element such as Water for Fire or Wind for Earth. You also can combine multiple snakes of the same element as one giant snake named a ‘Basilisk’ that has the power of a mid-tier shaker/blaster power but at the cost of the snakes making it up dying as the cost of the transformation is too much for them, resulting in the transformation lasting only 10 minutes if you were to use all of your snakes.

Negentropy lets you summon 100 more snakes, and Esoteric Knowledge lets you make snakes of even more esoteric elements like Time and Shardless give you both.

title: (Shaker/Trump) Pseudoscientific Manifestation
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to actualise any form of pseudoscientific belief into your immediate surroundings. These effects have various intensities, but clearly suffer from a form of Manton Limit, vastly reducing their effectiveness on living beings.

The effects you can cause range from minor ‘mastering’ alterations to someone’s behaviour from their astrological sign to changing the entire flow of a fight by applying feng-shui and negative energies to the room you’re in.

As you learn more of these pseudosciences you could begin manifesting energy vampirism, Electrogravitics, or Free Energy theories, making you a bane and boon to Tinkers and Thinkers everywhere.

title: (Thinker) I Know You Better Than You Know Yourself
description_html: With a single glance, you know and more importantly, understand, everything about a person; from their personality, their quirks, their deepest darkest secret, to why they act with arrogance, why they have a love of the color purple, to even how they’ll react or interpret something, even if entirely abstract. This isn’t merely a question of knowing them and what they’ve been through but a true understanding of them at the deepest level, and this in turn, can be used to make you their greatest ally, seeing every flaw and able to help them, or their worst enemy, able to predict their every move before they are ever able to even think of making it. This can be toggled between needing an intentional activation or left to act passively. Moreover, the power works on both the conscious and subconscious level; it won’t overload you with information—instead, it’ll slip in and meld with your understanding and comprehension of people as if you had always known them. This comes with an inherent understanding and supernatural skill at how to best utilize this knowledge. This also updates anytime you interact with them in any manner.

addons.title: Know It All

raw_object_text_safe.text: With a single glance, you know and more importantly, understand, everything about a person; from their personality, their quirks, their deepest darkest secret, to why they act with arrogance, why they have a love of the color purple, to even how they’ll react or interpret something, even if entirely abstract. This isn’t merely a question of knowing them and what they’ve been through but a true understanding of them at the deepest level, and this in turn, can be used to make you their greatest ally, seeing every flaw and able to help them, or their worst enemy, able to predict their every move before they are ever able to even think of making it. This can be toggled between needing an intentional activation or left to act passively. Moreover, the power works on both the conscious and subconscious level; it won’t overload you with information—instead, it’ll slip in and meld with your understanding and comprehension of people as if you had always known them. This comes with an inherent understanding and supernatural skill at how to best utilize this knowledge. This also updates anytime you interact with them in any manner.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Thinker) I Know You Better Than You Know Yourself

title: (Striker/Shaker) Born Again
description_html:
You can now revive anyone who has died, as long as you have access to their biological material.

By touching the deceased’s biological material, you can form a cocoon around it, which rapidly develops into a restored version of the person. This process typically takes one day. The revived individual returns with all their memories and in their physical prime, free from any debilitating diseases or birth defects. If the person was a Parahuman, they would also regain their powers unless their shard had chosen a new host and was unwilling to support multiple hosts. Additionally, you can use this ability to heal the sick and injured if you wish.

Once per day, you can expand this power into an area-of-effect revival, forming cocoons around all deceased individuals within a ten-mile radius. This mass resurrection brings all the cocoons directly to your vicinity and completes the revival process within seconds, but it leaves you severely exhausted.

If you possess esoteric knowledge or a shardless power, this ability becomes a true resurrection, restoring not only the body but also the soul of the deceased. Furthermore, your revival range and usage limit may increase.

title: (Breaker/Blaster) Flame On
description_html:
You are able to excite the particles that make up your body, rapidly increasing your temperature until you become a living plasma generator. As you activate your power, the molecules within you vibrate at extreme speeds, producing temperatures ranging from 1,500 to over 10,000 K (2,200–17,540°F). At lower intensities, your body burns like an open flame, igniting materials on contact. When fully unleashed, you transition into a state similar to ionized plasma, glowing with the blinding brilliance of a solar flare. In this form, you are not just burning—you are radiating intense electromagnetic energy, from visible light to infrared and even high-energy ultraviolet radiation. This radiant heat alone can ignite flammable objects within meters of your presence, and prolonged activation may cause the ground beneath you to melt into slag.

Your body passively excites surrounding gas molecules, creating an ionized plasma field that extends outward. You can exert control over the excited particles around you, allowing for directed bursts of flame and controlled propulsion. By pulling in and energising atmospheric gases, you create self-sustaining jets of superheated plasma that grant you flight, functioning similarly to an advanced rocket propulsion system. The force of this expelled plasma generates enough thrust to keep you airborne. You can launch concentrated blasts of fire that exceed 20,000 K (35,540°F), hot enough to momentarily rival the temperature of a nuclear explosion in localized bursts. These projectiles do not simply burn—they carry enough energy to ionise matter on impact, breaking molecular bonds and causing structural disintegration. The sheer intensity of your attacks means even indirect exposure can cause severe burns, while electronics within close proximity may fail due to electromagnetic interference.

You can make the surrounding air rapidly superheat, creating thermal updrafts that can escalate into firestorms, with hurricane-force winds feeding the inferno you leave in your wake. At extreme output, your body radiates X-rays and other ionizing emissions, making prolonged use hazardous not only to enemies but to bystanders and even yourself without proper control. To sustain this level of energy without burning yourself to ash, you have a form of heat resistance through a specialised energy field that prevents your molecules from succumbing to the same incineration you unleash on the world.

addons.title: Torch It
addons.description_html:
Your ability to excite particles has evolved into something far more destructive—you now weaken molecular bonds upon contact, causing materials to degrade and collapse at an accelerated rate. Anything exposed to your flames or plasma doesn’t just burn; it crumbles, disintegrating into embers and dust as its structural integrity is forcibly unraveled.

This effect extends to anything within your plasma field, meaning even near misses from your fire or heat waves can compromise structures, corrode metals, and cause reinforced barriers to fracture and fail. Living beings suffer more than burns—cellular bonds weaken, flesh loses cohesion, and bones become brittle as their very structure destabilizes. Even flame-resistant or energy-based defenses offer little protection, as your power does not simply destroy through heat, but through fundamental decay.

With precision, you can apply this effect selectively, allowing you to cut through armor and obstacles while leaving surrounding areas untouched. However, at full intensity, your power can turn battlefields into wastelands of molten slag and drifting embers, making prolonged engagements hazardous even to yourself.

addons.title: Supernova!
addons.description_html: Your power no longer merely generates heat—it reshapes the very behavior of excited particles, turning them into catalysts for an unstoppable chain reaction. Whenever you excite matter, it begins to pull in neutral particles while repelling others that are also excited, spreading the reaction outward in a self-sustaining cascade. Each new particle that falls into this state gains the same properties, compounding the effect and increasing the overall energy of the system. The more energy you pour into an event, the further and faster the ignition spreads, allowing you to precisely control whether you are merely igniting a single target or triggering a planet-wide inferno. Given enough power, even the sky is not safe—entire atmospheres can become a roiling sea of plasma, ionizing in great waves that expand until nothing remains untouched. Unlike normal combustion, this reaction does not rely on fuel or oxygen; it is a fundamental shift in how energy propagates, making even typically inert substances vulnerable to destruction. At its most extreme, this cascading excitation warps physics itself. As the reaction accelerates, highly energized areas gain unnatural density, creating pockets of localized gravitational collapse that pull in surrounding mass like miniature stellar cores. The hottest regions become so dense that they begin to distort spacetime, leading to strange and unpredictable gravitational effects. If allowed to continue unchecked, the energy buildup can reach a point of no return, where the sheer mass and pressure within a single ignition site force it into a new state of matter—one that can collapse into a singularity or erupt into a new star. The end result depends on the scale of the reaction and how much control you exert over its growth. However, if you do not have Negentropy, your shard will rapidly exhaust itself and burn out, perhaps even burning itself from your flames.

addons.title: White Hole Incarnate
addons.description_html: You have become a thermodynamic singularity, the living embodiment of a white hole. Unlike black holes, which consume matter and energy, you are a constant, inexhaustible eruption of heat and radiation, an unstoppable force pushing outward against the universe itself. At will, you can unleash this power, turning your body into an unrelenting source of energy that expels waves of plasma, electromagnetic radiation, and raw heat at levels beyond comprehension. This energy surge does not require fuel, nor does it diminish over time. Matter caught in your presence does not simply burn—it is forcibly disintegrated, pushed apart at the atomic level, expelled from cohesion itself. However, this effect is fully under your control, allowing you to scale the intensity of your emissions or suppress them entirely. When activated, your presence warps the battlefield into a roiling inferno of superheated plasma and gravitational repulsion, making it all but impossible for anything to approach you without being hurled away or obliterated. You can generate incomprehensible thermal pulses and ionization storms, emitting bursts of gamma rays and X-ray radiation strong enough to scramble electronics, overload sensors, and create luminous, fiery shockwaves visible for miles. You do not simply set fire to your surroundings—you rewrite the flow of energy itself, causing cascading chain reactions that send unstoppable waves of heat and radiation across entire battlefields. At your highest output, your plasma emissions burn so intensely that they can be seen from orbit, and the very air itself ignites into expanding sheets of nuclear fire. Unlike natural phenomena, your energy does not diffuse or settle—it only grows, spreading outward indefinitely unless consciously controlled. The sheer intensity of your output means even distant observers risk exposure to deadly radiation, and prolonged use could transform entire regions into inhospitable wastelands. However, if you do not have Negentropy, your shard will rapidly exhaust itself and burn out, unable to sustain the relentless cosmic blaze that defines your existence.

title: (Brute/Trump) Criminality
description_html: Whenever you commit a crime or break a law your everything is enhanced. Skills, powers, body, and etc. The greater the crime the bigger the boost, with the severity and context diminishing or increasing said boost. As such, you could gleefully murder a innocent person and receive a 50% boost, or jaywalk and receive a 1% boost. The laws that are used are the ones from wherever you were born and the location you are in.

title: (Brute/Trump) Non-Newtonian Force
description_html: You can freely violate Newton's Third Law of Motion, which states that "for every action force exerted, there is an equal and opposite reaction force". You are capable of reducing or outright negating the reaction force for any force you directly produce. For example, you could casually push your hand through a two-foot-thick metal wall like melted butter, facing no resistance, deliver powerful blows with no recoil or lift objects far heavier than your body should be capable of simply by reducing the pressure pushing back against you. This is not just limited to kinetic energy but applies to any physical force you directly exert, whether via your body or your powers. You could unleash unstoppable Blaster effects that pierce without losing momentum or move through matter in an electrical Breaker form with zero resistance. You have perfect innate control over this power and how it manifests, preventing you from accidentally sinking straight down into the earth's core or losing traction when walking. This power cancels out against other All-or-Nothing abilities, with both effects mutually nullifying one another. However, this power only applies to the action forces that you directly produce, so any external force inflicted on you will still operate exactly as expected. In essence, your actions are an unstoppable force but you remain a very moveable object.

For example, you could casually push your hand through a two-foot-thick metal wall like melted butter, facing no resistance, deliver powerful blows with no recoil or lift objects far heavier than your body should be capable of simply by reducing the pressure pushing back against you. This is not just limited to kinetic energy but applies to any physical force you directly exert, whether via your body or your powers. You could unleash unstoppable Blaster effects that pierce without losing momentum or move through matter in an electrical Breaker form with zero resistance. You have perfect innate control over this power and how it manifests, preventing you from accidentally sinking straight down into the earth's core or losing traction when walking. This power cancels out against other All-or-Nothing abilities, with both effects mutually nullifying one another. However, this power only applies to the action forces that you directly produce, so any external force inflicted on you will still operate exactly as expected. In essence, your actions are an unstoppable force but you remain a very moveable object.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Brute/Trump) Non-Newtonian Force

title: (Trump) Yomotsugaeri
description_html:
Should you perish at the hands of a parahuman, whether through a direct application of their power, a tinker device, or something more roundabout, you can use your opponent's power to resurrect yourself.

After you die, you will have a few moments of clarity, allowing you to choose which power to use as a resurrection vector—in case there were numerous attackers that contributed to your demise—as well as mentally recuperate from the pain and trauma of death.

During the resurrection, your body will be completely remade by your opponent's power, giving you an existence akin to an autonomous, self-sustaining ability, complete with the power reminiscent of the one that killed you that will persist for as long as your new form does. Depending on the exact power of your opponent, your new body and the manner in which you resurrect can be rather bizarre. For example, getting killed by Jack Slash may see you reborn as a collection of wavelengths transmitting cutting force; you may become a living information when killed by Tattletale; and getting killed by a tinker may cause their shard to force them to build a new body for you. As part of your opponent's power is diverted to sustain your form, their own power becomes significantly weaker.

After resurrection, you become immune to the direct application of the power you now embody, as well as similar powers, although you are not invulnerable and can still be damaged and even killed through indirect means or other powers. Should the same parahuman successfully kill you a second time when you embody their power, your form will become even stronger, with their power weakening once more. After a few of your deaths, they may be left completely powerless. On the other hand, should you be killed by a completely different parahuman, your form will be discarded, and a new one will be created based on the new opponent's power.

Do note that you can still be killed by a normal unpowered person or someone immune to having their power tampered with, like an Endbringer. And unless you possess some other means of resurrection, this death will be final.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Scale Model
description_html:
You can produce a singular 1 m<sup>3</sup> cube that contains a real-time scale model of any area that you are aware of. This projection is perfect, replicating the landscape, people and objects exactly as they exist in the real world.

By interacting with the model, you can remotely physically affect the corresponding location. Actions such as lifting a diminutive car with your hand or setting a tiny door on fire with your lighter will cause the real-world counterpart to experience equivalent results. The projection can be created and dismissed at will.

To observers in the affected area, these changes appear to be the work of an invisible, untouchable entity. You could manipulate furniture as though playing with a dollhouse or crush a miniaturised figure, simultaneously flattening them in reality. This can include your current surroundings, aiding in reconnaissance or combat.

The model’s scale can be freely adjusted, from 1:1 up to a 1:24 ratio, determining how it corresponds to the real world. As such, your projected model can cover a maximum space of up to 24x24x24 metres in size, enough to encompass a small apartment block. This power has no inherent range limit beyond standard shard constraints.

Only physical phenomena can be transmitted through this power, such as kinetic force, combustion, electricity etc, preventing more abstract phenomena, namely parahuman abilities like Trump or Master effects, from being directly channelled.

title: (Blaster/Trump) Se Adapta
description_html: In between your knuckles are a series of holes, from these holes you can fire barbed needles at high speeds. These needles are barbed and designed to shatter on impact with armour, turning into microscopic shrapnel to be breathed in. When these barbs make their way into a body, they begin to secrete a liquifying agent. Starting from the wound outwards (potentially from inside their lungs if fragments are inhaled), the victim begins to liquify then crystallise, with nothing short of amputation able to stop the spread. When completely crystallised the body begins to act spontaneously, under the direction not of you directly, but your Shard, responding to your emotions and impulses. When a living organism is crystalised, your Shard is able to act through it with impunity, and with far less restrictions than through its host, essentially allowing the Shard to express itself in any number of alternate ways aligning with its purpose, albeit limited to its original ‘level’ of power expenditure (and thus being far less than a speculative Titan counterpart). How this will express in your case depends almost entirely on other powers you possess. By default, however, your shard exists to sabotage Data collection, with most of its expressions specifically being devised to baffle traditional Entity collection methods. When the spines impact another Parahuman, after crystallising, their Shard is able to act through the host in much the same way as your own, but unlike normal crystallised humans, you will not have control over this one, leaving it free to its own devices. As the Shard continues to act through its Host however, it will begin to find its data corrupted, and its power waning as it expends more and more, eventually being fully siphoned of power to sustain the ‘avatar’ and your shard.

title: (Trump) As the Plot Demands
description_html:
Whenever you need or want it, you will spontaneously develop a Skill or Power at a level that, alone, would need a bit of effort to solve what you needed it for. Skills are capped at their possible limit while Powers are capped at 15 SP.

Always remember that, alone, those Powers/Skills can only deal with your situation if you put effort into it. You need to defeat someone wielding a Gun? You can now take a couple shots, so better make it count to strike them down. Need to hit a moving target? Increased Marksmanship that just needs you to be completely focused to be 100% accurate.

Those Powers/Skills are somewhat temporary but can stack with each other for greater effects. Essentially, there's three ways you can lose a Skill/Power: you solved what you gained them for, resulting in a 60% chance to lose them; you exited a conflict, with a 30% chance for each Skill/Power related to the situation; and finally, every 24 hours each of the Skills/Powers you gained have a 30% chance to disappear.

addons.title: Coddled by the Plot
addons.description_html:
You now constantly acquire new Skills or Powers that have the exact strength necessary to solve their reason of existence—though still limited by the SP cap—but where before you needed to desire or need something for them to develop, now merely existing is enough for your power to gift you Powers/Skills. You could lie in your bed and suddenly have the power to always be wearing comfortable clothes, or walk outside and not need sunscreen even on the sunniest of days.

These Skills/Powers are still bound to the three loss conditions.

title: (Changer/Brute) Here There be Dragons
description_html:
You can transform into a classical western dragon roughly 25.2 meters (88 feet) long from head to tail with a wingspan of 30.2 meters (99 feet), and a weight of 16 tons (32,000 lbs). This dragon form has scales of a color of your choice, and with a near-instantaneous shapeshift.

You can remain in your draconic form indefinitely and be unable to age when under this transformation, though you still age normally when in human form. You retain your full mental faculties and personality without being affected by your dragon form's instincts and biology.

Your dragon form has strength, durability, regeneration, and speed that rival the highest of Brutes. 

With strength comparable to Alexandria, you can effortlessly tear skyscrapers apart and flatten mountains, or fight Behemoth to a standstill. Unlike Alexandria, this physical strength originates from your abnormal physique. It does not come with a forcefield that allows you greater leverage or prevents objects from crumbling under their weight.

While you are not invincible, your durability allows you to walk off a point-blank nuclear explosion without scratching your scales, though All-or-Nothing effects will cleanly tear through your scales. To balance this, you possess an incredibly potent regeneration, allowing you to regenerate in seconds as long as your Corona Pollentia and Gemma are intact. This also makes you immune to non-tinkertech modified diseases, poisons, and radiation.

Your speed on land rivals that of modern supercars, approaching 300 km/h; it is nothing compared to the hypersonic flight speed you can reach. Even with your large and heavy body, you have near-perfect maneuverability, and your reaction time is enhanced to allow you to fully control even at extreme speeds.

Last but not least, you can breathe fire; you can control the amount of fire your breath expels from merely a campfire's worth to a level comparable to a volcanic eruption. However, you cannot control this fire after you breathe it, so be careful about accidentally burning down your house or the city it's in.

Your clothing and equipment are stored within a small pocket dimension when you are in your dragon form. When returning to your human form, your clothing and equipment return to the position and orientation they had when you originally changed forms. Optionally, you can prevent clothing and equipment from being stored. However, unless it takes your dragon form into account, whatever you wear or have on your person will most likely be destroyed.

While your draconic form has opposable thumbs on the two front legs, your overall fine control does not match your human form, dramatically reducing your ability to utilize tools in your dragon form.

addons.title: Why be Yourself When you can be a Dragon Instead
addons.description_html:
Rather than your Shard doing the work of turning you into a Dragon every time you use your power or manage your fire breath, it has instead modified your body to mutate into a dragon yourself through the development of unique organs skirting the edge of biological plausibility.

This leaves with a biological system that envelops your spinal column, extending from your cerebellum to the tailbone. The system spatially folds and contains the mass that your Dragon form has shunted the excess organic matter to a pocket space, shifting all its poundage to it, leaving you at your usual weight. Once changing into your form, clothing and equipment are then stored in said pocket space in return.

Your flammable breath is generated by glands between your respiratory system and larynx that synthesize a hyper-flammable chemical compound similar to gasoline or napalm, with another gland close to the larynx igniting this compound, achieving fire breath using the larynx’s stimulation as a trigger.

Your DNA is a wondrous composition of genetic information. Now, with a quad-helix structure, you are practically a different species, only tangentially related to modern humanity.

Your ability to passively mutate your body has grown to the point of allowing you to emulate simple Tier 1 powers. However, complex powers like Tinker powers, most Trump powers, and things like Dimensional, Temporal Manipulation or True Precognition are simply beyond you.

Your ability to passively mutate your body has grown to the point of allowing you to emulate simple Tier 1 powers. However, complex powers like Tinker powers, most Trump powers, and things like Dimensional, Temporal Manipulation or True Precognition are simply beyond you.

Rather than your Shard doing the work of turning you into a Dragon every time you use your power or manage your fire breath, it has instead modified your body to mutate into a dragon yourself through the development of unique organs skirting the edge of biological plausibility.

This leaves with a biological system that envelops your spinal column, extending from your cerebellum to the tailbone. The system spatially folds and contains the mass that your Dragon form has shunted the excess organic matter to a pocket space, shifting all its poundage to it, leaving you at your usual weight. Once changing into your form, clothing and equipment are then stored in said pocket space in return.

addons.title: Why be Yourself When you can be a Dragon Instead

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You can transform into a classical western dragon roughly 25.2 meters (88 feet) long from head to tail with a wingspan of 30.2 meters (99 feet), and a weight of 16 tons (32,000 lbs). This dragon form has scales of a color of your choice, and with a near-instantaneous shapeshift.

You can remain in your draconic form indefinitely and be unable to age when under this transformation, though you still age normally when in human form. You retain your full mental faculties and personality without being affected by your dragon form's instincts and biology.

Your dragon form has strength, durability, regeneration, and speed that rival the highest of Brutes. 

With strength comparable to Alexandria, you can effortlessly tear skyscrapers apart and flatten mountains, or fight Behemoth to a standstill. Unlike Alexandria, this physical strength originates from your abnormal physique. It does not come with a forcefield that allows you greater leverage or prevents objects from crumbling under their weight.

While you are not invincible, your durability allows you to walk off a point-blank nuclear explosion without scratching your scales, though All-or-Nothing effects will cleanly tear through your scales. To balance this, you possess an incredibly potent regeneration, allowing you to regenerate in seconds as long as your Corona Pollentia and Gemma are intact. This also makes you immune to non-tinkertech modified diseases, poisons, and radiation.

Your speed on land rivals that of modern supercars, approaching 300 km/h; it is nothing compared to the hypersonic flight speed you can reach. Even with your large and heavy body, you have near-perfect maneuverability, and your reaction time is enhanced to allow you to fully control even at extreme speeds.

Last but not least, you can breathe fire; you can control the amount of fire your breath expels from merely a campfire's worth to a level comparable to a volcanic eruption. However, you cannot control this fire after you breathe it, so be careful about accidentally burning down your house or the city it's in.

Your clothing and equipment are stored within a small pocket dimension when you are in your dragon form. When returning to your human form, your clothing and equipment return to the position and orientation they had when you originally changed forms. Optionally, you can prevent clothing and equipment from being stored. However, unless it takes your dragon form into account, whatever you wear or have on your person will most likely be destroyed.

While your draconic form has opposable thumbs on the two front legs, your overall fine control does not match your human form, dramatically reducing your ability to utilize tools in your dragon form.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Manifold Forms
description_html:
Every week, you gain a new form—each with a distinct appearance and unique set of powers. These forms are generated randomly, their features and traits often wildly different from your base form. This can range from being older, younger, of a different gender, or with entirely unfamiliar physical proportions and racial features. Despite these differences, each form remains biologically the same species as you, ensuring that you never shift into something non-human or entirely alien—no animals, no machines, no non-sapient lifeforms as long as you are human.

Each form has 5 SP worth of powers, randomly selected from your Shard’s catalog. These powers are exclusive to that form and are accompanied by 10 CP worth of complementary skills. The skills are tailored to match the form’s abilities and can range from combat, survival, performance, technical expertise, or something stranger.

In addition, every form comes with a generated backstory—memories, preferences, and personal context that was made up by your shard. While these memories don’t override your own, they can influence your instincts and behavior while in that form, making each transformation a shift not just in body, but in mindset.

You can store an unlimited number of forms, building a growing library of alternate selves. However, you can only transform into one form at a time. 

Staying in a form and practicing with it can improve its abilities. After roughly a month spent training in a specific form, that form gains 1 additional SP worth of power and 2 CP with of skills.

You start with zero forms.
