title: (Tinker) Madness Palace
description_html:
You are a Tinker whose mind is irrevocably linked—by accident, design, or cosmic oversight—to the [SHARD] Archive, an extra-dimensional, multi-temporal vault that stores fragmented, recursive knowledge siphoned from countless realities by the Shard Network. To you, this forbidden vault is known only as the Madness Palace—a labyrinth of half-remembered truths and broken blueprints never meant for human eyes. A stray permissions glitch gave you full access to its infinite halls, and every step deeper bends your mind further under its impossible weight.

At baseline, you’re already an accomplished Tinker, capable of building tech decades beyond contemporary human science—matching any mid-tier generalist in the field; however, that's just a very shallow and equally vast amount of knowledge curated by the [SHARD]. But with the Madness Palace, you reach far beyond mundane genius. You don’t receive intuitive designs the way normal Tinkers do. Instead, you mine corrupted data fragments, conflicting heuristics, and partial schematics buried in recursive logic. Making sense of it demands sheer brilliance—and invites creeping insanity.

Your specialty is meta-specialization. The Archive does not limit you to a single technological field; instead, you freely hybridize disciplines—splicing together physics-defying engines, mimicry frameworks, or power-channeling rigs once thought possible only for other Shards. The deeper you “dive” into the Palace, the stranger and stronger your creations become. But every deep dive leaves a mark: disorientation, obsessive thought loops, hallucinations, and the slow erosion of your stable identity. Dive too deep, too often, and you risk becoming a living query loop—a mind fragment endlessly running in the Archive’s backrooms.

All your Tinkertech is whiteboxed: you fully understand every twisted line of logic and can replicate your inventions at will. But your designs are so warped and layered that anyone else trying to reverse-engineer them risks mental collapse—rendering your work effectively blackboxed to everyone but you (or someone equally mad).

The Madness Palace doesn’t grant infinite time or perfect focus. Every session spent plumbing its depths erodes your sanity and identity, piece by piece. Shallow dives yield stable, reliable tech within normal Tinker boundaries. Deep dives promise world-breaking innovation—and the gnawing certainty that the Archive is not just feeding you data, but quietly learning from you in return.

In the end, you are an omnidirectional wildcard Tinker: your greatest strength is a vault of forbidden, cross-dimensional knowledge—and your greatest threat is the unraveling mind that must wield it.

addons.title: Sys-Shard Admin
addons.description_html:
By combining the recursive Archive access of Madness Palace with the precision engineering of Power Tinker, you gain administrator-level interaction with the Shard Network. Shards no longer appear as alien mysteries but as nodes in a vast system, each with functions, permissions, and processes that can be mapped, analyzed, and rewritten.

You can isolate a Shard’s active routines, expose hidden parameters, and edit the rules that shape its powers—restrictions, efficiency, trigger logic, or even the branching pathways of its growth. The Madness Palace provides the recursive heuristics to interpret this alien code, while your Tinkertech stabilizes the link long enough to enforce changes. This allows you to repair or stabilize failing Shards, hybridize abilities, forge artificial linkages, and even rewrite how triggers unfold.

These edits come with danger. Your bridges into shardspace rely on invasive, fragile methods—implants, neural rerouting, vat-brains—and each attempt risks drawing attention from defensive routines buried deep in the Network. Corruption, feedback loops, or parasitic data structures can destabilize both Shard and host. Worse, the recursive logic of the Madness Palace bleeds into your work, threatening to erode your mind until you become less a Tinker and more an administrative process endlessly running in shardspace.

addons.title: Photonic Crystals Cluster
addons.description_html:
Your mind no longer needs to directly wander the dangerous halls of the Madness Palace. Instead, you weave it together with a lattice of Computronio nodes, creating a distributed network of thought that explores in your stead. These nodes project into the Palace, dipping into its endless archives and returning only refined, stable fragments of knowledge.

The result is a stream of coherent blueprints and safe insights, stripped of the toxic excess that would drive even the strongest thinker to ruin. The knowledge is limited to what a specialist in that field could produce—meaning you will never pull back impossible nonsense or shortcuts to powers outside your scope—but what you do receive is immediately usable and free from corruption.

This network scales with your resources. A handful of nodes provide trickles of inspiration; a true computational lattice can harvest breakthroughs across multiple disciplines at once. The mad brilliance of the Palace becomes ordered, compartmentalized, and safe—no longer whispers that gnaw at your sanity, but blueprints that expand your workshop and strengthen your reach.

title: (Master/Trump) Sankta
description_html:
You possess the ability to transform others - and optionally yourself - into Sankta, denoted by the presence of a unique and personalized halo and pair of luminescent wings, although the wings are entirely cosmetic and do not bestow flight.

The Halo of a Sankta grants them an empathic mental connection to each other, allowing them to feel the emotions, pain, and intent of other Sankta. Additionally, Sankta are bound by “Laws” which punish negative actions and reward positive ones, albeit only when committed towards other Sankta. All Sankta possess an innate awareness of the Laws which bind them, meaning they cannot violate them out of ignorance. Merely thinking about violating the law is enough to cause minor negative feedback, akin to slight pressure or a minor headache.

To elaborate, selfless actions provide not just positive feelings, but in the case of Parahumans, also provide minor but compounding boosts to the control and strength of their powers so long as they do not commit a punishable act. Conversely, harmful acts that inflict suffering on others result in Exile. Exiled not only lose the benefits of being a Sankta but also the ability to understand other beings - even non-Sankta - on a fundamental level.

This inability to understand extends to the point of being unable to understand speech, writing, expression, or even recognize features, leaving them truly and utterly alone in the world, save for the incomprehensible shades of those they once knew. The inability to understand is so strong that it functionally goes both ways to a certain extent, as Exiled are fundamentally unable to communicate with others. On the flip side, Sankta who do possess haloes find themselves functionally unable to see and register Exiled as people, instead seeing them as something along a particularly smart animal, a beast in the wilderness.

You do not have to touch others to convert them; instead, you're able to convert any being that enters a 100-meter radius.

addons.description_html: Type: Humanity binds the power of the Sankta to their very DNA, transforming an artificial state of empowerment into a true racial transformation, their halo and wings not mere power manifestations but a fundamental part of their body. As this is a true racial transformation, the effects are permanent and can be biologically passed down and inherited. All Sankta benefit from the effects of Type: Humanity, possessing triple helix DNA. Additionally, Exile actually becomes worse. Being Exiled doesn’t transform someone back into their original race; instead, it merely strips them of the features which denote a Sankta, halo shattering and wings fading. Lastly, if you possess Flock, then the strengthened connection Sankta possess allows for the sharing of evolutionary data, meaning that if one Sankta develops a beneficial mutation, all Sankta can manifest it as well.

addons.title: Laterano
addons.description_html:
The Sankta network takes jurisdiction over your ever-growing world dimension, transforming it into a pocket city-state that any Sankta can access freely, whether entering directly or opening portals with a size from small enough to barely fit a bullet through up to the size of large semi-trucks.

At the core of this dimension lies Laterano, a bright and beautiful city of Gothic architecture with all the infrastructure needed to support its Sankta inhabitants. As new Sankta are connected to the Law, the city grows in size and creates new infrastructure.

This ensures that every Sankta has their base needs covered, with the city providing fully furnished housing with all the needed amenities, such as food, water, electricity, and even a separate layer of internet for the city's digital needs.

This city also generates non-residential properties like farms, bakeries, or workshops that Sankta can take possession of with relatively little effort. This works through the Halo, reading when a Sankta has relevant skills and generating the corresponding properties needed to use those skills. These properties adapt to their owners and their needs, growing with them or expanding if they hire other Sankta.

While nothing prevents non-Sankta from entering one of the portals that a Sankta creates, the city simply does not make allowances for them. Unless a Sankta decides to open a business catering to outsiders or they convince a Sankta to let them live with them, they will be left homeless and without any form of accommodation, supplies, or access to automated infrastructure.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You possess the ability to transform others - and optionally yourself - into Sankta, denoted by the presence of a unique and personalized halo and pair of luminescent wings, although the wings are entirely cosmetic and do not bestow flight.

The Halo of a Sankta grants them an empathic mental connection to each other, allowing them to feel the emotions, pain, and intent of other Sankta. Additionally, Sankta are bound by “Laws” which punish negative actions and reward positive ones, albeit only when committed towards other Sankta. All Sankta possess an innate awareness of the Laws which bind them, meaning they cannot violate them out of ignorance. Merely thinking about violating the law is enough to cause minor negative feedback, akin to slight pressure or a minor headache.

To elaborate, selfless actions provide not just positive feelings, but in the case of Parahumans, also provide minor but compounding boosts to the control and strength of their powers so long as they do not commit a punishable act. Conversely, harmful acts that inflict suffering on others result in Exile. Exiled not only lose the benefits of being a Sankta but also the ability to understand other beings - even non-Sankta - on a fundamental level.

This inability to understand extends to the point of being unable to understand speech, writing, expression, or even recognize features, leaving them truly and utterly alone in the world, save for the incomprehensible shades of those they once knew. The inability to understand is so strong that it functionally goes both ways to a certain extent, as Exiled are fundamentally unable to communicate with others. On the flip side, Sankta who do possess haloes find themselves functionally unable to see and register Exiled as people, instead seeing them as something along a particularly smart animal, a beast in the wilderness.

You do not have to touch others to convert them; instead, you're able to convert any being that enters a 100-meter radius.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Master/Trump) Sankta

title: (Thinker) FGC Mentality
description_html: "Wombo Combo!" You can visualize yourself as if your body is a fighting game player character while you're using an imaginary controller as input for your actions. This ability can help you in executing tasks much more effectively. As you can do things that require a skill set you're not as experienced in or as talented in, as if you're just clicking a few buttons. The more complicated the combo input is, the more complex the things you can do. A quick example would be cooking a hard-to-execute recipe. You can do so without cooking experience, so long as you execute the button inputs in your head. The more complicated the combos are, the tastier it becomes. You don't think up a combo yourself; your ability gives you a list of ones you can try. You can still fail if you haven't gotten the grip of the combo you are trying to do, however. Nothing that some practice couldn't fix. Life is a video game, and you're a pro gamer.

addons.title: Super Cancel
addons.description_html: Turns out, when your mentality focuses on the right set of actions and inputs to reach a goal helps a lot with the ability to branch out from any movement. Your Thinker powers meld with Move Cancel to plan and improve its effectiveness, seeing the “best” routes and picking the “right” branches as combos on your head. In turn, it makes your “branches” instantaneous, done in quick succession, moving from one area to another or immediately onto the next opponent, where you’ll be all over the place from anyone’s point of view. This guidance also helps with power synergies (if you have any). Inputting a combo to plan a successive path of “branches” will inevitably result in a Super. A Super Cancel being a cinematic attack made from one of your powers at your disposal (or Move Cancel) that causes a high degree of damage or puts the enemy or obstacle at a disadvantage. How this Super manifests is always up to you. Having Stacked Move will change up this synergy’s mechanics to “stack” the combo you make in your favor, adding several ways how an input or combo is performed, speeding your chance for a Super, resulting in different unpredictable effects, like “wavedashing” or “crouch dashing” while on the cusp of a Super.

addons.title: ULTRA COMBO!
addons.description_html: Sometimes, slow and steady wins the battle, with Your Only Move’s ‘pause’ opening FGC’s eyes in reading your opponent: every ‘pause’ will tell you their weak points, what moves they’ll lean on, you’ll be fully aware and sharply reading the opponent, to the point you’re already know how to begin and end a match with the strategies to boot. As a result, all your combos are freeform, where there’s more fluidity in the range of combos you’re able to do or act on, as long as you ‘pause’ to plan these out. Be ready to make some strings! Having Brain Playstyle/Super Cancel and/or Body Playstyle will expand your capability further, with the former’s intuitive awareness of your “branches” will refine your ability to see the “best” branches to the point it is already “done”, the opponent only catching up when they’re on the ground or already dead.

title: (Master) End-Controller
description_html:
You now possess the ability to forcibly interface with and override the control matrix of any Endbringer within 100 meters of you, regardless of whether they were created by another Shard, Entity, or other means.

However, this reprogramming is not instantaneous and varies based on a target’s strength and proximity. At maximum range, several minutes are usually required to gain control of most Endbringers. But as this distance shrinks, so too does the time required, with even brief physical contact allowing for near-instant subjugation.

Any interruption in this reprogramming, such as the Endbringer leaving your 100m radius, resets this process in its entirety. Moreover, most Endbringers will sense your attempt to control them and respond with overwhelming force or the desire to flee. Simply staying in the required range can become a desperate struggle for survival.

Furthermore, you instinctively perceive the exact amount of time required to complete reprogramming for any Endbringer within your range, granting you perfect awareness of how your power interacts with them. Once reprogramming is complete, your control is absolute and permanent, overriding all prior loyalties, programming, and commands, and, in the absence of orders, acting independently in ways consistent with your Shard’s directives.

Finally, any Shard-boosting perks you possess (such as Negentropy, Esoteric Knowledge, or Pocket Shard) extend to your controlled Endbringers. In particular, Negentropy drastically accelerates reprogramming, reducing the time required to subjugate even an Endbringer at maximum range to as little as one minute.

title: (Tinker) Magic is Technology
description_html:
You know the trope where it turns out a complex and powerful magic system is actually a form of technology? Yeah, this Tinker specialty revolves around that concept.

Consider essentially any and all common uses for magic in the fantasy genre, and this Tinker specialty will probably have some method to replicate them with technology. Whether that be wands controlling the elements, enchanted items, summoned magical creatures, or even something like the existence of mana.

Some examples could be mana taking the form of a versatile biocompatible nanite design implanted in a user to let them directly cast spells. Golems are pretty simple, just robots and AI with a fantasy aesthetic. Alchemy through medicine and poison. Enchanting items could work by installing modifiable energy field projectors into the desired objects. Even a curse of bad luck is possible through the use of a long-range probability manipulating device.

Powerwise, a good example for the low end of this power would put you in the same level as a hedge wizard: simple levitation, the odd light illusion, maybe a few electro zaps here and there.

title: (Tinker) Iterative Design
description_html:
Much like String Theory, you are a Free Tinker with a slight twist. In your case, rather than your creations being on a time limit, your Tinkering methodology has a Focal Tinker flair.

As a baseline, you can build pretty much anything; however, your initial creations are below even conventional technology in capability, being more along the lines of DIY projects. However, by studying your creations, you gain an understanding of how to make a new version that is improved in some way.

This process can occur multiple times, each iteration of the project growing more advanced, although at a certain point, you will reach a soft-cap due to Shard restrictions. Thus, the optimal usage of this power is to create something, then study it before creating an improved version, before repeating the process over and over again.

Additionally, this process of studying something to build a better version can be applied to any technology, not just your own, although you will still have to work past the blackboxing of other Shards if you want to study another Tinker’s tech.

title: (Trump/Shaker) Fatalis Engine
description_html:
Your power is designed with one purpose and one purpose only: to kill. Your power grants you access to 5 slots, 5 mutable channels you can slot with lethal vectors with which to express your powers.

Burning, cutting, poison, monsters, explosives, ablations, concussion, predations, fragmentation, entropy, gravitation, toxic bloom, and countless others catalogued by your Shard. These are not mere elements or base themes either, no, they’re mere examples, slots can hold anything your power deems a viable method of killing,

Slots can be swapped freely, but only loaded effects are accessible at any point in time. Every vector expresses only lethality. No healing, no shields, no utility—only lethal function. Fire cannot warm, predators cannot guard, poisons cannot numb; their function is to end life and nothing else.

Slots are freely expressive, a single vector that can be expressed in endless ways. Entropy may be represented as a corrosive fog, collapsing terrain, or withering weapons. Vectors can also be freely combined, such as <u>Predation</u> and <u>Toxic</u> bloom to create fungal beasts, ablation and gravitation to create singularities that shear matter, mix <u>Fire</u> + <u>Monsters</u> + <u>Poison</u> + <u>Explosion</u> to create a dragon spewing toxic, explosive fire while slashing with razor-edge claws.

Once loaded, slots can be expressed in any combination, in any number of ways simultaneously. This means you can summon poison blades, caustic acids, and creatures that breathe fire and explosive poison gas, you can deploy fire pillars, exploding spiders, and poisoned blades—all drawn from the same slot pool.

By default, the power is efficient, using no more force than necessary. But you control the scale. Ablation can strip buildings layer by layer or erase entire blocks. Gravitation can pull a man to his knees or mimic the collapse of a star. Flames can flicker or burn as plasma jets that scour cities. Scale brings collateral.

Your Shard also remembers: once you create something, from razor-wire entropy traps to collapsing predator hives, you can recall it instantly as a stored configuration.

Your power’s effective range manifests in two hundred square meters; the Manton Effect holds, so you cannot use it to spawn your effects directly inside a living being, although near them is fine.

title: (Stranger) Extenuating Circumstances
description_html: You didn’t do that. And if you did, it wasn’t that bad. And if it was, you didn’t mean it. And if you did, they deserved it. No matter what you do or say, everyone who experiences it will see you as having been entirely right. Not because their reasoning has been tampered with, but because their perception of the world has been altered to construct an alternate reality where you would be right, and everything the people affected experience will be filtered through the lens of that reality. This doesn’t wear off; anyone who has had their worldview changed by your actions will continue to live their life seeing only what your power lets them see, automatically filtering out any and all evidence suggesting you could have been wrong, until they either die or have their perception tampered with by you again. The simulation they are trapped in is flawless, taking the knowledge and feelings of the target into account to cut off any suspicion they might have before they even start to feel it. Not even Tattletale would be able to tell something is wrong in the world if she fell under your power’s effect.

title: (Brute/Breaker) Self Projection
description_html:
You have gained a power akin to Scion’s avatar, your physical self now existing as a material projection. Your shard continuously heals and maintains both your body and consciousness, rendering you effectively unkillable by conventional means.

You regenerate any damaged tissue nigh instantaneously, fast enough that even those with parahuman senses may fail to register it. You can fully control this process, altering its speed and scope at will. Total erasure of every atom of your body would only see you being immediately reconstituted.

Your body’s ‘template’ will update automatically to ensure any beneficial alterations, such as tinkertech and so on, can be integrated into your body and so similarly restored. As a side effect, your shard will permanently maintain you at peak condition and safeguard your mind in a manner akin to Alexandria.

This doesn’t prevent you from being trapped or restrained. Your shard can potentially run out of energy replenishing your body, although it may take decades of continuous damage to achieve this.

addons.title: Custom Projection
addons.description_html: This power’s functionality has transformed, harkening back to one of its original purposes for the Entities: the creation of customisable projections able to pass as members of a host species. With (Breaker/Trump) Custom Avatar, you don’t have just one alternate form. Instead, every avatar you create is stored as an individual template that is freely accessible. Additionally, the reservoir that fuels your transformations now refills passively at a baseline rate equal to what would be generated through normal relaxation. There is no upper limit to how many templates you can create, though transitioning between them consumes your reservoir, with the cost scaling proportionally to the degree of deviation between the two forms. Beware that your mind can still be influenced by the alien thought processes of forms your shard emulated in cycles past.

addons.title: Continuity of Being
addons.description_html: Every body born of Amon Syndrome has become more than a copy; they now manifest as projections, sustained by your shard through the exact same framework as your ‘primary’ body. As such, every projection you create possesses the same durability and extraordinary regenerative capability as your original body. You may summon or dismiss projections at will and can materialise new avatars within a hundred metres of any existing body. This does not increase your "pool" of power for avatars. Additionally, you may designate any projection as your ‘primary’ self at any time, seamlessly transferring your full suite of abilities to that body. Even if your ‘primary’ body was somehow annihilated beyond recovery, your shard would simply reroute into another active projection, preserving your continuity of self.

title: (Shaker/Master) Dark Worlds
description_html:
With this power, you are given the ability to create a core of darkness within an enclosed space by piercing the floor with a sufficiently sharp object such as a knife or screwdriver. With this core of darkness established, a field of darkness is formed and spreads to encompass the entirety of the room.

When the room is completely enclosed in darkness, over the course of an hour, a pocket dimension is procedurally formed, influenced by your imagination and perspective of the location, and based on the objects within the location. Various individuals and structures based on the items within the room populate this pocket dimension. Such natives have an ingrained loyalty to you for creating them and universally wield 8SP worth of powers expressed in ways befitting the object of their origin.

People of the real world entering this pocket dimension, excluding you if you so choose, have their clothing, form and possessions transformed into items based similarly on their wielder's personality and their form into more combat suitable forms. Such as a hoodie becoming a spiked set of leather armor or a pencil becoming a carbon-reinforced wooden sword. This can also exclusively provide unpowered individuals with 10SP worth of powers when within this realm, however they will lose these powers when leaving. Parahumans, such as you, are exempt from this temporary boost.

This pocket dimension can be destroyed in two ways. Whether by illuminating the pocket dimension with a sufficiently strong source of light, or by destroying the core of darkness maintaining its existence.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Urbanist
description_html:
You can generate and manipulate urban utilities and structures. The city around you is under your complete control and oversight, from the tiniest nook to the tallest monuments, letting you perceive and manipulate every element of the city's infrastructure as an extension of your will. You can manipulate the way roads turn, the writings on signs, which floors elevators stop on and which stations trains go to. You can shift, lower, raise, or sink entire city blocks, and seal off streets into inescapable mazes. If it is part of the scenery and within the bounds of concrete, it is inside your domain.

From any available surface, you can rapidly extrude these very same utilities and structures with enough force to kill most average Brutes - asphalt roads complete with sidewalks, telephone phones and electrical networks, streetlights and underground plumbing and more. Within the span of a second, you could grow an entire block’s worth of buildings or larger ones such as skyscrapers, with these monoliths of concrete quickly rising from the ground or from each other. While they only begin as nondescript, regular (if a tad brutalist) architecture, with focused effort you can ‘officiate’ them. They gain detailed interiors and specialized fittings: hospitals with operating theaters and diagnostic equipment, factories with functional assembly lines or fortified compounds with armories and defensive emplacements. Anything you create comes with its necessities such as underground plumbing or reinforcement. You can also dig out subterranean passages to allow for tunnels and subways. Your creations will remain permanently unless you choose to dissolve them back into the earth.

addons.title: City of Tomorrow
addons.description_html: Your ability to manifest tinkertech in your environment has settled in quite well with your ability to design and manifest equipment for buildings. Where before you could only create mundane hospitals, factories, or military encampments, now you can turn them into the nodes from where your tinkertech propagates. As you apply further focus on officiated buildings or areas, their equipment and surroundings begin to transform into tinkertech at a rapid pace, suited for the designated purpose of the officiates. For example, a hospital might eventually grow into a full on medbay you would see on a starship, or a military encampment might start producing its own robotic soldiers. A road network grows solar panels and kinetic receivers that transform the energy of the cars driving atop them into usable electrical energy. An art museum gains a Master rating. Schools, offices, apartments - so long as it is an officiate, it can grow tinkertech. More focus and more time means more advanced refinement of this tinkertech.

addons.title: La Citadelière
addons.description_html:
A voice whispers into your ear, now, tickling your ear’s inner canals. Uninterrupting, but ever-present, like a newspaper birdie at your shoulder. The information it whispers is of the city, when you think of it. Of any city. It speaks of the people in their hustle and bustle, the quiet troubles they stew within that the rush of this day and age cannot whisk them away from. It speaks of the time, as it ticks from your phone, watch, and hippocampus. The corners of the city where the lowly trod and the criminals hide, the abandoned dusts where ambitious projects lay to the wayside, and the seasons when winds and insects come and go.

And your mind pieces it all together to create a painting of past, present, and future. At any time you wish, so long as it has happened in your vicinity, and so long as it happened in the bounds of a city - and even the rustiest pipe in the deepest of forests counts as a stretch of a city - you know what happened, how it happened, and what it will make happen. Omniscience bounded in gray. Your creations especially amplify your awareness, with the voice whispering louder near them, more detailed in explanation.

You are now capable of applying influence with your urbanism, for you are aware of the city in its entirety, and thus act as its Will, translating its vibrations and musings into plots that could decide the fate of nations. Your manipulation of the smaller things - from signs to logos, from typography to parking lines - sharpens when you utilize it alongside your awareness. Subliminal messaging on a mass degree, unable to be perceived by most even as you walk among the crowd. In days, you could change the air of a city to be transient, as people unintentionally act in ways that would lead to its decline. In weeks, you could organize mass protests for bloodsport, breaking records with how many people attend and how far politicians go to appease them. In months, you could change the world on a global scale. And if you were to focus this manipulation for or against a singular group or person, you can be sure that you decide their fates alone, with their lives putty in your hands. Martyrs, scapegoats, heroes and villains, handmade all by you.

addons.title: Vastness Over Yonder
addons.description_html:
You are no longer limited to the manipulation of urban spaces, nor the transformation of a single ecosystem at a time. Rather, your power has ascended to a breadth and depth most will envy: simply, Environment Manipulation.

Within a range of 20 miles, you are now able to manifest and manipulate any mundane environment, and are capable of controlling, adding to, and removing from these environments at both a micro and macro scale, including biological entities. You are not limited to singular environments either. You could will into existence a bustling desert locale on one half with a winter wonderland on the other half, or turn into a jungle that gets continuously dense and dangerous as you near its center. You possess full knowledge and control over any entities you directly create, from memories to life cycles to instincts and more, and are well-equipped to handle and take advantage of this knowledge.

Additionally, when creating biological entities, you can fabricate entire lives for them at a moment’s whim, allowing you to create societies where both man and animal coexist together, or are at war with one another, or simply entirely fake ones where they believe they have always existed. However, you may only create memories and lives that you believe are capable of happening or occurring. These memories can include the learning of any skill and profession, meaning that any animal or human you create could be fully learned and capable of virtually any task you put them to.

While you are still capable of becoming the environments you create, you no longer have to meld into them to fully control them, with this function instead becoming a defensive and mobility option, letting you essentially teleport anywhere within your 20-mile radius, and allowing you to propagate your domains rapidly.

title: (Trump/Striker) Power Broker
description_html: You have been granted the power to create new powers, but instead of wielding them yourself, you grant them to others. Every day, you gain a charge which you may use one or more of to fuel your power. This power has four aspects, Imbue, to grant a new power to someone, Alter, to modify Imbued abilities, Upgrade, to improve the strength or versatility of Imbued powers, and Reclaim, to take back that which you Imbued. Imbue is the act of infusing charges into someone to grant them powers. Simply come up with a power that is possible to exist while touching someone and the charges will take that form. You may be as specific or not as you want, the charges will fill in any gaps in your design. There are limits to this however. Each charge is only equal to roughly 1 SP of power, so any power you create will be limited by the amount of charges used (i.e. if you grant superstrength, they aren't toppling skyscrapers with only 1 SP of it). Another limit is that you can only Imbue any specific person with up to 3 SP of power within a given day. Finally, a person can only hold one Imbued power at a time. Alter is the act of modifying the 'blueprint' of an Imbued power, therefore changing its expression. Each power you create has a blueprint detailing how it works, and you may examine it by simply touching its host. You may redesign the blueprint whenever you want, but in order for the new blueprint to take effect, you must expend a charge to Alter the power to fit the new blueprint. You can do this as often as you want, and any previously used designs are saved, allowing you to create a wide range of possible expressions to instantly Alter to for just about any situation. The main limits are that the power must still cost as much total SP as it did before and that the power must still be in line with its core mechanics, i.e. a power to heal through time reversal could become the power to harm through time acceleration, but not the power to read minds. Upgrade allows you to increase the SP an Imbued power is worth, therefore making it better. Whether you simply up its parameters or add new expressions like giving a Striker Healer a Blaster power in the form of regeneration inducing energy beams is up to you. The main limit to this is that Imbued powers have an upper limit of 15 SP, and again you can only add upwards of 3 SP of power to a specific person in a given day. Reclaim allows you to take back charges Imbued into others simply by touching them. Note that you aren't taking the powers themselves, but the charges used to make them. This is an inefficient process, so for every three charges you try to Reclaim, you only get one charge while the others vanish. Additionally, this process is stressful to the person it's used on. If you move slowly, you can Reclaim one charge every five minutes with them only feeling mild discomfort, but you can also instantly Reclaim your charges, causing damage proportional to the number. For an otherwise normal human, this would be at most a broken finger or minor internal bleeding if one charge were Reclaimed this way, but fifteen at once would outright kill them. Note that charges spent Altering a power cannot be Reclaimed, only those used to Imbue and Upgrade powers. Note: You do not possess innate immunity to powers granted with Power Broker nor do you have any sort of Master power to influence those you give them to. So maybe don't give that sleezy looking guy a Master power if you aren't already immune to them?

You may be as specific or not as you want, the charges will fill in any gaps in your design. There are limits to this however. Each charge is only equal to roughly 1 SP of power, so any power you create will be limited by the amount of charges used (i.e. if you grant superstrength, they aren't toppling skyscrapers with only 1 SP of it). Another limit is that you can only Imbue any specific person with up to 3 SP of power within a given day. Finally, a person can only hold one Imbued power at a time. Alter is the act of modifying the 'blueprint' of an Imbued power, therefore changing its expression. Each power you create has a blueprint detailing how it works, and you may examine it by simply touching its host. You may redesign the blueprint whenever you want, but in order for the new blueprint to take effect, you must expend a charge to Alter the power to fit the new blueprint. You can do this as often as you want, and any previously used designs are saved, allowing you to create a wide range of possible expressions to instantly Alter to for just about any situation. The main limits are that the power must still cost as much total SP as it did before and that the power must still be in line with its core mechanics, i.e. a power to heal through time reversal could become the power to harm through time acceleration, but not the power to read minds. Upgrade allows you to increase the SP an Imbued power is worth, therefore making it better. Whether you simply up its parameters or add new expressions like giving a Striker Healer a Blaster power in the form of regeneration inducing energy beams is up to you. The main limit to this is that Imbued powers have an upper limit of 15 SP, and again you can only add upwards of 3 SP of power to a specific person in a given day. Reclaim allows you to take back charges Imbued into others simply by touching them. Note that you aren't taking the powers themselves, but the charges used to make them. This is an inefficient process, so for every three charges you try to Reclaim, you only get one charge while the others vanish. Additionally, this process is stressful to the person it's used on. If you move slowly, you can Reclaim one charge every five minutes with them only feeling mild discomfort, but you can also instantly Reclaim your charges, causing damage proportional to the number. For an otherwise normal human, this would be at most a broken finger or minor internal bleeding if one charge were Reclaimed this way, but fifteen at once would outright kill them. Note that charges spent Altering a power cannot be Reclaimed, only those used to Imbue and Upgrade powers. Note: You do not possess innate immunity to powers granted with Power Broker nor do you have any sort of Master power to influence those you give them to. So maybe don't give that sleezy looking guy a Master power if you aren't already immune to them?

title: (Trump/Changer) Hoarder
description_html: Through touch you can steal the powers of a Parahuman. The stealing occurs at a rate of 1% cumulatively per 1 second, thus taking 100 seconds to completely steal a power. You can store and use as many powers as you want, and they are massively amplified, which means even if you only managed to steal a low percentage of someone's power it would still be somewhat useful. When you increase the percentage, the amplification is redone using the new baseline. For example, if you stole 100% from Grue you could have the best of his Pre and Post Second Trigger, amplified to a greater degree. You would be able to instantly cover an entire city with your darkness — said darkness completely absorbing all energy interacting with it, removing scents, hidering movement by increasing the effort to do so, and nullifying all powers caught within while letting you access all of them as good as their users could. You would also have perfect control over your darkness, being able to shape it into all sorts of things and even turn it into a liquid or solid, this control would also allow you to selectively adjust the properties mentioned before, like excluding an ally from the power nullification. Finally, you can allow others to not have their sight hindered by your darkness. While if you stole 1% you would be able to blanket a room with your darkness, and reshape it into fragile solid constructs that absorb a small amount of energy. Each power also comes with a permanent physical mutation, all your mutations will never clash with each other in the sense that if you had both ice and fire nails they would change in some way so they can coexist, this won't stop you from looking like an abomination due to all the powers you stole. Grue's mutation would for example be that any black color in your body absorbs all light that touches them, essentially becoming 100% Black.

title: (Tinker) Unfinished Dreams
description_html:
You are a free Tinker of unprecedented scale and capability. The catch being that all the designs this power provides are either incomplete, flawed in some fashion, or otherwise require substantial refinement to be of practical use.

These designs can fall on a sliding scale between a technically functional prototype that works but is in need of severe optimization, fragmented pieces of a design or theory that hints at something theoretically technologically possible, and everything in between.

The reason for the state of these designs is because this power is a repository for technological designs dreamed up by the host species of previous cycles that were unfinished or otherwise in development by the end of those cycles.

While the Entities have made use of all they could gleam from these designs, the potential remains for a new mind with the right creativity and work ethic to produce new and potent innovations from them, which is the reason for this repository's existence.

These designs can originate from civilizations who consider simple sticks and stones to be the height of technology, to those who consider the fundamental principles of reality to be guidelines instead absolutes, and everything in between. 

At the absolute highest point of technological progress this power provides it might touch on principles comparable to a tier 3 Tinker power, you’ll just need to put substantial work in if you ever want to approach those heights.

Finally, due to the nature of this repository your Shard hasn’t made any changes to the designs it provides that would require Shard assistance to be made or function. Though some percentage of the designs might still be blackboxed in some form from their original creators, overall you’ll still have a vastly easier time sharing your technology with others than most Tinkers.

title: (Trump) Just Like Legos
description_html:
You have access to twelve grids. Up to six can be active at once. Each grid is a 9×9 layout where you place functional blocks. The more complex a grid is, the more energy it costs to run. Simple layouts are efficient and stable. Dense or layered designs burn power quickly.

Blocks represent basic operations such as targeting, movement, projection, transformation, filtering, and conditional logic. When activated, a grid executes as a single structured effect. Instead of raw force, the system favors precision, letting you build effects that would normally require multiple separate abilities.

Each grid comes with built-in blockages that restrict certain cells. These are not purely drawbacks. Some blockages grant benefits if worked around correctly, such as reduced energy cost, duplicated outputs, longer duration, or limited free activations. Good designs account for these limits instead of ignoring them.

You may reroll a grid at will. You can reroll the entire grid, only its blockages, or only the special properties of individual blocks. This allows refinement without starting over. Any rerolled element is replaced with a new, compatible option.

Rerolling or modifying a grid takes up to one minute of uninterrupted focus and can only be done on an inactive grid. Active grids are locked and cannot be altered, preventing on-the-fly reconfiguration during combat or execution.

Energy cost scales with instruction density and interaction depth. Linear effects are cheap. Conditional logic, multi-target resolution, or chained interactions raise costs rapidly. Pushing a grid too far risks instability, resulting in partial execution or complete failure.

addons.title: Build it Brick by Brick
addons.description_html: You can now create physical bricks based on the blocks you have developed for use in your grids that can be used with the same logic to make tinkertech constructs. These bricks can range anywhere from the size of a regular lego brick to the scale of a person to a minifigure. Bricks can only connect to bricks of the same size. You can also tinker any object or materials into the shape of bricks you can build constructs with. Objects tinkered into bricks will continue to function but do not gain any new properties or capabilities besides the change in shape. You can use Artificer charges to apply patterns to bricks in order to enhance your constructs. At the full charge cost, you can create bricks that power themselves and give the entire construct new capabilities, conversely you may put an enchantment on a brick at reduced charge cost, though it will require a power brick to function. With Enchanting Alchemy, you may directly transmute materials in a transmutation circle into enchanted bricks. In any case, enchanted bricks function better than normal bricks and will be able to fully interact with other bricks in the same construct. You may also use your grids and their block logic to create and modify patterns. These constructs are fueled by power bricks that are created by expending either Artificer charges or a large amount of grid energy. Power bricks provide a steady output of power that is used by bricks in the construct without much need for maintenance. Power bricks can only fuel bricks that are up to five grid spaces away from them in any direction, though you may put multiple power bricks in a construct. You can also make other types of energy bricks, such as transformer, battery or capacitor bricks to improve the energy efficiency of your constructs. When creating a power brick, you may decide to roll a random restriction or condition on it, similar to the blockages from your grids, which provide greatly increased power outputs and other boosts when successfully built around. Brick-based constructs are easy to build and highly modular and reconfigurable, and while the bricks themselves are still blackboxed as normal, you are not restricted from creating instruction manuals for putting them together. However the constructs will be prone to breaking apart completely on hard impacts and can be pulled apart with bare hands unless security-, durability-, or defense-type bricks are built into them.

addons.title: Bootlegos
addons.description_html: You can fuse blocks together to create unique unstable blocks with unpredictable effects. These unstable blocks can have multiple effects that combine together, as well as effects you might not even know until you slot them into a grid and might run in inconsistent but powerful ways with each use. The unstable blocks might also have unconventional shapes or restrictions and drawbacks that make them even more powerful when successfully slotted. Each unstable block is unique and can only be slotted into one grid at a time, and the more unstable blocks in a grid may cause unforeseen consequences. You can combine as many normal blocks as you want, and experimenting with formulas may give you a better understanding of how to get the types of blocks that you want. You can also brew slightly toxic potions that give you extra grid energy, psychedelics that reveal unforeseen grid patterns for you to use. You may also make single-use power potions based on grid patterns or candies based on blocks that can apply their modifiers to other capes’ powers. With Build it Brick by Brick you can experiment to create unstable bricks that provide strange and powerful interactions with the rest of the construct, as well as soup up power bricks to provide increased energy in a wider area, but with volatile effects on the bricks it powers.

title: (Trump) Witchbrew
description_html:
By maintaining uninterrupted contact with a Parahuman for a certain amount of time—depending on their powers potency and their relationship with their Shard, anywhere between half a minute and four minutes—you can take their power and manifest it as an eerie looking liquid in a small crystalline vessel of your choice—or in any existing vessel you are touching at the time. 

Any unpowered person that fully consumes the liquid will obtain the power it contains.

A Parahuman drinking a Witchbrew results in them gaining a version of the power contained within that is drastically decreased to an equivalent of a Tier 0. Non-Parahumans drinking a mix of Witchbrews results in a random one working normally before all others, and the rest being applied to drinker as if a Parahuman.

title: (Tinker) Man Fuck Nanites! All My Homies Hate Nanites!
description_html:
Nanites suck, don’t they? Tiny little machines that supposedly solve every problem in existence with enough technobabble and handwaving. Nanite gel you smear on something and it instantly repairs the damage? How? How do they analyze structural failure and reconstruct complex systems that quickly? Nanite swarms that float around converting other matter into more nanites? That doesn’t even make sense. CHEMISTRY AND ATOMIC BONDS DON'T WORK LIKE THAT! Where does the energy come from? What about the heat output? Conservation laws don’t just take a vacation because the plot or super-tech shenanigans says so.

Fortunately, you are a Tinker who refuses to play that game. You specialize in designing technology that counters, disrupts, and outright annihilates nanotechnological systems and devices. Force fields, hardened structural lattices, and environmental barriers that prevent grey goo or hostile micro-machines from infiltrating and rewriting matter are well within your capabilities. You can create defensive systems that remain stable even when submerged in active nanite swarms, allowing you to operate safely where others would be consumed. Your weaponry is tailored to pierce nanite-enhanced materials and bypass self-repairing augmentations, exploiting coordination limits, signal dependencies, and material weaknesses. You can design AOE devices that disable or flash-fry micro-machines all the way down to the femto-level, breaking swarm cohesion and rendering adaptive systems inert.

But your expertise doesn’t stop at destruction. The other half of your specialization lies in interacting with the world at extremely small scales without relying on microscopic robots at all. Instead of swarms, you use fields and directed energy. Magnetic confinement systems, electromagnetic manipulation arrays, plasma shaping frameworks, telekinetic-force analog technologies, and Directed Energy Fabrication platforms allow you to reshape matter directly. You rearrange bonds through controlled energy gradients, stabilize or destabilize atomic structures, and fabricate materials by inducing structural change rather than assembling them piece by piece with machines. Nuclear transmutation and controlled alchemical processes are within reach, not through self-replicating bots but through precise, field-driven manipulation of fundamental interactions, with the necessary containment and heat management built into your designs.

Where others cheat with tiny robots, you weaponize physics. Nanites are a crutch. You build the counter and the better alternatives.

title: (Thinker) The Human Perspectives
description_html:
Within several hundred feet of yourself you have perfect awareness of every other person; from where they are and how they are moving—both in relation to both you and every other person in your radius—to their current health and well being, and down to what they are currently feeling, thinking, experiencing, and intending. 

This knowledge appears from a first person perspective as if you are personally possessing each and every individual, experiencing everything they do yourself, simultaneously, across all people within your range.

You have infinite multitasking and perfect physical coordination in regards to this power. 

<small>As an example; you would be able to precisely stab or shoot someone in your range exactly where you wanted—assuming your base physical abilities and skills were up to par—and know where they were aiming with their own weapons and whatever traps they had planned as you do so.</small>

title: (Shaker) Slice & Dice
description_html: You possess a remarkable capacity to ‘cut’ within a radius of 100 metres around you via a singular, specialised function: Slice. This ability generates a nearly two-dimensional, invisible plane of pure shearing force that moves through space to cause a cutting effect. The concentrated kinetic energy each Slice carries is entirely under your control, ranging in strength from cutting a blade of grass to effortlessly cleaving through reinforced steel buildings at its peak. A Slice may originate anywhere within your radius and can take any orientation, length, curvature or angle that fits within that area. You can direct its exact motion and trajectory, having it travel at extreme speed, orbit you or remain fixed while rotating. The edge thickness of a Slice can range from 1 cm to 0.1 mm at its sharpest. You may form any number of Slices simultaneously and mentally control all of them with perfect precision and awareness. This enables complex applications such as shaving someone without a single nick, rapidly repeating Slices that mimic a chainsaw or dense lattices of overlapping cuts akin to a barrier, repelling and shredding objects. Slices may also travel beyond your radius if they retain sufficient momentum, though you lose control over their trajectory and their force will naturally dissipate over distance. You can freely dispel any generated Slice instantly and are physically invulnerable to your own power, preventing any self-injury.

addons.title: Clean Cut
addons.description_html:
Your Slices may now be imbued with Faultline’s ability, letting them split the molecular bonds holding materials together upon contact.

This enables them to bypass most forms of physical durability, cutting through substances such as diamonds like butter. Your Slices don’t inherit the same Manton Limit and retain their lethality against living targets. You may freely choose whether a Slice carries this enhanced cutting property or remains purely kinetic in nature.

Conversely, the interaction between these two powers also removes the Manton Limit from Faultline’s touch as well, allowing you to separate flesh and bone as easily as stone or steel with direct contact.

addons.title: Cut the Gordian Knot
addons.description_html:
Cutting is an art; what matters is not just the cut itself, but knowing how and when.

At first glance, the most obvious change is that your Slices can now operate anywhere within your line of sight compared to your original 100 metre radius. More importantly, however, is that your enhanced intuition has integrated with your power to cut, becoming a potent Thinker ability in its own right.

Instead of consciously working out how best to cut, your shard constantly analyzes and predicts your opponents, environment and any unfolding scenario. This information is fed back to you as an innate understanding of the optimal placement, timing and geometry of your attacks, naturally guiding them so they align with your intent and interests.

As such, you instinctively perceive where, when and how to make the optimal cut for any given scenario. You can target specific gaps in a defense or apply the exact force and technique required for the result you want; such as performing surgery without medical know-how or paralyzing someone from the neck down by severing their spinal cord.

This power operates even when you are not consciously directing it. If a sniper were to fire at you, you might casually produce a Slice to intercept the bullet, deflecting or even ricocheting it back towards the shooter despite having no prior awareness of their presence. You’re aware of this guidance and can decide how much to rely on it, letting your power automatically act when milliseconds matter.

title: (Trump) Tarot
description_html:
You possess a potent and versatile Trump ability that allows you to expand and re-express Parahuman abilities using the 12 standard power classifications (Master, Blaster, Thinker, Tinker, Brute, Striker, Changer, Stranger, etc.). You may affect an unlimited number of individuals over time, but can only actively target roughly a dozen Parahumans at once.

Whenever you first encounter a Parahuman, a secondary Thinker ability automatically classifies their power and internally catalogs it as a deck consisting of 1 card plus 24 slots, all but one of which start empty. Each power classification is represented twice among the slots.

Your power identifies the category their ability is most intrinsically aligned to (such as Shaker for Vista or Tinker for Armsmaster). Their current expression is catalogued as the base card, occupying one appropriate slot.

From there, the simplest option is to begin filling additional slots. When you choose a slot to fill, the target’s power mutates to express that category in a way organic to their original ability, broadening its scope rather than granting a separate or disconnected power. You choose which category to add, but you do not choose the exact expression; it emerges from the shard based on the target, the current power expression, the user, and surrounding context.

Each new expression is potent enough to be considered a new power in its own right, at minimum rivaling the original ability. However, it does not exist in isolation. Instead, the expansion integrates directly with what is already present. The power does not grow through generic, grab-bag, or cluster-like additions; rather, the base power itself becomes more capable.

For example, expanding Grue’s Shaker ability with a Mover slot might allow him to teleport between dark spaces with a moment of focus, and instantly within areas suffused by his darkness. Filling a Thinker slot could grant awareness of everything occurring within his darkness at all times. A Master slot might allow him to drain the will and stamina of those caught inside it, and so on.

As different classification slots are filled, the power becomes broader, more versatile, and more potent as its components operate as a coherent whole.

When the second slot of a given classification is filled, the power begins to compound upon itself. While it still broadens, it also gains noticeable depth. For example, if Armsmaster had only his base Tinker slot and you filled nothing but his second Tinker slot, his power would grow to rival Hero’s in both potency and versatility.

As additional slots are filled, the power continues to broaden and strengthen—not by accumulating discrete abilities, but because each new expression reinforces the entire power. Even a single added category typically produces flexibility comparable to or exceeding the original baseline, and as more slots come online, their interactions compound. The ability evolves as a unified organism, with each component feeding into the others. 

You may fill slots all at once or gradually over time. These expansions are permanent unless you rescind them. Because the specific expressions are context-driven, order matters: earlier expansions influence later ones, and adding the same set of categories in a different sequence can produce drastically different outcomes.

Once a specific expression has manifested, it is catalogued as a new card in your internal deck representing that target’s power. If you later rescind a slot, you may refill it either to generate a fresh expression or to re-express a previously recorded version by using the corresponding card. This allows you to lock in certain mutations while letting others continue evolving, enabling piecemeal refinement without full control over the final result.

Some cards are dependent on others, as later expressions can build on functions created by earlier expansions.

All changes are persistent unless you choose otherwise. You may rescind any added slot at will and refill it later, either allowing a fresh expression to emerge or reinstating a previous one.

Crucially, you may also rescind the base card itself. When this happens, you choose whether the power is re-expressed through one of the other categories, leave it up to chance, or you may re-express the power in the same category, causing the target’s entire power to reroll its core expression while remaining within the same classification.

A target can never be left without a base card; your power enforces that at least one of the twelve basic category slots is always occupied.

As a result, rescinding and re-expressing the base power never weakens a target in absolute terms, though it may radically alter how their ability functions and can sometimes produce substantially stronger or more versatile outcomes depending on the resulting power.

You also possess secondary Thinker abilities that allow you to flawlessly remember and track every card you have recorded, every configuration you have created, and how each behaved in practice. This also lets you keep track of everyone you’ve affected, allowing you to manage your beneficiaries.

All changes are persistent unless you choose otherwise. You may rescind any added slot at will and refill it later, either allowing a fresh expression to emerge or reinstating a previous one.

Crucially, you may also rescind the base card itself. When this happens, you choose whether the power is re-expressed through one of the other categories, leave it up to chance, or you may re-express the power in the same category, causing the target’s entire power to reroll its core expression while remaining within the same classification.

A target can never be left without a base card; your power enforces that at least one of the twelve basic category slots is always occupied.

As a result, rescinding and re-expressing the base power never weakens a target in absolute terms, though it may radically alter how their ability functions and can sometimes produce substantially stronger or more versatile outcomes depending on the resulting power.

You also possess secondary Thinker abilities that allow you to flawlessly remember and track every card you have recorded, every configuration you have created, and how each behaved in practice. This also lets you keep track of everyone you’ve affected, allowing you to manage your beneficiaries.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Epic
description_html:
Your very being is entwined with energy on fundamental levels. You're able to manifest constructs of energy whose effects and properties are completely within your control. For example, shields that automatically move to intercept attacks, constructs that affect temperatures, shields that destroy what comes in contact with them, and even shields that can selectively nullify phenomena. All those and more are achievable. At its strongest, one of these shields could stand up to a prolonged assault from Behemoth, though its surface area would have to be no more than 20 square meters and require a buildup of several minutes.

The stronger and more complex the effects you impart on your constructs, the longer the buildup you need before their creation, with the average construct taking less than a second when its size is less than a car.

Your constructs are free-floating and capable of being moved through the air by yourself freely. You also possess a secondary Thinker power that allows you to know where each of your constructs is in relation to yourself. Any constructs more than 100 meters away from you disappear automatically.

title: (Trump) Totally Accurate Randomiser Run
description_html:
You feel a timer ticking down inside your head that starts at a random length anywhere between one day and one month. The closer it gets to zero, the better you can tell exactly how much time is left. When the timer hits zero, one of three different things happens at random:

The first thing that can happen is you get a permanent random power that at its weakest is 5 SP and at its strongest is 10 SP. The power's actual effect is also random but you are guaranteed to be able to use said power. Afterwards the timer starts over.

The second thing that can happen is the timer immediately starts over with a new random length. Then a random number from one to five gets picked, and for that many timers in a row, each one will instantly skip half of its time the moment it starts. For example, if the random number is three and your next timer is set to ten days, it immediately jumps down to five days left; the following timer, eight days, becomes four days; and the timer after that, four days, becomes two day. Each time these timers reach zero, they will trigger another randomised outcome, picking between the 3 options again.

The third thing that can happen is the timer starts over with a new random length, and the next time you actually get a power, the lowest and highest possible strength of that power both increase by 5 SP. This keeps stacking up every time you get this outcome until you finally get a power. For example, if you get this outcome five times, your next power will have its strength range increased by 25 SP, so the original 5 to 10 SP turns into 30 to 35 SP. After you get that boosted power, the strength range goes back down to the normal 5 to 10 SP for the next time around. 

Each time the timer reaches zero, it’s akin to a Trigger Event, regardless of which of the three happen. This means it’s a complete blindspot to Thinkers.

title: (Trump/Breaker) Sophist
description_html:
This ability can become whatever your target believes is your actual powers. 

You can only pick one target at a time, and you can use the abilities they perceive you totally having so long as they keep believing. This however, also includes weaknesses they think you may have.

The target has to fully believe this however. As such, if they know the true nature of your power, the power would lose effectiveness, as they can't just suddenly convince themselves that you have an ability they know you don't actually have. This can potentially be mitigated by tampering with their memories? Possibly.

You can change targets any time.

title: (Trump/Thinker) Catalog
description_html:
You have a collection of a hundred powers between 1 and 15 SP. They are distributed such that each PRT Classification has at least 5 powers whose primary classification matches.

You can use up to 3 powers at a time. If a power is swapped out, it will be available again the next day, essentially entering a cooldown.

You have a Thinker component that allows you to know the names of the powers within your catalog and what they can do.

Finally, you are highly resistant to Masters and Thinkers, messing up their powers such that those of lower strength don't work at all, and those of higher strength suffer heavy interference.

You may choose what's in your collection or let it up to fate.

title: (Striker/Tinker) Cargo Cult
description_html:
Tinker powers are generally a mix of actual advanced technological knowledge with a dash of shard trickery to enable the construction of machinery that currently-available tools aren’t advanced enough to construct on their own.

You have none of the former and so, so much of the latter. You aren’t provided any technological knowledge beyond what you would have without this power, but your shard warps physics on everything you do work on to make it function as though it were far more advanced, drawing on your intentions and the design of the object.

You could fold a piece of paper in half repeatedly to give it an edge so fine it can slip through the gaps in molecules, or make a potato battery that somehow generates more power than a nuclear power plant, or clumsily construct an apparatus out of sticks and leaves that can fly faster than a fighter jet with perfect maneuverability.

The better an object would work without shard interference, the more effective the boost will be. If you have other tinker powers this will work to boost the tinkertech you make massively, creating something far more powerful than either power could do alone.

Other tinkers are probably going to make fun of you.

title: (Master/Trump) Evoker
description_html:
Your shard is host to countless colonies of highly social miniature shard-like energy sprites. These sprites feed on the shard’s energy, which they use to develop powers and shape into their own realms to inhabit within the shard. Your Shard’s purpose is to manage the Entity’s relationship with these sprites.

The culture of the sprites and structure of their colonies is influenced by which shard cluster they inhabit. The sprites can use their own energy to use power expressions that have been recorded by those clusters, and making colonies appear to be “themed” around certain types of power expression. This also affects the forms the sprites take, how they act, and what they value in their realms. You gain a minor Thinker power that allows you to comprehend the alien sociology and topography of these colonies by filtering them through a lens based on fictional and mythological tropes you are familiar with.

By meditating, you can project your mind into these colonies and treat with their inhabitants. Time spent projecting to a colony should only take an hour or two in the real world, but from your perspective, time may seem fluid and surreal as events follow a dreamlike logic. You can also search for new colonies while meditating, though sprites you contract can give you hints and directions to the kinds of colonies you are looking for.

By befriending, outsmarting, defeating or completing tasks for the sprites in their colony, you gain the ability to conjure these sprites into the physical world in a semi-corporeal state. You directly control the summoned sprites’ actions through a psychic link. The conjured sprites can be physically harmed, but if destroyed in your realspace, they will simply be cast back into their colony where they must spend some time reforming.

Each sprite is adept at a specific power expression of the shard cluster their colony is built around. At the start, you have access to around three colonies, and a dozen sprites from each with powers equivalent to 4-7 SP. The strongest sprites can range up to 12-15 SP. You have a psychic bandwidth that can summon half a dozen sprites at a time, which grows with your reputation in their realms.

addons.title: Morian Zenas
addons.description_html:
You can manifest colonies you have access to into pocket dimensions that you can physically enter, or with preparation and energy, overlayed onto your physical world. Because of the anomalous topology of these realms, you must cast a protective field around yourself and others when entering them.

Due to how the sprites construct their colonies from archived power expressions gleaned from adjacent shards, the matter, atmosphere and inhabitants are basically extensions of these expressions. Matter, energy and beings drawn from these pocket realms are more potent than those normally conjured, but also more unstable and not under your direct control.

addons.title: Apocrypha
addons.description_html:
When researching techniques or designs, you can ask power-sprites for secrets from their colonies that can be developed or incorporated into your systems.

The secrets the power-sprites give you come from power expressions developed and archived by the host shards in past cycles. Because past host species had vastly different natures and understandings than humanity, the secret powers fed to you will be difficult for you to comprehend without the help of the sprites. 

Due to the truly alien lens of these power expressions, they interact strangely with power expressions of the current cycle, though they still work by the same overarching rules of shard expressions.

addons.title: Lords of Misrule
addons.description_html:
Each colony’s structure is constructed around a large sprite known as a Prince. As the ones who nested in Shard cluster to construct their realms, Princes have taken on a pseudo-shard-like structure and power output. These Princes could be loosely interpreted as queens, overlords, gods, etc, and are the rulers of their entire realm.

Princes require a massive bandwidth to summon into reality, and can only be briefly partially manifest. They also require the full trust of an entire colony as well as personal deals and bargains with them. Finally, manifesting them requires several trips into their realm to set the right conditions, as well as twenty-four hours in the physical world to prepare for their summoning. You have the full trust of your starting colonies to summon their princes.

Princes are the masters of their domain and manifest minor reflections of their realms onto reality around them when summoned, though these dissipate when the summoning ends. They are also masters of the most powerful power expressions recorded and developed by the denizens of their realms. They can easily defeat a full-powered endbringer once manifested.

In addition, your summoning bandwidth is increased twentyfold, and it is much easier for you to discover other colonies and gain the contract of normal sprites, and you start with an additional five colonies contacted.

addons.title: 36 Lessons
addons.description_html:
When exploring and interacting with the realms and colonies of power sprites, you may find or be gifted grimoires, called storybooks, containing several usable power expressions from the realm that can be added to your Grimoire of Shards library. Storybooks have the same types of recharging batteries as regular grimoires. Taking and studying these storybooks costs none of your Grimoire charges.

Rather than containing esoteric patterns that unscramble as you use the power, the powers of the storybooks are transcribed as stories in a human language you understand. By reciting the passages of these stories, you will be able to cast the power expressions they record.

However, while the words are in human language, the actual content of the stories is almost incomprehensible to those not from the storybook’s original colony. The more you understand the culture and unique logic of the original colonies, the more sense these stories will make to you through Evoker’s thinker effect. Through understanding, you will be able to recite the power expressions more efficiently and at stronger power ratings, and come up with more versatile uses for those expressions.
