These Princes could be loosely interpreted as queens, overlords, gods, etc, and are the rulers of their entire realm.

Princes require a massive bandwidth to summon into reality, and can only be briefly partially manifest. They also require the full trust of an entire colony as well as personal deals and bargains with them. Finally, manifesting them requires several trips into their realm to set the right conditions, as well as twenty-four hours in the physical world to prepare for their summoning. You have the full trust of your starting colonies to summon their princes.

Princes are the masters of their domain and manifest minor reflections of their realms onto reality around them when summoned, though these dissipate when the summoning ends. They are also masters of the most powerful power expressions recorded and developed by the denizens of their realms. They can easily defeat a full-powered endbringer once manifested.

In addition, your summoning bandwidth is increased twentyfold, and it is much easier for you to discover other colonies and gain the contract of normal sprites, and you start with an additional five colonies contacted.
addons.title: Lords of Misrule

addons.text:
When exploring and interacting with the realms and colonies of power sprites, you may find or be gifted grimoires, called storybooks, containing several usable power expressions from the realm that can be added to your Grimoire of Shards library. Storybooks have the same types of recharging batteries as regular grimoires. Taking and studying these storybooks costs none of your Grimoire charges.

Rather than containing esoteric patterns that unscramble as you use the power, the powers of the storybooks are transcribed as stories in a human language you understand. By reciting the passages of these stories, you will be able to cast the power expressions they record.

However, while the words are in human language, the actual content of the stories is almost incomprehensible to those not from the storybook’s original colony. The more you understand the culture and unique logic of the original colonies, the more sense these stories will make to you through Evoker’s thinker effect. Through understanding, you will be able to recite the power expressions more efficiently and at stronger power ratings, and come up with more versatile uses for those expressions.
addons.title: 36 Lessons

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Your shard is host to countless colonies of highly social miniature shard-like energy sprites. These sprites feed on the shard’s energy, which they use to develop powers and shape into their own realms to inhabit within the shard. Your Shard’s purpose is to manage the Entity’s relationship with these sprites.

The culture of the sprites and structure of their colonies is influenced by which shard cluster they inhabit. The sprites can use their own energy to use power expressions that have been recorded by those clusters, and making colonies appear to be “themed” around certain types of power expression. This also affects the forms the sprites take, how they act, and what they value in their realms. You gain a minor Thinker power that allows you to comprehend the alien sociology and topography of these colonies by filtering them through a lens based on fictional and mythological tropes you are familiar with.

By meditating, you can project your mind into these colonies and treat with their inhabitants. Time spent projecting to a colony should only take an hour or two in the real world, but from your perspective, time may seem fluid and surreal as events follow a dreamlike logic. You can also search for new colonies while meditating, though sprites you contract can give you hints and directions to the kinds of colonies you are looking for.

By befriending, outsmarting, defeating or completing tasks for the sprites in their colony, you gain the ability to conjure these sprites into the physical world in a semi-corporeal state. You directly control the summoned sprites’ actions through a psychic link. The conjured sprites can be physically harmed, but if destroyed in your realspace, they will simply be cast back into their colony where they must spend some time reforming.

Each sprite is adept at a specific power expression of the shard cluster their colony is built around. At the start, you have access to around three colonies, and a dozen sprites from each with powers equivalent to 4-7 SP. The strongest sprites can range up to 12-15 SP. You have a psychic bandwidth that can summon half a dozen sprites at a time, which grows with your reputation in their realms.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Master/Trump) Evoker

title: (Trump) Queen
description_html:
With a touch you can grant up to 15 SP worth of powers to a non-parahuman, though no singular power may exceed 10 SP. You may distribute it whichever way you like, such as one singular 5 SP power, or fifteen 1 SP powers, etc.

You retain a connection to your granted powers regardless of distance, allowing you to modify them at will and control them as if you were the user — of course, the later means you can only make it do what it actually can, unless you use the former to cheat of course. This also gives you a controllable two-way telepathic connection, and the capacity to access their senses.

Lastly, your granted powers makes their users develop a certain attitude towards you. It could be loyalty, love, a desire to protect, etc.

Note: if the Parahuman population is numerous enough that finding a non-parahuman is rare, you will be able to grant powers to Parahumans too, as it would be too annoying to use this otherwise.

title: (Striker/Trump) Karma
description_html:
Your Shard has grown fascinated with the concept of meta-principles that humanity not only generally follows but has deemed ‘morality’. As a result, your power is now based on the vague concept of Karma that your Shard has managed to gleam.

The base benefit of this power is that anyone you strike or attack in any way gets an increased amount of damage proportional to the amount of ‘sins’ they have committed. If they kicked a few puppies, then a punch will feel like being hit with a sledge hammer, but if your target is someone like Jack Slash, then just giving them a paper cut would be enough for them to get completely bisected dozens of times over. This can also bypass defensive powers, as it works on targeting the person instead of whatever is between the strike and the target.

This damage multiplier works on two ‘opinions’, one of which your Shard gets from generalizing the base morality of everyone within the range of the 777 Miles (1250 Kilometers/roughly the size of Texas), and the other is from your own morality. If you are fine with someone kicking puppies, there would still be a damage multiplier because most other people are against that, but the increase would be less that what it would be if you also were against the violence on dog kind.

Finally, you also get a ‘sense’ for how ‘evil’ someone is, with the more bad karma they have making a bigger sensory range and stronger feeling of revulsion.

title: (Tinker/Striker) Origami
description_html: Your Shard has granted you a multi-faceted power centered around the manufacture of paper and the creation of origami constructs. The Tinker side of this power allows you to rapidly create any form of paper—for a very broad definition of paper—and even develop new varieties. Sandpaper already exists, but your power could create truly waterproof paper, fireproof paper, or even paper as durable as steel. This aspect of your power comes with a minor Thinker ability to intuitively understand what counts as paper and what doesn’t. The Striker side of the power is much more direct. You have the ability to rapidly form origami—and kirigami—constructs out of paper. The real benefit is that anything you make can take on the physical abilities—and size—of what you model it after. An animal-based construct, for example, will be able to move and react as if it were the real creature, obeying simple commands. Constructs based on tools and weapons can act as if they weren’t made of paper; an origami gun, for instance, could fire origami bullets if you really wanted. This side of your power also lets you fold paper—and paper-like things—with such precision to excel at origami. This does have a few weaknesses. First, your constructs are recognizably still paper, with the durability and vulnerabilities typical of paper. The Tinker side of this power does allow you to mitigate this, but at the expense of having to produce enough paper yourself. Your power does not do well at replicating humans and utterly fails to copy non-physical traits or abilities.

title: (Striker/Blaster) Gouge
description_html:
Gouge is a counterpart to Sting. While Sting lets you pierce all defenses, Gouge allows you to completely prevent all forms of healing.

No form of regeneration, healing, time manipulation, or even resetting will remove the damage caused by this. As a side, you may choose to prevent the wound from actually killing the target. Additionally, the injury will always be fresh and won’t get an infection unless you want it to. You can choose to end this effect or avoid using it at any time.

title: (Master/Shaker) Sensational Stasis
description_html:
Within a range of 100 meters, you are able to comprehend, perceive, and lock in any emotional or physical sensation felt by those around you. This makes a target incapable of letting go of an emotional or physical sensation, but does not prevent them from feeling other or even contradictory sensations.

Not only could you lock in someone's anger or panic to make it so they can't calm down, but you could even lock in something like the sensation of their leg going forward to make it feel like their leg is constantly moving. If they were to try to course correct by moving their leg backwards, you could also lock in that sensation at the same time. If they were to lose balance briefly, you could lock in that loss of balance to completely disorient them, and when this inevitably leads to a spike of panic, you can lock in that panic at its very height, which would likely beget even more panic that you can lock in.

Aside from the ability to send practically anyone into a self-feeding spiral of emotions or unbalance, you can use your power more subtly to lock in small amounts of specific emotions, such as locking in a small bit of happiness while talking to someone.

You are granted greatly enhanced multitasking, and you are able to lock in and perceive all of the major senses, excluding sight. Power granted senses may fall under your purview if they are sufficiently tied to an emotional or physical sense, such as a sense of movement from flight, or potentially a sense of dread from danger-sense.

title: (Tinker) Bonesinger
description_html:
You specialize in the creation of Wraithbone, a living metamaterial grown through song rather than manufactured through conventional engineering. By singing in an instinctive language, you cause Wraithbone to grow, branch, and reshape itself into complete devices with every component seamlessly integrated. Wraithbone is lightweight, exceptionally durable, slowly repairs itself over time, and can serve as everything from structural support and circuitry to armor, sensors, power conduits, and energy systems.

Your specialty revolves around Wraithbone itself rather than any single field of technology, allowing you to create an enormous variety of advanced devices. Weapons, armor, drones, autonomous constructs, vehicles, medical equipment, forcefield generators, infrastructure, tools, and intricate works of art are all possible, provided they can be expressed as a unified Wraithbone construct. Rather than assembling parts, you cultivate your creations, guiding their growth as the material responds to your voice, intent, and design until it reaches its final form.

You possess an innate understanding of Wraithbone, allowing you to freely repair, reshape, merge, or recycle existing constructs into entirely new creations. As your mastery grows, so too does your ability to harmonize with the material itself, increasing both the speed and precision with which it grows. While complex projects may require hours or days of continuous singing, every creation emerges as a seamless whole without the need for conventional tools, fabrication, or assembly, with the finished construct often displaying a level of elegance and integration that traditional engineering cannot easily replicate.

addons.title: Soulsong
addons.description_html: Your psychic mastery and Wraithbone have become inseparable. Wraithbone naturally resonates with psychic phenomena, acting as both a conduit and amplifier for your abilities, while the instinctive language used to shape it has become an extension of your own psychic will. By weaving your song with Sonder’s usage, you can subtly refine, strengthen, or alter your psychic effects with a level of power and precision far surpassing what you were capable of before. Likewise, your creations are no longer limited to being mere technology. Wraithbone can directly channel, store, and manipulate your psychic power, allowing your devices to replicate, enhance, or automate many applications of Sonder. Mental communication networks, autonomous psychic constructs, memory archives, dream interfaces, anti-Master defenses, cognition-enhancing implants, and countless other devices become possible, limited only by your imagination and the time needed to cultivate them. This affinity extends naturally to other psychic powers as well. Psychokinesis can be integrated into your creations to produce tools with unparalleled telekinetic precision or constructs capable of manipulating themselves as though alive, while [Connectivity] Issues can be woven into Wraithbone to create devices that interfere with, redirect, or reinforce a Parahuman's connection to their Shard, from protective wards to sophisticated shard-disruption technology. The song of your mind and the song of your Wraithbone have become one and the same.

addons.title: Spirit Matrix
addons.description_html:
Your mastery over Wraithbone and cognition have become inseparable. Rather than merely consuming minds to strengthen your own, you can crystallize fragments of cognitive essence into Wraithbone itself, preserving memories, knowledge, skills, instincts, and even echoes of personality as permanent psychic matrices. These matrices serve as the minds of your creations, granting them genuine intuition, creativity, and adaptability beyond even the most sophisticated artificial intelligence, while remaining completely loyal to you.

Every Wraithbone construct containing a Spirit Matrix automatically becomes part of a living psychic noosphere, seamlessly exchanging thoughts, memories, sensory data, and processing power with every other connected creation. Information spreads across the network instantaneously, allowing your constructs to learn from one another, divide complex tasks between themselves, or pool their intellect into a greater whole before separating once more. 

Every new mind you harvest enriches the network's collective knowledge, while every new creation expands its reach and processing capacity, transforming your Wraithbone into an ever-growing civilization of living machines united by a single harmonious chorus.

addons.title: Symphony Eternal
addons.description_html:
Your mind, your Wraithbone, and the countless spirits preserved within it have become inseparable aspects of a single existence. Every Spirit Matrix retains its own personality, knowledge, and expertise, yet each also forms part of an ever-expanding psychic chorus, freely exchanging thoughts, memories, perception, and processing power through a living noosphere spanning every Wraithbone creation. Independent minds may cooperate, merge into greater intellects to solve impossible problems, or separate once more, allowing the Chorus to continuously evolve rather than merely grow larger.

Soulsong has likewise transcended a solitary performance. Whenever you sing to shape Wraithbone or weave your psychic power, every preserved voice may join yours, harmonizing into a literal chorus whose combined will guides the material with impossible precision and complexity. The knowledge, creativity, and experience of every spirit contributes to each creation, allowing countless minds to work in perfect concert where once only one could. Every construct produced by this Chorus carries a fragment of its collective song, joining the living network the moment it is born.

Your psychic imprint permeates this entire symphony, spreading wherever your Wraithbone endures. Every new mind preserved enriches the Chorus with fresh voices and perspectives, while every new creation expands both its reach and its collective intellect. Should your body be destroyed, your consciousness simply becomes another voice among the Choir, sustained by the harmony of countless echoes until a new vessel can be cultivated or another host claimed. addons.text:

Every new mind you harvest enriches the network's collective knowledge, while every new creation expands its reach and processing capacity, transforming your Wraithbone into an ever-growing civilization of living machines united by a single harmonious chorus.

You specialize in the creation of Wraithbone, a living metamaterial grown through song rather than manufactured through conventional engineering. By singing in an instinctive language, you cause Wraithbone to grow, branch, and reshape itself into complete devices with every component seamlessly integrated. Wraithbone is lightweight, exceptionally durable, slowly repairs itself over time, and can serve as everything from structural support and circuitry to armor, sensors, power conduits, and energy systems.

Your specialty revolves around Wraithbone itself rather than any single field of technology, allowing you to create an enormous variety of advanced devices. Weapons, armor, drones, autonomous constructs, vehicles, medical equipment, forcefield generators, infrastructure, tools, and intricate works of art are all possible, provided they can be expressed as a unified Wraithbone construct. Rather than assembling parts, you cultivate your creations, guiding their growth as the material responds to your voice, intent, and design until it reaches its final form.

You possess an innate understanding of Wraithbone, allowing you to freely repair, reshape, merge, or recycle existing constructs into entirely new creations. As your mastery grows, so too does your ability to harmonize with the material itself, increasing both the speed and precision with which it grows. While complex projects may require hours or days of continuous singing, every creation emerges as a seamless whole without the need for conventional tools, fabrication, or assembly, with the finished construct often displaying a level of elegance and integration that traditional engineering cannot easily replicate.

title: (Trump/Striker) Sechen Leech
description_html: By touching someone, you are able to reset someone to the absolute weakest their power has ever been, and in doing so, gain the power you stole for yourself. If you were to steal the added strength of a parahuman undergoing a power boost derived from their Sechen ranges, the powers you receive would be temporary echoes of power, but if they had permanently increased the strength of their power, the gains would be permanent. You have no limit to how many powers you can have or use. For instance, if you were to steal Taylor's strength when she was in a tough situation, you may temporarily gain her power with a range of a block or two, likely with less ability to finely manipulate the insects and comprehend their senses. If you were to steal Taylor's strength when she was an experienced parahuman, having increased her base range by impressing her shard, you would permanently gain her power, with however many blocks of range you're taking away from her, possibly ending up at an equal strength to her. This power is most noticeable when used on Tinkers, as in most cases, you would be resetting their tech tree back to square zero. If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless, this will reset people to a baseline based on their potential, but will not take away their knowledge. Their body and any special abilities will be reset to a baseline for their age as if they had never trained, but they would still keep any innate potential or knowledge of techniques. As always, you will be given permanent or temporary access to any strength or power you steal, depending on whether their strength or power was permanent or temporary.

title: (Trump) Offense or Defense
description_html:
At full offense, you can fire energy beams with a Sting-like effect capable of ignoring all defenses and tearing through Endbringers like they're nothing, leaving you with a forcefield that can barely hold up to a normal human's punch.

At full defense, you have a barrier that can absorb, deflect, and otherwise nullify all types of attacks before they can harm you or your allies, in exchange for a beam barely able to scratch paint.

You are able to change the offense-to-defense ratio at will, but doing so will take time, depending on how big the change is, with the most drastic changes taking up to 30 seconds.

title: (Trump) Sword And Shield
description_html: You have two slots for powers, aptly named the Sword slot and the Shield slot. These powers normally take around a minute each to ramp up to full strength, which maxes out at the same level as peak Eidolon, and there is no limit on how long you can keep a power in a slot. You are capable of ‘skewing’ the build-up times of your powers, such as making your Shield slot take up to a day to ramp up while making your Sword slot start at full power. To unskew this would take as long as ramping up your slowest slot. You have control over what powers you get, but you can also choose to cycle them randomly if the need ever arises. Within your Sword slot, you are capable of manifesting a variety of 'offensive' powers, such as telekinesis, lasers, or fireballs. The main limitation is that you won't gain the normal secondary powers that they come with: you won't get the ability to breathe in smoke with pyrokinesis, and you won't become quicker to react or have any form of multitasking when summoning a salvo of lasers. This slot is incapable of using powers such as healing or power-granting. Your Shield slot is capable of holding a myriad of 'defensive' powers, such as a Stranger effect to make you unnoticeable, regeneration, or invulnerability. The limitation of this slot is that the powers used cannot extend beyond you and your clothes. This slot is also unable to summon abilities such as future sight or clairvoyance. Having complementary powers in each slot can lead to synergies between them, including working in ways that violate slot limits, such as having pyrokinesis in your Sword slot and then gaining the option for a flame-based Breaker state in your Shield one, even if that would be impossible to have otherwise. Finally, you are highly resistant to Thinkers, messing up their powers such that those of lower strength don't work at all, and those of higher strength suffer heavy interference.

title: (Shaker/Trump) A Curse Upon Thee
description_html:
The idea of a curse under a Parahuman model seems novel to your Shard, so giddy with potential that it runs with the concept. Taking the form of an area-wide effect that applies to anybody you “curse” (a person in particular, a group, or a small city’s population), your power will use a collection of small power expressions, such as micro-telekinesis, light probability and physics bending, and minor master effects bordering on conditioning, to name a few, to set a permanent effect, with the appearance of a curse upon the victim(s).

Severity and lethality will dull in scale; a mere person's "curse" will crescendo into elaborate happenstances that’ll be potentially deadly, escalating into an inevitable end, while a hundred will experience occurrences that might severely injure, but generally make them miserable without outright killing them. Further diluted if your curse scales to a small city, with your power only capable of generating happenings that build an air of malaise or misery upon the populace, while they are not severe, the curse compensates in frequency and prevalence.

For your power to come into effect, you must directly declare the conditions, reasons, and the effects to the victim(s), clearly and cleanly for them to hear, as that's the moment they register the curse takes effect, i.e., “For the fact of robbing me of rightful estate, I curse your blood to a life of scarcity and failure to its pursuit, falling to men of ill-repute”.

There are a lot of ways to break a curse; going back on the curse’s reason in the first place works well in the case of victim(s), but you can always lift the curse at will once you feel satisfied that your victim suffered enough grief.

addons.description_html: With It Gets Worse, your curse loses its constraints. The range and scope of power expression of your curse manifest are more daring, from warping space-time, inexplicably bending a car’s destination, coincidentally colliding into targets, to creating a collection of dimensional and probabilistic events to ensure the humiliation, misery, and/or death of the victim(s). The need for a clear declaration is removed entirely; if you’ve been wronged by the victim, no matter the intention or goal, a Curse will come into effect. It’ll worsen in severity for those who intentionally had it out for you or are actively pursuing you. As It Gets Worse acts as a cumulative effect, the more the victim tries to avoid or fight the Curse, the worse it’ll be.

title: (Trump/Brute) Resurrective Incarnation
description_html:
Whenever you die, your body and mind are completely repaired, and you are resurrected, and whenever you're resurrected, you will gain the power and mindset of a deceased parahuman. You will find that your personality and emotions will shift to align more closely with that of the deceased parahuman you're copying, and you will likely find yourself emulating them if you don't stop yourself.

The method of your death has an influence on what power you copy, as either the power or parahuman will always be related to the way you died. For instance, being killed by Hookwolf may lead to you getting a power based around metal, but it may also lead to you getting the power of a deceased Empire member, or that of a cape that Hookwolf had previously killed.

Upon dying, you lose access to the powers of whatever parahuman you were emulating previously, and your mind is no longer nudged towards their personality.
